tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //shā chi/hā sbya 7717shā 0'aḥcuXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog

ba lag bra shed ga rigalha mo skyabs kyis brtsams/( mo rnyes ༷ci snying ri 713 〉〉〉 cho) chod)/ ) ru : (87 rmi 4 444'i ruci ri 3 5 tshe nga lha ༷ ri yes 5 )snga ra /nya zhu gcu trīrim chocho sisko ——1 44 7 5 7 ༷ lto ring /95 )) spam dze ri/ ci'i 4 〉 rko—— — sku) dzikānya dzo 3—— tsholo 4) 1 skor / ༈ ma rdzi gci smo mirigagochaskrunakhang/
bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigalha mo skyabasakyis bcoms/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigalha mo skyabasakyis bcoms/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

1 sngon 'gro'i gtam/ ad krin zhes pa'i nad ngan 'di'i 'gog bcos ni 'gro ba mi'i lus phung gi bde thang dang tshe srog la 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i bya bzhag gal chen zhig red/ de bas na srol rgyun gso rig gi dgongs don ltar gyi ad krin 'gog bcos thad kyi phan nus dang rin thang la mi mang po zhig gis mthong chen gtsigs 'dzin byed bzhin yod rung /rang re'i bod lugs gso rig las de'i thad kyi zhib 'jug gi dpyad rtsom sogs lag son du cung dkon pas/ 'dir spyi lo 1994lo'i sngun nas bzung phran nyid kyis bris pa'i 'bras nad zhib 'jug thad kyi dpyad rtsom du ma dang / dpal ldan rgyud bzhi sogs bod lugs gso rig gi bstan bcos su gsungs pa'i 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad dang brtag bcos sogs lhan cig tu bsgrigs pa ma zad/ gzhan da dung nub lugs gso rig 'bras skran zer ba'i nad kyi dbye ba dang nad kyi brtag bcos sogs kyis zur brgyan byas te mdor bsdus tsam bkod pa yin/ad krin nam 'bras nad kyi zhib 'jug dang brtag bcos ni 'tshol snyeg dang tshod blta'i rang bzhin can gyi bya bzhag zhig yin la/dpe deb 'dir bkod pa ni phran nyid kyis gzhung lugs zhib 'jug dang lag len nyams myong ji bzhin bkod yod pas phyogs de ba'i bshad

2 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigastangs dang ma rtogs log rtogs kyi lta ba sogs yod srid pas/ ngos nas klog pa po spyi dang gso ba rig pa'i mkhas dbang rnam pas dgongs 'char lhug por stsol ba'i re ba snying nas zhu/ yang dgos dpe deb 'di par bskrun gyi 'gro song ma dngul la a ri'i 'gro phan thebs rtsa tshogs pas rgyab skyor chen po gnang bar bka' drin che zhus pa yin/ /zhes lha mo skyabs kyis kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'phrod bston slob grwa/ kun su'u krung dbyi slob gling bod lugs gso rig slob gling nas spyi lo 2009lo'i zla4ba'i tshes 16nyin sbyar ba'o/ /

dkar chagasde tshan dang po/ bod kyi gso ba rig par ad grin zhes pa'i nad la ngos 'dzin yod med skor gyi mtha' dpyod/( 1 )le'u dang po/ gzhan lugs mi mthun pa dgag pa/ ( 1 )le'u gnyis pa/ rang lugs 'thad ldanang du bzhag pa/ ( 5 )le'u gsum pa/ 'bras nad dam ad yine tsha grang gang gi phyogs su gtogs par dpyad pa'i chod gtam/ (10)sde tshan gnyis pa/ 'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyas/(13)le'u dang po/ ad krin nam 'bras nad gso rig gi byang 'phel rags brjod/ ༄ (13)le'u gnyis pa/ bod lugs gso ba rig pa'i 'bras nad ngos 'dzin la thog mar khyon yongs nas dpyad pa dang de'i sdom tshig (19)sde tshan gsum pa/ bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/(35)le'u dang po/ bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig la rags tsam dpyad pa dang de'i phyogs sdom/ (35)

2 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigale'u gnyis pa/ gso rig rgyud bzhi las bstan 'bras kyi brjod bya/ (59)le'u gsum pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa dang de'i rang 'grel las 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad/ (65)le'u bzhi ba/ so ma ra dzā las 'bras nad skor gyi rnam bshad/ (78)le'u lnga ba/ zur lugs kyi 'bras nad gso ba'i sman sbyor brgyad/ (81)le'u drug pa/ 'bri gung gces bsdus las 'bras nad kyi brtag bcos/ (86)le'u bdun pa/ kong sprul zin tig las bad mgul dang pho thog gi brtag bcos/ (92)le'u brgyad pa/ de'u dmar ba'i gsungs las mid 'chus kyi sngags bcos sogs/ (100)le'u dgu ba/ man ngag lhan thabs las rma 'bras dang gnyan 'bras kyi lta ba/ (110)le'u bcu ba/ sman bsdus e las 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad/(116)le'u bcu gcig pa/ man ngag bka' rgya las gsungs pa'i 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad/ (123)le'u bcu gnyis pa/ phan bde'i bang mdzod las 'bras nad skor gyi rnam bshad/ (132)le'u bcu gsum pa/ mgo log khams gtsang 'brug rgyal

dkar chag 3 gyi 'bras bcos thun min 'ga'/ (133)le'u bcu bzhi ba/ bon gyi gso rig rgyud 'bum bye ba'i yang snying zhes pa las 'bras nad kyi skor gleng tshul/ (150)le'u bco lnga ba/ 'brong rtse be bum las phyi 'bras kyi bcos thabs zab mo (152)le'u bcu drug pa/ bod yul dmangs khrod kyi 'bras nad bcos thabs/ (162)sde tshan bzhi ba/ deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ (166)le'u dang po/ bzang 'bras dang ngan 'bras/ (167)le'u gnyis pa/ 'brad nad la ming 'dogs tshul/ (169)le'u gsum pa/ 'bras nad snga tsam rtogs thabs/ (171)le'u bzhi ba/ 'bras nad kyis sngon 'gog (173)le'u lnga ba/ 'bras nad kyi brtag bcos/ (175)zur bkod/ (191)

1 sde tshan dang po/ bod kyi gso ba rig par ad krin (lo7)zhes pa'i nad la ngos 'dzin yod med skor gyi mtha' dpyod/de yang 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni deng skabs su nub lugs gso rig pas ad (lo)ces 'bod pa'i nad ngan 'dis lo re la mi 'bor sa ya lnga yas mas kyi srog 'phrog bzhin yod pas 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi 'chi rkyen dang por gyur bas mi chod/ 'brel yod tshan pa'i sdom rtsis ltar na nad ngan 'di na mkhan gyi nad pa da dung lo re bzhin je mang du 'gro bzhin yod pa mtshon/ de na rang cag bod lugs gso rig tu ad (lo)ces pa'i nad 'di la ngos 'dzin tshul yod med dang / yod na ji ltar ngos 'dzin gyi yod pa/ de sgrub byed kyi rgyu mtshan ci yod sogs la lan 'debs dgos pas/ 'dir le'u gsum du dbye nas brjod pa la/le'u dang po/ gzhan lugasamimathun pa dgag pa/spyir deng skabs gso rig smra ba rnams kyi khongs su bod kyi gso rig tu ad (7)ces pa'i nad la ngos 'dzin med par 'dod pa dang

2 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigangos 'dzin yod par 'dod pa bcas lta ba mi mthun pa gnyis don dngos su byung 'dug ste ngos 'dzin med pa'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan de dag gis dpyad rtsom lta bu'i sgo nas rang 'dod de mngon dod dang dmar rjen du gnas skabs su ni sgrog gi med mod/ yin na yang da lta'i rang byung tshan rig skor gyi yig cha dang tshad ldan shan sbyar tshig mdzod thams cad kyi nang du bod kyi gso rig gis ad (7)ces par ngos 'dzin ni lta ci/tha na ched spyod kyi tha snyad tsam yang med pa gzhir bzhag byas te dgos med kyi tha snyad dper na 66ngan skran mi lha 'bras skran mi sogs gsar bzos byas yod/ ngos 'dzin med par 'dod pa'i lta ba 'di ni yongs su 'khrul pa zhig yin rung skabs 'dir btang snyoms su 'jog gsham du rang lugs 'thad ldan 'chad na bye ma'i 'ching bu bzhin rang shugs su 'thor 'gro/ yang bod lugs gso rig tu ad (7)ces pa la ngos 'dzin yod par 'dod pa'i lta ba de la'ang ngos 'dzin byed yul mi 'dra ba gnyis byung yod/ kha cig gis ad (slob)ces pa skran la ngos 'dzin pa dang / kha cig gis khong 'bras la ngos 'dzin byed/ 'dod tshul sngon ma de la khungs yod par ma mthong la/ 'dod tshul phyi ma de rang lugs dang cung mthun na'ang bsam blo'i gu rgya cung zad dog par mthong /ci'i phyir zhe na/ khong 'bras ni lhan skyes rma brgyad kyi ya rgyal gtso bo 'bras kyi bye brag gcig yin phyir/ nub lugs gso rig gas ad (slotho)ces pa bod lugs gso rig gzhung gi 'bras nad spyi la ngos 'dzin byas na shin tu don la gnas pa zhig yin/ thog mar skran du ngos 'dzin pa'i lta ba mi mthun pa'i lugs de dgag pa la/

bod kyi gso rig tu ad krin la ngos 'dzin yod med skor gleng ba/ 3 skran dang ad gnyis bod lugs dang nub lugs so so'i gzhung lugs su brjod pa'i nang don gzhir byas te bsdur na gso dka' sla'i phyogs nas khyad par shin tu che ba ste/ nub lugs su smra ba'i ad ni srog gcod kyi nad ngan zhig yin pas 'tsho nus pa shin tu nyung la/ yang dgos de nyid rnying bar gyur rjes de las kyang gso mi thub par bshad yod/ yin na yang bod lugs gso rig gis smra ba'i skran la gso sla/gso 'bring / gso dka' bcas kyi bye brag yod rung 'tsho mi nus par srog la rgol ba ni bsdong zla'i nad gzhan ma 'grogs na med par bstan 'dug dper na khrag skran lta bu ni spyir btang du gso sla la de nyid rnying par gyur rjes de las kyang gso sla bar bshad rgyud du khrag skran rnying ba gso ba sla zhes bya/ / zhes gsungs yod pa bzhin no/ / 'ga' zhig gi 'dod pa ltar na khrag skran yang nub lugs kyi khrag gi yod (a )la ngos 'dzin pas de yang gso mi nus pa'i nad yin/ ci'i phyir zhes na khrag gi ad la sngon nas da bar phan nus khyad par can gyi gnyen po gang yang ma rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir man ngag rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa gcong chen skran nad bstan pa'i nang skran nad skor zhib phra gsungs yod kyang de'i nang du ad (nub lugs gso rig tu bstan pa'i )kyi gnas lugs dang mthun pa'i rtags zur tsam yang med par snang ngo / /gal te kha shas kyi dgongs pa ltar skran dang ad gnyis gzhi gcig tu bzung na skran yin na ad yin pas khyab dgos pas/ de na skran rigs brgyad las rdo skran chos can/ ad yin par thal/ skran yin

4 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub na/ der thal/ rdo skran ni skran gyi bye brag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / don dngos su rdo skran ni ad ma yin te/ de ni rdo dngos ma yin zhing mtshan nyid rdo ltar sra zhing 'dril ba zhig yin/ de la nub lugs gso rig gis don mthun tha snyad ca'e hri (07)zhes yod cing / ad krin ni nub lugs kyi rnam bshad ltar na mi lus kyi grub cha phra phung ma smin pa dag skyes drags par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/yang na srin skran chos can/ ad ma yin par thal/ de gnyis la gzhi mthun pa'i cha ci yang med pa'i phyir/ skran ni rlung srin mkhris srin bad srin sogs don snod dang sha pags bar na gong bur 'dril nas lus kyi phyi nang la spangs 'bur dod pa yin pa'i phyir/ nub lugs kyi pa'o khrung pin (7yol)zhes pa de yin no/ /'bras skran gyi rigs sam nang gses gzhan dag la'ang gong bzhin rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ad min tshul dang don mthun gyi tha snyad nub lugs gso rig la yod pa rnams re re bzhin sbyar thub rung chu thigs kyis rgya mtsho mtshon pa'i dpe bzhin re zhig 'di tsam gyis chog par bya/ mdor na ad dang skran gzhi gcig tu 'dzin pa'i ltar snang gi lugs 'di ni rgyud bzhi mjug don skabs su de bzhin skran dang khong 'bras brtag bcos 'phrul zhes gsungs pa'i nyen brda'i bslab bya la ma 'dzem par mig ldan g.yang la mchong ba'i mngon tshul kho na'o/ /

bod kyi gso rig tu ad krin la ngos 'dzin yod med skor gleng ba/ 5 le'u gnyisapa/ rang lugs 'thad ldan du bzhag pa/rang lugs su ad ces pa ni bod lugs gso rig tu bstan pa'i 'bras nad la ngos 'dzin byas na shin tu don la gnas par mthong / rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ 'bras nad dang ad gnyis gso dka' ba'i rnam bshad kyi cha nas gcig mthun yin pa/ dper na man ngag rgyud du/khong 'bras smin nas gso bar dka' ba'i phyir/ / smin du mi gzhug gsar dus gso ba sgrim/ / zhes pa 'di dang nub lugs kyis ad ni dang thog phog ma thag gso bar brtson dgos la/ yun lon na gso dka' bas srog la rgol bar 'dod pa'i dgongs pa phyogs yos nas gcig mthun yin/ gzhan yang 'bras nad dang yod gnyis lus kyi gnas rnams la phog tshad mang nyung gi cha nas bod lugs dang nub lugs so so'i gso rig gzhung du 'chad pa gcig mtshungs su song / rgyud chen du phal cher pho long mid pa'i 'brel mtshams mang / / zhes pa nub lugs gso rig gis don dngos su ra sprod byas pa 'di ltar/ ad krin phog tshad las pho ba'i ad kyis dang po zin yod/ rang rgyal du lo rer pho ba'i ad kyi 'chi grangs ni khri bcu drug la slebs yod/yang de min dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gzhan zhig tu rang rgyal gyi grong khyer du pho ba'i ad nad dang grong gseb tu min pa'i ad nad kyis ad

6 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigand yongs kyi phog tshad dang po zin zhes 'khod yod/ gzhan yang man ngag rgyud chen du kha gsal zhing dngos bstan gyi 'bras nad nang gses bye brag re re bzhin nub lugs ad nad kyi dbye ba so sor sbyar na don dang mthun zhing go ba yang dag pa len thub ste/ dper na/ sha 'bras (r+sā༅a//lko)dang/ rus 'bras(6147)/ rtsa 'bras(ṭha )/ glo 'bras(/oṃslom)/ mchin 'bras(skoratshoco)/ mkhal 'bras( rdzoslo1)/ rgyu long 'bras(77)/ gzhang 'bras(ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha )/ lhang 'bras (077)lta bu'o/ /'di bzhin bod lugs gso rig nang gi 'bras nad rigs thams cad re re bzhin mdzub mos ri ston gyi rnam pas nub lugs ad nad la thod gtugs te khungs lung btsan po dang rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i sgo nas re re bzhin shan sbyar go ba 'khrul bral len rgyu yod pa zhig byed nus pa 'dis kyang ra sprod bgyis pa ma yin nam/ de las ldog ste skran rigs brgyad/khrag skran/ mkhris skran/ nyen skran/ rdo skran/ rlung gi lhing skran/ rtsa skran/ chu skran rnams ad nad kyi dbye ba so sor shan sbyar byed thabs bral ba bltas pa tsam gyis mkhyen gsal bzhin no/ / yang na phyogs gzhan zhig gis bsgrub pa ste/ 'bras nad dang ad nad gnyis kyi rigs so so'i nad rtags rang rang gi gzhung na bkod pa rnams me long gzugs brnyan bzhin phan tshun dpyad bsdur btang na/glo 'bras la/ man ngag rgyud du/ glo 'bras min pa na zhing zas mid dka'/ / zhes dang / be+e sngon las de la kha snon du/ glo 'bras mid pa na zhing hril hril byed/ / ces gsungs yod/ nub lugs kyi glo ba'i ad kyi nad rtags ni/ lud pa khrag can 'byung zhing dbugs 'byin

bod kyi gso rig tu ad krin la ngos 'dzin yod med skor gleng ba/ 7 rngub dka' ba dang gzer yod pa/ glo mig nas hril hril gyi sgra 'byin la lus stobs nyams rgud du 'gro ba bcas so/ / gong gsal bod lugs nub lugs gnyis kyi nad rtags rnams re re bzhin dpyad bsdur byas na/nub lugs kyi lud pa khrag can 'byung zhes pa de ltar snang la bod lugs kyi gre 'bras nad rtags su med pa 'dra yang don dam par khong 'bras spyi rtags skabs smin nas gyen thur gnyis kur rnag rdol 'gyur/ / zhes bstan yod pas de gnyis la brjod pa'i nad rtags kyi char mi mthun pa phran tsam yang med ces smra chogamachin 'bras la/ man ngag rgyud du/ mchin 'bras dbugs 'gags mgo 'khor skom dad che/ / zhes dang / be+e sngon las kha snon du mchin stong na zhes 'khod 'dug nub lugs gso rig gi mchin pa'i ad kyi nad rtags mi na yun shin tu thung ste spyir btang zla ba gnyis gsum tsam las 'tsho mi thub pa/ mchin steng na la mchin pa cher rgyas byed pa dang lus skem pa bcas so / / yan lag brgyad par mkhris gyur smin pa myur ba yin/ / zhes pa (nyes gsum gyi khongs su bsdus na mchin 'bras ni mkhris gyur gyi 'bras nad yin )go slar bkrol na na nas yun ring 'tsho mi thub ste myur du smin nas 'chi zhes pa'i don no/ / sman dpyad zla rgyal las/ mchin 'bras me dang mtshon ltar myur ba'o/ / zhes pa'ang de'i don no/ /pho ba'i 'bras la/ man ngag rgyud las pho 'bras lto sbos zos 'khren med pa na/ / gdong ba rkang bol g.yo zhing skrangs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs yod/

8 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riganub lugs kyi pho ba'i ad kyi nad rtags ni grod khog stod sbos pa dang na ba'am mi bde zhing zas la dang ga zhan pa/ nyams stobs shor ba/lus skem la g.yo zhing skrangs pa bcas so/ / yang nub lugs gso rig gis/ pho ba dang rgyu ma 'brel mtshams la byung bas pho ba'i ad nad kyis ad nad yongs kyi 47 18yabazung yod ces bstan pa 'di dang man ngag rgyud du phal cher pho long mid pa'i 'brel mtshams mang / / zhes pa kānyis ma gros gcig mthun du song ba rgyu mtshan med pa gtan nas ma na/ gzhang 'bras la/ man ngag rgyud du/ gzhang 'bras gzhang kha na zhing 'phyen dbugs 'gag ces dang be+e sngon las kha skong la/ bshang ba rnag khrag 'dres pa 'byung / / zhes gsungs yod/ nub lugs su/gzhang lam gyi ad nad ni bshang ba bkag pa'am thengs mang du gyur ba/phog mkhan las bzhi cha gcig tsam gyi bshang ba rnag khrag 'dres pa/gzhang khar na zug drag po gtong zhes bshad 'dugamid pa'i 'bras nad bad kun 'gas dang / mid 'chus/ ske 'ching / gre thogs/ mid 'bras bcas ming gi rnam grangs kyi na lugs kong sprul zin tig tu/ bad kun mgul 'gags sam gre thogs kyi rtags/ brang rgyab dang phrag mig gzer/ brang tsha/ skabs skabs su gre thogs su spu yod pa 'dra ba dang / phreng rdog lta bu yar 'gro mar 'gro byed pa 'byung / bad kun pho thog zas skom khar song tshad yar skyugs nas lus je skem du 'gro ba thams cad kyis shes sla zhing las nad lta bu bcos dka'/ zhes bkod pa 'di gnyis la bsam gzhigs btang na

bod kyi gso rig tu ad krin la ngos 'dzin yod med skor gleng ba/ 9 med 'bras la gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na gre thogs ste gre ba dang pho ba'i 'brel mtshams su byung ba gcig dang / pho thog ste mid pa dang pho ba'i 'brel mtshams su byung ba bcas gnyis su dbye dgos pa gsal bo rtogs thub/ nub lugs gso rig gis kyang mid pa dang gre ba'i 'brel mtshams dang mid pa dang pho ba'i 'brel mtshams ni mid pa'i ad nad kyi 'byung gnas gtso che shos yin zhes gtan khel byas 'dug mid pa'i ad nad kyi rtags kyang 'di ltar bstan 'dug thog mar mid pa mi bde ba'am spu lta bu'i rdzas yod snyam byed pa/ kha zas za skabs phrag mig tu gzer chung gtong ba/ zos rjes grod khog sbos pa/ mid pa bkag ste nyag phra bar gyur ba'i rkyen gyis rim bzhin zas mid dka' ba'am yang na mid mi thub pa/ nad kyi mjug mthar skom kho na yang mid dka' ste chu thigs tsam yang mi thar zas dang pho ba'i be snabs gyen du skyug yong /man ngag rgyud du/ mid 'bras ni bad kun gso ba'i le'ur bsdu ba las 'bras nad kyi le'ur mi 'jog don ni mid 'bras sam bad kun mgul 'gags 'di nyid nad kyi rgyu rkyen na lugs/ phog gnas/ ldang dus/na so bcos thabs sogs phyogs mang po zhig nas bad kun sa chu'i rang bzhin shan shugs che ba de mngon phyir ro/ /

10 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigale'u gsum pa/ 'bras nad dam ad krin tsha grang gang gi phyogs su gtogs par dpyad pa'i chod gtam/gong du brjod pa'i khungs lung de dag gis bod lugs gso rig gis ad krin la ngos 'dzin yod med dang / 'dzin yul/ de'i sgrub byed rgyu mtshan bcas rags tsam brjod tshar bas/ 'o na de'i dgos pa ste bod lugs gso rig gi nad kyi tha snyad dang nub lugs gso rig gi nad ming phan tshun bsdur te thod gtugs pa'i dge sa dang de la dge mtshan ci yod zer na/ spyir deng skabs 'dzam gling du ad krin gyi zhib 'jug la lag len gyi zhib 'jug dang gzhung lugs kyi zhib 'jug bcas gnyis su yod pa las phran gyi dpyad rtsom 'di gzhung lugs zhib 'jug gi khongs su gtogs/ yang dgos 'bras sam ad krin gyi nad la rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs dang rgyal khab mang pos shugs chen gyi sgo nas brtag dbyu da zhib 'jug byed dang byed bzhin yod rung / deng gi dbar nad kyi rgyu dang bcos thabs sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas de'i gsang ba bkrol ma thub la/ de bzhin nad ngan 'di yang skyes bo 'ga' zhig 'khrul snang ltar 6 dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus migang zag gi bsod nams zad pa'i rkyen gyis gsar thon gyi nad rigs shig ma yin par/ bskal ba ya thog gi dus skabs nas bzung yod pa gna' rdzas brtag dpyad thog

bod kyi gso rig tu ad krin la ngos 'dzin yod med skor gleng ba/ 11 nas shes gsal du gyur/yang 'bras nad dam ad krin ni mi'i rigs kho na tsam ma zad srog chags sna tshogs dang rtsi shing gi rigs la'ang byung rgyu yod pa'i nad gzhi zhig yin la/ de ltar du bod lugs gso rig las rta nad gso ba'i sna tshogs dpe cha'i brjod byar rta yi 'bras nad kyi brtag bcos bstan yod pa bzhin no/ / gal te nga tsho bod lugs gso rig gis ad krin zhes par ngos 'dzin yod med dang 'dzin yul tsam gyi thad nas rmongs par gyur na/ ad krin gyi gso bcos dang zhib 'jug ni kha yi rlangs pa tsam du gyur ba ma yin nam/ rang re'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhi rtsa'i dgongs don ltar na/ tsha grang gnyis su ma 'dus nad gzhan med pas/ / 'bras nad dam ad krin 'di nyid kyang tsha grang gang gi phyogs su gtogs pa'i gnad don 'di dpal ldan rgyud bzhir gsal bor 'khod med pas/ phyis 'byung gi rgyud 'grel dang gso dpyad kyi phyag rtsom rnams su'ang rang mal du bzhag pa las tsha grang gang gi khongs su gtogs min la thag gcod ni lta ci/ dogs gzhi tsam yang mdzad mi 'dug pas/ 'bras nad dam ad krin 'di nyid tsha grang gang yin gyi khongs su gtogs dgos pa ni gzhung lugs kyis nad bcos lag len la phyogs ston skabs shin tu mkho gal che ba zhig tu gyur/ de na 'bras nad 'di tsha ba'i nad yin nam grang ba'i nad yin/ yang na de la tsha grang gnyis su phye rgyu yod dam tsha grang thun mong gang yin zer na/ phran gyi lta bar 'bras nad kyi rgyu ni 'grams 'khrugs kha zas dwangs ma ma smin pa/ / zhes pa ltar yin pas rgyu yi sgo nas grang bar gtogs/ na lugs

12 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigakyang byugs lums kun gyis bshig dka' brtan la mkhrang / / sogs gnyen po'i kha na sra phyir bad kun sa chu'i rang bzhin can gyi mtshan nyid lci snum brtan pa mngon gsal yin pas grang bar 'dod pa dang / de bzhin mtshan nyid rno ba'i rkyen gyis tsha nad mang che ba ni 'gos phog rang bzhin can gyi nad yin rung / 'bras nad la 'gos phog gi rang bzhin med pas grang bar gtogs/ yang gnas kyi sgo nas 'bras nad phal cher pho long mid pa'i 'brel mtshams mang zhes brjod pa ltar na pho long mid pa dang de rnams kyi 'brel mtshams ni bad rlung gi gnas yin phyir 'bras nad 'di nyid grang bar ngos 'dzin pa dang / dmigs bsal du mchin pa dang snod mkhris/ khrag sogs mkhris pa'i yul yin pas de dag la 'bras nad byung na tsha ba'i cha nges can zhig med pa ma yin rung /khyon yongs nas gzhigs na 'bras nad spyi ni tsha ba'i khongs su mi gtogs la/ de la tsha grang gi dbye ba 'byed rgyu'ang med/ gzhi rtsa'i phyogs nas grang ba'i khongs su 'du bar 'dod pa rang lugs yin/mdor na/ rang re'i ad krin nam 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad lta bu cung zad 'thus sgo tshang la kha gsal zhing rnam grangs phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta bu ni rgyun srol gso rig gzhan gyi lta ci smos/ deng skabs dar rgyas che shos yin pa'i nub lugs gso rig gi mdun nas ngo gnong mi dgos par snang / rang rgyal gyi krung lugs gso rig la mtshon na ad krin la ngos 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa gor ma chag kyang bcings 'grol sngon du gcig gyur dang ched spyod nad ming ma grub la de'i skor gyi gzhung lugs 'thus tshang zhig ni de las kyang ma byung ba sha stag go /

13 sde tshan gnyis pa/ 'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/le'u dang po/ ad krin nam 'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel rags brjod/'bras nad gso rig ni rims tshad sogs kyi rig tshan bzhin ljang bu 'bus pa kyang snga mo red de/ de'i 'phel rgyas ni ha cang dal ba yin/nga tshos mi'i rigs kyi shes rig 'phel rgyas kyi brgyud lam la phyi mig cig gzigs tshe shin tu gsal ba zhig ni/ gdod ma'i shes rig ldan pa'i mi rigs thams cad kyi khrod du yi ge byung ba nas bzung 'bras nad la ngos 'dzin gyi zin tho mthong rgyu yod/ dper na/ lo sum stong lnga brgya'i snga rol gyi rgya nag gi rus sbal gyi rus pa'i steng gi yi ge khongs su 'bras zhes pa'i tha snyad mchis la/de'i rjes kyi sman gzhung chen mo 〈nas cin 〉du 'bras nad kyi rgyu dang nad brtag bcos thabs sogs mdor bsdus tsam bstan yod/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i skabs kyi rgya gar dang / spyi lo sngon

14 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigagyi dus rabs bco lnga ba'i skabs kyi gna' bo'i e cib/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs lnga ba'i skabs kyi zhi lā sogs kyis kyang yig thog nas 'bras nad la ngos 'dzin 'dug pas gong gsal lo rgyus de dag gis 'bras nad ni nye dus gsar du byung ba'am/ ngos zin thob pa'i nad gzhi zhig gtan nas ma yin par gna' snga mo'i dus nas yod pa'i nad rigs shig yin par ra sprod byed thub/ de bzhin rang re'i bod la bshad na'ang spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gsum pa'i nang mdzad par grags pa'i zhang zhung bon gyi 'bum dkar nag khra gsum du 'bras nad sogs nad rigs du ma'i tha snyad mchis/ spyir 'bras nad ni 'dzam gling gi yul gru so sor khyab yod mod/ 'on kyang 'bras nad kha shas 'dzam gling yongs la khyab yod la/ kha shas ni sa gnas 'gar phog tshad shin tu mtho ste/ dper na/glo 'bras dang pho 'bras/ nu 'bras bcas ni 'dzam gling gi sa gnas so sor khyab tshad ha cang rgya che la/ yang na mid pa'i 'bras nad ni sa gnas khag gsum la phog tshad cung mtho tsam 'dug gcig shos ni rang rgyal gyi hwa pe (416)dang gcig shos ni ya gling dkyil ma'i mtsho rgyud dang /da dung gcig ni h+phe gling lho phyogs kyi sa cha khag cig yin/ sna 'bras rgyal khab mang che bar phog tshad shin tu dma' rung / ya gling shar lho'i sa ཿkālda dang rang rgyal gyi hwa nan (lha )sa khul rnams su cung tshabs chen bod kyi sa khul rnams su sna 'bras byung tshad cung mtho bas phal cher sna tha 'then pa dang 'brel ba che bar 'dod pas shes ldan rnams pas brtag dpyad 'tshal/

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 15 'dzam gling 'phrod bsten rtsa 'dzugs kyi tshod dpag ltar na/'dzam gling yongs la lo rer mi 'bor khri 500yan tsam 'bras nad kyis 'chi bzhin yod pas mi'i 'chi 'bor grangs tshad kyi rgya cha mtho shos su slebs kyi yod la 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi tshe srog dang bde thang thad la gnod pa tshabs chen gtong bzhin yod/'dzam gling gi rgyal khab khag las 'bras nad kyi 'chi 'bor che shos ni 'jar man gyi rgyal sa po lin (77)yin te/ lo rer mi 353 6pobre 16te 'bum tshad las lo rer 353 6'bras nad kyis 'chi bzhin yod/o si khru ri yar (ma lko/)262dzakhri 10dang / su'u ko lan la ( d+mocha༅)242 841 10/ dbyin jir 236 5810 / rgyal khab mang che bar 100 —200dzakhri 10yi dbar yin/ krung go'i 'bras nad kyi 'chi 'bor ni ha lam lo rer 90— 100dzakhri 10'chi bzhin yod/ rgyal khab mi nyung ba zhig la 'bras nad kyi 'chi 'bor gyis mi'i 'chi 'bor yongs kyi 175yas mas bzung yod/ don gnas gnas tshul de'i 'og rang rgyal du rgyal yongs rang bzhin can gyi 'bras nad 'gog bcos kyi dra ba chags bzhin yod la/ rgyal spyi'i thog tu'ang 'bras nad 'gog bcos kyi rig gzhung spel res kyi bya bzhag la 'khrug cha ha cang chen po yod/dper na/ 1978lo'i zla 10bar a ken thin (༅༅༅)nas tshogs pa'i thengs bcu pa'i rgyal spyi'i 'bras nad rig pa'i tshogs 'du ni de sngon gyi thengs gang rung las kyang rgya che ba dang mi grangs 'bor chen du gyur yod de/ rgyal khab 77lhag tsam gyi sku tshab 8189tshogs 'dur zhugs pa dang / dpyad rtsom 2000lhag 'byor/ 1982lo'i zla 9bar a ri'i zhi yā

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 17 nad khams gso rig mkhas can gyis lo ngo dung phyur gnyis kyi skabs su gnas pa'i srog chags chen po khon 'brug (ṣ+ṭha༅)gi 'gyur rdo'i steng nas de la 'bras nad phog myong ba'i rjes shul rnyed yod la/ yang rtsi shing gi rigs ste la phug la ser bas rmas skyon phog pa rdeng me rtog ma la ka la 'khyags pas thebs pa/ sngo kun lan gin (747)la gnyan kha rgyas pa bcas kyi rkyen pas de dag la 'bras nad byung rgyu yod pa 'di dag gis kyang 'bras nad ni srog chags tsam ma zad srog med kyi skye dngos la'ang byung nus pa ra sprod byed thub/ yang dgos su srog chags la 'bras nad skyes pa ni de las kyang rgyun mthong zhig yin te/ nya rigs la 'gro ba mi dang gcig 'dra'i 'bras nad mang po byung rgyu yod de/ dper na sbal gzig gi nang du 2 75la mkhal ma'i 'bras nad kyis bzung yod/ bya rigs kyi khongs su de pho'i 'bras nad phog tshad mtho shos slobs yod de/phal cher 10—205dbar gyi de pho la 'bras nad phog yod la da dung mang che ba ni ngan 'bras yin/ 'o 'thung srog chags ni 'bras nad phog tshad mtho shos kyi srog chags yin/ mi'i 'bras nad mang che ba dud 'gro la'ang byung rgyu yod pas/ nor dang / rta/ phag khyi/ byi la sogs ni 'bras nad phog tshad mtho gras su slebs/ bod lugs gso rig gi rta'i gso dpyad skor gyi gzhung mang por rta'i 'bras nad la ngos 'dzin yod par ma zad/ de'i rgyu rkyen brtag bcos sogs ched du le tshan dbye nas bstan yod phyir/ nga tsho'i mes po rnams kyis gna' snga mo nas bzung mi tsam la ma zad srog chags gzhan la'ang 'bras nad phog rgyu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal bo rtogs yod pa mtshon thub pas/ 'di ni 'dzam gling

18 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigasteng gi chas snga shos kyi srog chags 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad yin phyir 'bras nad rig pa'i byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus steng gi nam yang sub mi thub pa'i mdzad 'phrin gyi rdo ring zhig go/'gro ba mi'i 'bras nad kyi lo rgyus ni gna' bo'i e cib kyi dmar gdung gi dus skabs nas rnyed thub yod la/ dmar gdung gi rus sgrom steng nas 'bras nad kyi rjes shul rnyed yod/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi bar pho 'bras dang mngal 'bras kyi yi ge'i zin tho 'khod 'dugagana' bo'i zhi la dus rabs kyi sman dpyad mkhas can pa zhi po kho lā tis (lkoṣ+ṭha༅7'a )kyis thog mar 'bras zhes pa'i yi ge spyad de lus la zhen pa dang srog la nyen kha byed pa'i skrangs thog mtshon par byas/ rgya rigs kyi ches thog ma'i 'bras nad kyi ngos 'dzin ni rus bskos yi ge yin/'on te 'bras nad kyi khyab khongs dang dbye ba nges tshig gi thad kha gsal dkon pas/ me dpal dang gzhang 'brum sur ya sogs dang gcig tu 'dod pa'am bsres 'dug bod kyi gso rig la dpyad bu khri shes kyis bcoms par grags pa'i gso dpyad kyi 'bum dkar nag khra gsum du ches thog mar 'bras nad kyi tha snyad byung ba ma gtogs de'i sngon gyi yig cha mjal rgyu shin tu dkon/ nub lugs sam deng rabs gso rig gis 'bras nad la zhib 'jug ni dus rabs bcu dgu bar dbu tshugs pa dang nang sgos su 1960lo nas bzung 'bras skrangs kyi rgyu rkyen dang gso bcos/sngon 'gog bcas tshan rig zhib 'jug rgya cher spel mthar 'bras nad kyi sngon 'gog 'gyur ldog chen po 'byung yod/

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 19 le'u gnyisapa/ bod lugs gsob rig pa'i 'bras nad ngos 'dzin la thog mar khyon yongasanas dpyad pa dang de'i sdom tshigadang po/ bod lugasagasorig gi 'brasand ngosa'adzin gyi byung 'phelashin tubasdusapa/bod kyi gso rig ni 'dzam gling sman dpyad rig pa'i khrod kyi ches rin thang ldan pa'i shul bzhag dang / bod mi dmangs kyis nad rigs la yun ring rgol ba'i shes rab kyi snying khrag yin/ de la gzhung lugs kyi ma lag grub pa yod pas mi tshad/ 'thus sgo tshang zhing brjod bya phun sum tshogs pa'i gso rig gi grub cha zhig tu 'gyur/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi gzi byin rab tu 'bar ba'i shes rig zhig kyang red/ de ni bod mi'i khrod shin tu mtho ba'i mtshan snyan yod pa ma zad/ da dung rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan pa'i khrod nyin re bzhin du dga' mos dang do snang thob bzhin yod/ spyir lo rgyus yun ring 'dzoms pa'i bod kyi yi ge'i nang gna' snga mo nas bzung 'bras nad la lo ngo stong phrag 'ga'i snga rol zhang zhung shes rig skabs nas bzung 'bras nad dang phyogs mtshungs nad rigs kyi zin tho yod pa dper na g.yung drung bon gyi bstan bcos chen mo klu 'bum dkar nag khra gsum du 'bras nad dang de min nad rigs

20 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigamang po khag cig gi tha snyad bkod 'dug gzhan tung hong gter yig nang bkod pa ltar bod thu stod skabs kyi blon chen mgar stong btsan yang 'bras nad kyis sku bkrongs pa'i lo rgyus bkod pa 'di ltar/stag gi lo la bab ste (666)lo blon chen stong btsan 'a zha yul nas slar 'khor te zin mda' thong myig byang bar lo gcig (thong myag ni mid 'bras kyi na tsha yin/) yos bu'i lo la (667)btsan po 'or rmong du gshegs te blon chen stong btsan rus pur gum par lo gcig ces dang /ma mtha' rtsom rigs brtsams chos ge ser rgyal bo'i sgrung tshogs sogs su'ang 'bras 'dul sman rdzas mi nyung ba zhig bkod yod pas/ de na skabs de'i bod mis 'bras nad la thog ma'i ngos 'dzin dang gzhan yang 'bras nad 'gog bcos kyi nyams myong nges can zhig bsog yod pa mngon par gsal/da yod bod kyi gso rig gi bstan bcos snga shos su brtsi ba'i sman dpyad zla rgyal du/ 'bras nad thog ma'i rigs dang dbye 'byed kyi gsal bshad dang / de min da dung 'bras 'dul zhes pa'i bcos thabs kyi gnas lugs phyogs sdom cung legs po mdzad 'dug de'i rjes kyi bod sman mkhas can rnams kyis kyang rgyun mi chad par zhib 'jug dang 'phel rgyas btang yod/ bod kyi gso rig gi thog ma'i sman dpyad kyi kun 'dus chen mo gso rig rgyud bzhi dang dus rabs rim byon gyi mkhas dbang dag gi bcoms chos su gna' bo'i bod mis 'bras nad la rgol ba'i nyams myong gi zin tho phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ de na nga tshos spobs sems chen po'i sgo nas 'di ltar brjod chog ste/ dus der

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 21 bod kyi gso rig gis 'bras nad la ngos 'dzin cung tsam cha tshang ba'i gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhi grub yod mod/ 'on kyang rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis da lta ni/ lag len ches snga shos yin pa'i 〈'bras 'dul〉bcos thabs la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gso tshul rtsa don rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas bya ma thub par nyams yod/ mdor na/ lo rgyus kyi dus bkag dbang gis bod kyi gso rig la deng rabs gso rig ltar gyi 'bras nad rig tshan zhig rang btsan du grub ma thub rung / 'on te gso rig rgyud bzhi bton pa nas bzung rim gyis cung tsam gcig gyur gyi nad ming dang gso bcos lag len bcas la rin thang 'dzoms pa'i 'bras nad dbye tshul dang rig pa'i gzhung lugs zhig grub zin pas gsham du de dag re re la dpyad na 'di ltar ste/gnyisapa/ bod lugasagasorig gi 'brasand kyi rgyu rkyen skor gyi ngosa'adzin ladapyad pa/snyan grags che ba'i bod sman mkhas can stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis gso ba rig pa'i ming tshig 'ga' zhig gi don gyi bzhin ras gsal bar ston pa'i me long las/ 'grams 'khrugs dwangs ma ma smin pas/ / khrag ngan rgyas te rtsa mig byer/ / rlung gis bsgril nas be 'bras ltar/ / sra zhing mkhregs gyur 'bras zhes bshad/ / ces 'bras nad kyi nad rgyu'am gzugs khams kyi nad rigs mtha' dag ji bzhin rlung mkhris bad kun gsum las mi 'da' ste/ de gsum rang rang gi grub tshul mtshan nyid rlung gi mtshan nyid rtsub yang grang phra sra g.yo

22 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadang / mkhris pa ni snum rno tsha yang dri ma mnam 'khru gsher dang / bad kun snum bsil lci rtul 'jam 'byar bag can bcas kyi rgyud rim 'gul skyod rgyun ldan gyi ldang tshad dang 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum gyi rkyen 'byung ste kha zas kyis dngas bcud khrag lam brgyud zungs khrag tu ma gyur ba (bod sman skyes khams rig pa ltar na rgyun ldan gyi gnas tshul 'og kha zas kyis dwangs ma gso/ dngas mas khrag gso/ khrag gis sha gso/ shas tshil gso/ tshil gyis dus pa gso/ rus pas rkang mar gso/) ngan khrag tu gyur ba'am de'i gsos su song ste khrag rtsa brgyud lus kyi phung grub so sor khyab skabs rkyen 'dzoms pa'i gnas su rlung gi grub tshul gyi mtshan nyid yang rtsub sra phra grang bcas kyi log pa'i byed las kyi sra mkhregs zhu dka'i dngos gzugs su bsgyur ba yin la/ de 'dra'i be 'bras 'dra ba'i skrangs rdog la bod lugs gso rig gi 'bras zhes brjod/ yi ge'i nang don ni snying po can gyi rdog gzugs la go 'gro yang / gang ltar de ni deng dus nub lugs gso rig nas smra ba'i ad krin zhes pa de yin pas/ des na 'di ltar brjod chog ste bod kyi gso rig gi 'bras nad kyi slong rkyen ni rlung mkhris bad kun gyi byed las 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum las byung ba dang /khyad par slong rkyen ni rlung gi byed las log pas (ngan khrag ) phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yin no / /gsumapa/ bod lugasagasorig gi 'brasand dbye tshuladang brtag bcosabyed thabasasogasaladapyad pa/bod lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad dbye 'byed thad gcig gyur

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 23 min pa'i gnas kha shas mchis rung / khyon yongs nas gzhigs na gcig mthun du song yod de/ gso rig rgyud bzhi ltar na dbye tshul gtso bo gnyis mchis te rgyu'i sgo nas dbye thabs dang nad gzhi'i sgo nas dbye thabs gnyis so/ /1 nad rgyu'i sgo nas dbye na/ de rigs rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang / / mtshon dang bye 'bras dbye ba bco brgyad bshad/ //sa gso rig rgyud bzhi'i nang tshan man ngag rgyud du gsungs yod pa ltar 2 nad gzhi'i gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyud bzhi las 'bras nad brtag bcos le'ur/ gnas kyi dbye na phyi 'bras nang 'bras gnyis/ / phyi 'bras sha rus rtsa yi 'bras dang gsum/ / nang 'bras glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma dang / / pho ba rgyu long gzhang dang ldang ba dgu/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / phyi 'bras zhes pa ni don dngos su deng dus gso rig nas bshad pa'i 'bras gtso bo byang khog stod smad dang don snod kyi 'bras la go dgos/rtsa 'bras ni khrag rtsa'i 'bras nad dang dbang rtsa'i 'bras nad/men bu'i 'bras nad bcas yin no/ /2 bod lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad kyi nad rtags ngos 'dzin la dpyad pa/ mtha' yas pa'i bod kyi gso rig gi yig tshags sna tshogs su 'bras nad rigs kyi brtag bcos sogs mang po zhig gsungs yod de gso rig rgyud bzhir dpe bzhag na man ngag rgyud du gsungs par/ phyi 'bras spyi rtags rtsa rgyud phra la 'dar/ / skrangs pa sra brtan na zug chung

24 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigab la/ / lums 'dul kun gyi zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang de bzhin sra ba'i phung grub kyi 'bras nad la ngos 'dzin/ rus 'bras rus pa mdog 'gyur rtsi nyams zos/ / rnag chu sro ma khu tshigs 'byung ba yin/ / zhes dang sman dpyad zla rgyal du da dung gom gang mdun spos kyis rus 'bras kyi phyogs bsdoms brgyab par/ mus 'gram sna dus 'phang lor 'byung ba mang / / zhes gong bkod de dag gis snyi ba'i phung grub kyi 'bras nad la brjod pa de dag kyang lus kyi phyi ngos kyi 'bras skrangs kyi 'phel rgyas chos nyid de nad thog nad rtags dang rbad de gcig mthun zhig red/ snyi ba'i phung grub kyi 'bras skrangs la ngos 'dzin/khyad par sha 'bras nyung gsher 'khyags pa 'dra/ / zhes dang /khrag rtsa dang 'bras spangs kyi ngos 'dzin/ rtsa 'bras rtsa steng skrangs shing 'khyugs la 'phro/ zhes dang rtsa 'bras phog sla ba'i gnas ni sman dpyad zla rgyal du rtsa 'bras rtsa dang nye bar skrangs/ phal cher ske dang yan lagasho zhes dang rtsa 'bras la'ang dbye ba gnyis su phye yod de/ ston zla bzhin du 'phro ba dang / rtsa 'bras sha sha men bu 'dra zhes bshad pa'i gcig shos ni khrag rtsa'i 'bras skrangs dang / gcig shos ni dbang rtsa'i 'bras skrangs yin/ man rgyud 'bras nad kyi brtag bcos le'ur da dung lus kyi phyi ngos kyi 'bras skrangs sna tshogs kyi gso bcos dka' sla'i skor dang de dag gnad steng byung na gso ba dka' zhes par dpyad na skabs der bod kyi gso rig gis 'bras skrangs kyis lus khams dang tshe srog la 'tshe ba'i rang bzhin de la ngos 'dzin gsal bor thob yod ces smras chog par 'dod/

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 25 bzhi ba/ lusakhamasakyi 'brasaskrangasarigasalangosa'adzin/khong 'bras skran ltar reg pa sra ba'am/ / mi mngon gting nub zas la 'khyen pa ste/ / smin nas gyen thur gnyis kur rnag rdol 'gyur/skran zhes pa ni bod kyi gso rig gis 'bu srin gyi skran dang rdo skran/ rnag skran/ khrag skran sogs skran nad rigs brgyad kyi spyi ming yin/ skran nad ces pa yang 'bras skrangs la go ba len mkhan yod mod kyang / lta ba de ni nor 'dzol zhig yin pa smos ma dgos/ zhib phra gso rig rgyud bzhi'i nang tshan bshad rgyud du skran gyi dbye ba rnams la gzigs na mkhyen pas 'dir mi bshad/byang khog gi 'bras nad mang che ba nad mjug tu slebs nas smin skabs ngan khrag gyen du skyug pa dang thur du bshal ba sogs kyi nad rtags 'byung la/ khyad par du lus kyi phyi ngos kyi 'bras nad dang bsdur tshe/ lag pas reg skabs skrangs rdog gi mtha' mtshams mi gsal ba dang kha zas kyi dang ga mngon gsal je zhan du 'gro ba rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ / gzhan yang sman dpyad yan lag brgyad par 'bras skrangs nad rtags mang che ba la skrangs pa sra mkhregs dang g.yo 'gul dka' ba/ spangs ngos mtho dman mi snyoms pa/ mchin pa dang snod mkhris/ gsher rmen bcas kyi 'bras nad kyi nad 'gyur gzugs khams tshe srog la gnod 'tshe rang bzhin sogs kun la rnag thog btsag 'khel gyi rnam bshad gnang yod pa ste/ dper na/ nang ni (byang khog nang gi 'bras nad de khong 'bras) shin tu mi bzod cing / sra mkhregs

26 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigagating zab skran dang mtshungs/ / grogs mkhar lta bu mtho ba dang / me dang mtshon ltar myur ba'o/ / zhes me dang mtshon chas 'bras nad kyi zug rngu drag po dang lus srog la gnod 'tshe'i rang bzhin dang na yun ring thung la dpe 'jog pa ni shin tu nas 'os 'tshams zhig yin no/ / gong gsal nad rtags rnams kha gsal ba tsam ma zad khong 'bras kyi nad thog nad rtags dang shin tu mthun/1 glo 'bras kyi ngos 'dzin/ glo 'bras mid pa spangs la zas mid dka'/ / zhes dang rgyud 'grel be+e sngon gyis nad thog lag len dang zung 'brel gyis kha snon rgyab par/ dbugs 'byin dka' la hur sgra mchis/zhes pa 'di dang rgyal spyi'i 'bras 'gog mnyam tshogs kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i glo 'bras kyi nad rtags gtso che ba bdun (khrag skyugs pa/ glo lud pa/ dbugs 'byin rngub dka' ba/ glo tshad rgyas pa/ na zug gtong ba/ dbugs 'tshangs pa/ lus lci ba)las dbugs 'tshang ba dang dbugs 'byin dka' ba ni be+e sngon gyi kha snon du gsal ba dang / khrag skyug pa dang lus khams lci ba rnams gong gi khong 'bras spyi rtags skabs bstan zin/ yang 'ga' zhig gis gso rig rgyud bzhi'i nang gsung ba'i glo 'bras mid skrangs zas mid dka' zhes pa la dpyad pa btang nas/bod lugs gso rig gis glo ba'i 'bras nad dang mid pa'i 'bras nad la tha snyad thog nas dbye 'byed gsal bo med ces brjod kyi yod rung /don dngos su glo ba'i 'bras skrangs glo yu'i dbugs lam la mched pa dang de la gnon shugs thebs skabs mid pa na ba dang / zas lam la gnon shugs thebs nas zas mid dka' bar 'gyur ba'i nad rtags ston

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 27 no/ /2 mchin 'bras kyi ngos 'dzin/ man ngag rgyud du mchin 'bras dbugs 'gag mgo 'khor skom dad che zhes pa de la be+e sngon gyis kha snon du mchan steng na zhes gsungs yod/ bod lugs gso rig gi nyes gsum rig pa ltar na/ mchin pa ni nyes pa mkhris pa'i khongs gtogs yin/ de'i rkyen pas nad kyi gnas dang dbye ba'i sgo nas btags pa'i mchin 'bras 'di nyes pa'i sgo nas mkhris 'bras yin/ sman dpyad yan lag brgyad par/ mkhris 'bras rtsa mdog zangs ltar dmar/ / skom che tshad par 'khrul bar byed/ / gnod rkyen che la smin par myur/ /skabs 'dir brjod pa'i khrag rtsa zangs ltar dmar zhes pa don dngos su 'bras skrangs kyis 'phar rtsa la btsir gnon thebs pas lto ngos kyi sdod rtsa khros pa la go ba len dgos snyam/ / mchin 'bras kyi nang rkyen la/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus par/ / rgyu ni snum rnying chang rag go / zhes pa'i snum rnying ni rul skyon can gyi snum ldan zas rigs la go dgos(r+sār+sātsho chos)/ de na bod kyi gso rig la rang byung tshan rig phyogs kyi bkag rgyu'i rkyen gyis (r+sār+sār+sār+sā)zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di bton med la yang bton mi thub pa zhig tu gyur yang / 'on te dus yun ring bor mchin 'bras kyi nad pa la gso bcos dang / rtogs zhib khrod chang rgod dang snum rnying rul bas mchin 'bras slong ba'i gnas lugs la ngos zin dang phyogs sdom nges can zhig yod pa 'di dus skabs de la ltos nas bshad na/ dngos gnas las sla bo zhig gtan nas ma yin/2 pho 'bras kyi ngos 'dzin/ pho 'bras sbo zhing yid 'chus mid pa

28 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigan/ pho 'bras dang thog gsar ba'i dus 'ju byed lam gyi nad rtags gtso bor mngon pas/ / lag len du pho ba'i gnyan tshad dang pho ba'i rma sha la gnon rkyen che ba dang yid 'chus zhes pa ni pho 'bras kyi mtha' mjug gi nad rtags kha zas mi 'dod pa/ zhe mer langs pa/ khyad par du pho sgo'i 'bras nad kyi rkyen pas zas mid dka' ba dang / pho ba'i zar+shas tshags 'bras nad kyi nad rtags de rkyen du skyugs pa sogs la go da sa/4 mkhal 'bras kyi ngos 'dzin/ mkhal 'bras gcin sri mang zhing mkhal rked na/5 rgyu 'bras kyi ngos 'dzin/ rgyu long zhu rjes na la 'khru skyugs byed/ / gdong ba rkang bol g.yo zhing skrangs par 'gyur/ / nad thog lag len yang bshang ba gtong skabs byang khog smad du ha cang lci ba'i na zug ldang dub rang bzhin gyi gzer che/ yang dgos su 66'khru zhing mi ste ha lam rgyu 'bras kyi nad pa'i bzhi cha gsum la bshang ba gtong tshul gyi goms srol la 'gyur ldog byung /6 gzhang 'bras kyi ngos 'dzin/ gzhang 'bras ni gzhang kha na zhing 'og rlung 'gags/ / phyin dbugs 'gags zhes pa ni nub lugs gso rig gis smra ba'i gzhang 'bras kyi nad rtags rgyu 'gags dang 'dra mtshungs su 'dod/krung nub zung 'brel gyis ad krin bcos thabs zhes pa'i dpe deb du bkod pa ltar na/ phal cher bzhi cha gcig tsam gyi gzhang 'bras nad pa'i bshang par rnag khrag 'dres pa'am khrag 'khru bas/ de na bod

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 29 lugs gso rig gi gzhang 'bras nad rtags ni nad thog lag len dngos kyi tshod bgam brgal thub pa zhig yin/7 lhang ba'i 'bras nad kyi ngos 'dzin/ man ngag rgyud du lhang 'bras chu 'gags zug che chu so na/ zhes dang / nub lugs gso dpyad kyi dgongs par/ lhang 'bras ni 'bras spangs phung grub kyis gcin lam 'gags phyir/ gcin 'gags pa dang na zug gtong ba/ gcin khrag 'byung ba la dpyi rked na ba bcas kyi rtags thon par 'dod/〈 zas lam 'bras nad kyi ngos 'dzin/ khor yug dang srol rgyun bza' btung gi goms srol rkyen pas/ mid 'bras sam zas lam 'bras kyi nad 'di bod yul du phog tshad cung zad mtho bas/ bod mis mid 'bras la yun ring 'thab rtsod byas pa'i khrod de la ngos 'dzin gting zab mo dang gso bcos nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa zhig bsogs yod/de dang bod lugs gso rig gis mi lus kyi cha shas gzhan dag gi 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad dang bsdur na/ mngon sum gyis cha tshang la gting zab pa dang kha gsal zhing don dngos dang yongs su mthun pa'i khyad chos ldan/ 'dir bod lugs gso rig gi bstan bcos su mchis pa'i mid 'bras kyi gnad lugs kyis brjod bya drangs na/ gso rig rgyud bzhi'i nang tshan man ngag rgyud kyi le'u gsum par/ bad kun mgul 'gags (mid 'bras dang pho sgo'i 'bras nad kyi spyi ming )zhes bya ba pho ba dang / brang dang glo bar bad kun rgyas pa yis/ / bad kun rlangs pa glo yu mid pa chags/ / dper na dong ba'i logs la zo chags 'dra/ / des rkyen med pa 'chus nas zas mid dka'/ / dbugs rngub mi shes sha skem lus

30 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigastobs 'chor/ / zas skom med pas pho ba cha nas rub/ / mjug tu mid pa 'gags nas 'chi ba yin/ / gong gsal nad rtags la gzhigs na bod kyi gso rig gis smra ba'i bad kun mgul 'gags kyi khongs su pho ba dang glo yu'i 'bras nad kha shas 'dus yod pa bshad ci smos/ yang sog po'i blo bzang chos 'phel gyis brtsams pa'i gso rig gces bsdus snying nor du/ nad 'di (mida'abras)yi rkyen ni gyen rgyu'i rlung gi byed las log pas/ pho ba dang nyen sna'i 'og gi bad kun be snabs 'phel bas/bad kun rlangs pa glo yu dang mid pa'i nang ldebs su chags pas/ thog ma'i dus nas glo yu dang mid pa tsha bsreg gis bkag snyam byed/ rim gyis kha zas mid dka' ba/ zos ma thag tu skyug pa/ mid par 'gags snang 'char ba/ mjug mthar kha zas mid mi thub pas 'chi bar byed/ces pa dang / gzhan yang kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i zin tig gces bsdus su/ bad kun mgul 'gags sam gre thogs gi nad rtags ni/brang rgyab dang phrag mig tu gzer langs pa/ brang tsha/ skabs su gre ba dang mid pa dang lce thog tu spu yod pa 'dra ba dang / phreng rdog lta bu yar 'gro mar 'gro byed pa 'byung / rgyud du dbye ba bco brgyad tsam gsungs kyang bsdu na tsha 'gags grang 'gags gnyis su 'du ba las/ tsha 'gags zug shin tu che/ rtsa cung zad grims/ chu mdog ser/ grang 'gags zug gzer chung / rtsa stong zhing lhod/ chu mdog sngo/ mar babs nas lhen dang pho bar 'dril na pho thog ces bya/ zas tsam yib/sha thun rul ba/ rgyu khrag ma smin pa'i rigs thams cad shin tu gnod cing khyad par lug sha rnying pa zos na bcos su med pas rtag tu spang /

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 31 gre thogs dang pho thog gnyis kur tshig hrog gi rigs/ ja snum tshig song ba/ gyong po'i rigs rnams dang / phor grib gos grib sogs grib rigs shin tu 'dzem pa gal che/gong du bkod pa'i yig cha'i brjod bya de dag gis mid pa'i 'bras nad kyi rgyu rkyen dang nad rtags/ 'dzem bya bcas la cung kha gsal ba'i ༵༵ hā ༵༵da yod pas/ don gnyer can gyi shes ldan rnam par 'jug lnga ba/ bod lugasagasorig gi 'brasaspangasagasobacosakyi rnamabashad ladapyad pa/bod kyi gso rig gis gna' nas bzung 'bras skrangs khag gcig gso dka'i nad ngan du rtsis rung / 'on kyang / 'bras nad kyi gnod 'tshe yi mdun du lag rdum brag la 'dzeg pa ltar thabs shes ci yang med pa zhig lar nas ma yin/ lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i gangs can ljongs kyi gso rig bstan bcos mang po zhig gi nang 'bras nad gso bcos kyi nyams myong zin tho 'khod 'dugakun hong nas byung ba'i bod sman gyi yig cha kho nar khag gsum du yi ge 362kyis mid pa'i 'bras skrangs dang / bud med kyi 'bras nad kyi brtag dang bcos dang 'bras 'gog sman rdzas sogs 'khod 'dugayang gso rig rgyud bzhir 'bras rigs sna tshogs gso bcos byed stangs shin tu phun sum tshogs pa yod/ dper na/ 'bras nad kyi thog ma'i dus kyi 'du thabs dang / bar ma'i dus kyi bar skyon bsal thabs tha

32 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigama'i dus kyi kha zas bsten thabs/ gzhan yang gzugs khams kyi phung grub so so'i 'bras nad la dmigs pa'i me btsa'i thabs dang rnag phug 'jibs 'then bcad 'byor gyi bcos thabs/ rus pa thud thabs dang rus pa gcod thabs/ lcags tel gyis bsreg thabs sogs yod/'bras nad kyi gso bcos dngos kyi khrod gso rig rgyud bzhir 'bras spangs gsar ba'i dus gso bcos byed pa gtso gnad du 'dzin/dper na/ khong 'bras smin nas gso bar dka' ba'i phyir/ / smin du mi gzhug gsar dus gso ba sgrim/ / zhes pa bod lugs gso rig gis sngon nas bzung 'bras nad gsar ba'i dus kyi gso bcos ni shin tu gal 'gangs chen po yin par ngos 'dzin thob yod/ gal srid nad stobs 'phel te 'bras nad kyi phra phung rnams smin nas rtsa brgyud lus khams yongs la byer zhing khyab tshad rnying ba'i dus sam smin pa'i dus la slebs na/ sman bcos phan 'bras ni ha cang dman pa zhig yin/bod lugs gso rig gi lta bar/ nyes gsum rig pa'i sgo nas brjod na/ 'bras spangs kyi gso bcos kyang nyes gsum so so'i mtshan nyid dam rang rang gi ldang tshad la gnas dgos/ rtsa don 'di ni ci ltar gyur kyang gnas gang zhig dang rigs gang gi 'bras nad/ mi'i rang bzhin bdun gang gi 'bras nad yin rung / gso bcos kyi rtsa don gcig mtshungs yin/ gnas mi gcig pa/ phung grub mi 'dra ba/ don snod so so rang bzhin mi mthun pa bod lugs gso rig nas smras pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rang bzhin mi 'dra ba bdun po'i 'bras skrangs bcos thabs la rang rang gi khyad chos dang dbye ba chen po yod par 'dod/ yang sgos

'bras nad gso rig gi byung 'phel lo rgyus/ 33 su 'di ru brjod dgos pa zhig ni bod lugs gso rig gi gsung rab man ngan lhan thabs su ched du tshan pa phye ste le'u gnyis kyis 'bras nad la gom gang mdun spos kyis 'tshol zhib byas yod la/ da dung rin thang nges can gyi lta ba gsar ba btod yod pa de/ dper na/ 'bras nad kyi rgyu rkyen de ngan khrag dang gnyan gnyis su 'phel rgyas gtong ba lta bu'o/ / rtsom pa pos sngon byon mes po la 'ur bstod gtan nas mi byed par tshad mthun gyi gdeng 'jog dang / rang yang lung tsam rgyab rten la mgo 'khor nas mi 'dug par bden 'tshol gyi snying stobs dang /gsar gtod kyi blo spobs de ni da skabs kyi bod lugs gso rig gi gnas babs la gzhig na sngar las lhag pa'i mkho nyag can dang don snying can zhig tu gyur 'dug go /de min 'brong rtse be bum du 'bras nad kyi 'dul thabs la nad thog lag len gyi phyogs nas bsgyur bcos dang 'phel rgyas gtong ste/'bras 'dul lums zhes pa'i sbyor sde'i rnam grangs dang rigs je rgyas su gtong zhing / yang sgos su phul byung gi rnam pas gso rig rgyud bzhi byung rjes kyi lo ngo stong phrag lhag gi ring la byung ba'i grangs las 'das pa'i bod sman mkhas can rnams kyi 'bras nad khyad par du phyi 'bras brtag bcos kyi nyams myong la khyon yongs nas phyogs sdom rgyab pa'i phyir/bod lugs gso rig gi 'bras bcos lag len khrod kyi med du mi rung ba'i bstan bcos zhig tu gyur to/ /bod lugs gso rig gi gsung rtsom gzhan zhig ste man ngag bye ba rang bsrel du dmangs khrod du dar ba'i 'bras bcos kyi nyams myong sna

34 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigatshogs bsdus yod/'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i zin tig gces bsdus su ches thog mar mid 'bras kyi rtsa ba'i bcos thabs gsang sngags zab mo (deng skabs su tshe srog tshan rig gi bcos thabs zhes su 'bod/) yin pa'i lta ba bton/ mdor na/ bod kyi gso rig gis 'bras nad kyi ngos 'dzin la rgyun ring gi lo rgyus ldan pa/ zhang zhung shes rig dus skabs kyi me btsa' dang gtar kha sogs thog ma'i bcos thabs nyams myong las/rim gyis 'bras 'dul thabs sogs bod kyi gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin gyi gzhung lugs kyi ma lag grub po/ / yin rung / nye rabs su slebs rjes/ rkyen shugs sna tshogs kyi btsir snon 'og bod kyi gso rig gi 'bras nad kyi thun min rnam bshad rnams bar skabs zhig tu dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad grabs byed pa'i gnas su lhung myong / deng skabs nga tshos deng dus gso rig la ngos zin dang cha rgyus nges can zhig son rjes/ slar yang bod kyi gso rig la zhib 'jug gis de'i 'bras nad kyi bshad pa dang gso bcos nyams myong la rtogs zhib byas na/ rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i dngos yod kyi rin thang chen po mchis so/ /

sde tshan gsum pa/ bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/le'u dang po/ bod lugasa'abrasand gsorig la rags tsam dpyad pa dang de'i phyogasasdom/'bras nad ni 'gro ba mi'i lus srog la gnod pa tshabs chen gtong ba'i nad zhig yin pas/ mi'i 'chi rkyen gyi grangs tshad ang dang por slebs yod/ rang rgyal la cha mtshon na lo re'i 'bras nad kyi 'chi tshad ni cha snyoms 60dzakhri 10yin pa ste lo gcig tu mi grangs khri bcu la dpe blangs na de'i nang lo de bzhin 'bras nad kyis mi drug cu lnga lam du skyal gyi yod/ 'brel yod tshan pa'i sdom rtsis nang gsal ltar da dung nad 'di phog mkhan gyi nad pa lo re bzhin je mang du 'gro ba'i 'phel phyogs mthong / spyir 'phrod bsten rtsa 'dzugs dang rgyal khab mang pos thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs kyis 'bras nad la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad byas dang byed bzhin yod mod/ 'on kyang mig sngar rig pas khas len zhing gtan khel ba'i gcig gyur gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i ngos 'dzin ma thob/

36 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'abras nad kyi rgyu rkyen dang gnas lugs bcos thabs sogs gang ci'i thad nas bshad na'ang kun gyi tshad mar 'dzin pa 'ig dang gso bcos lag len la slob ston byed thub pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bshad pa 'thus tshang zhig ma grub/'bras nad bcos thabs ni 'u thug thabs zad kyi sgo nas gshags bcos dang sna mang bcos thabs zung 'brel la brten te lo bzhi'i gson tshad dang lo lnga'i gson tshad mtho ru gtong ba tsam gyi gnas su lus 'dugakhyad par du mchin 'bras lta bu ni re gnyis tsam ma gtogs spyir btang zla ba gsum las 'tsho mi srid la skabs bstun sman bcos tsam las gtan khel sman bcos ci yang med/'dir bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i 'bras nad kyi ngos 'dzin dang gso thar+shas skor gyi dmigs bsal dang khyad par can la mdor bsdus tsam ba da /da/ kyi gso rig gis 'bras nad ngos 'dzin byas pa'i skor spyi lo dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs nas yod pa rtogs thub/ g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon pas dus rabs bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i bar btsams pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang bod kyi mkhas pa mi dgus bcoms pa'i so ma ra dzā'am sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo yi nang 'bras nad la ngos 'dzin phra zhing zhib pa bkod 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ / de lta bu'i brjod bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs pa dang rnam grangs gsal ba/gzhung lugs dngos dang mthun zhing 'thus sgo tshang ba/ nad thog lag len la slob ston gyi rang bzhin che ba'am don dngos gso bcos khrod bed

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 37 spyod rin thang ldan pa ni srol rgyun gso rig gzhan gyis 'gran pa lta ci/deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad bshad pa dang bsdur na yang gso bcos thad rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par dang so so'i dge mtshan nam legs cha ldan pa ni ngo gnong mi dgos pa zhig yin/'di ni gangs can gso rig nyal 'gro'i sgeg mos 'dzam gling tshe rig chu gter la 'phul ba'i rin bral gyi 'dod 'byung nor bu zhig yin no/ /'on kyang lo rgyus kyi 'phel phyogs dang spyi tshogs kyi dar rgud sogs sna tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen las bod kyi gso rig gi lo rgyus la'ang shugs rkyen sna tshogs 'byung te/ skabs shig gi ring nad kyi ngos 'dzin dang dpyad bcos kyi nang rtsa che ba khag gcig rgyun 'dzin legs po ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis rgyun chad pa'ang byung ba yin/ lhag don rig gsar gyi tshabs che'i gnod skyon 'os 'bras nad la 'ga' cig gis yang das pa'i ngos 'dzin byed ma thub par skran dang 'khrul ba'am ngan skran zhes ha ma go ba'i ra mgo lug sbyar gyi tha snyad gsar ba btags nas sgyur rtsom tshang mar ma dag rgyun 'byams kyis ad krin la skran/ ngan skran zhes log bsgyur byas 'dug de na ngos kyi bod lugs gso rig nas smra ba'i 'bras nad dang deng dus gso rig gis smra ba'i ad krin gnyis la nad rgyu dang nad rkyen/ nad kyi gnas lugs dang mtshan nyid/ nad rtags sogs gzhung mang po la gtug ste bsdur yang ngos 'dzin gcig gyur ma gtogs mi mtshungs pa'i gnas med pas/ de gnyis gzhi gcig la ngos 'dzin byas pa yin/

38 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadang po/ 'brasand dang skran nad kyi dbye ba bshad pa/'o na skran zhes pa ci ltar yin zhe na/ skran zhes pa ni ngo bo mi 'dra ba'i lus zungs dang dri ma sogs kyi grub cha sna tshogs gong bur 'dril ba'i rnam pa la dmigs te btags/ de'i dbye ba ni/ bshad rgyud du/skran la khrag mkhris lhen dang rdo yi skran/ / rlung srin rtsa chu'i skran dang brgyad du bshad/ / ces dbye yod pa rnams mdor bsdus tsam bstan na/1 khrag skran ni lus kyi phyi nang gi gnas gang rung zhig tu rkyen gang dbang gis khrag dang ngan khrag gong bur 'dril ba/2 mkhris skran ni grang mkhris 'phel ba'i rkyen gyi khrag gi snyigs ma snod kyi gnas nas dwangs snyigs legs par 'byed ma thub par mkhris pa'i snyigs ma lhang ba'i nang ma log pas/ snod mkhris dang mchin pa rgyu ma sogs nyes pa mkhris pa'i gnas su sa dang rdo'i rnam pa ru gnas pa ste nad kyi rgyu rkyen gyi sgo nas ming btags la/ spyir snod mkhris kyi gnas byung ba'i skran ni mkhris skran yin pas ma khyab la/ mkhris skran yin la snod mkhris kho na'i gnas su 'byung ba'i kyang ma khyab/2 nyen skran ni pho ba'i me drod nyams pas bad kun dang khyad par du 'byar bag gi rnam pa de 'phel nas nyen sna'i 'og zangs tshags kyi gnas la dreg pa chags pa/4 rdo skran ni nyes gsum gyis lus zungs kyi snyigs ma so so myag bzhu dwangs snyigs bye nas rang gnas su bskyal ma thub pas lus gnas gang rung zhig tu che chung nges med kyi gong bu 'dril ba sa dang rdo'i ngo bo

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 39 chags ༵/srin skran ni don snod dang klad pa/ pags pa sogs la gnas pa'i srin bu 'phel te gong bur 'dril ba/6 rtsa skran ni lus kyi rtsa spubs nang chags pa'i skran sna tshogs la gnas kyi sgo nas btags pa'o/ /7 chu skran ni lus kyi chu ser brlan gsher gyi ngo bo can kha shas sha pags kyi bar gseng du 'dus nas gong 'dril ngo bo ska ba'am cung zad sra 'gyur gyi rnam pa can// rlung skran ni pho ba dang long ga mngal du gnas pa'i rlung gi nying skran/gzhan yang spu mang po rgyu long pho ba'i gnas su shor ba lhan cig tu tshogs te gnas pa la spu skran zer/ zas kyi ngo bo ma log par pho rgyu long gsum gyi nang du rdog por chags pa'i zas skran/ sngo ngad rigs bston drags pa'i rgyu ma'i nang du rdog gnas kyi rtsa skran/ rnag lus gnas gang rung du gong 'dril gyi gnas pa'i rnag skran sogs gal te gnas dang sbyar nas dbye na mang po yod/gnyisapa/ 'brasand kyi ming don dang dbye ba/ rgyu rkyen/1 'bras ni lhan skyes kyi rma brgyad kyi ya gcig yin la thog mar 'di'i ming la dpyad na go ba len rgyu gnyis 'dugalhan skyes zhes pa ni skabs 'dir dang po mi'i mngal du lus chags pa'i dus khu khrag brgyud nad kyi rgyu zhig lus la gab pa'i tshul du gnas/

40 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigagal te nad ldang ba'i rgyu rkyen nges can zhig dang phrad na ldang ba ste/'bras nad ni rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyu rkyen dang 'brel ba che ba'i gnas lugs ston 'dug bsam/2 'bras ni mtshon rma ltar phyi nas drag shul spyod mi dgos par nad dang lhan cig rma rang bzhin gyis skyes pa'i nad cig yin/ 'bras zhes ming 'dogs don ni/ stag tshang lo tsā bas/ 'grams 'khrugs dwangs ma ma smin pa/ / ngan khrag rgyas te rtsa mig byer/ / rlung gis bsgril nas be+e 'bras ltar/ / sra zhing mkhregs 'gyur 'bras zhes bshad/ / ces smos pa ltar don snod sogs lus zungs kyi ldebs ngos su thog mar rma be 'bras lta bu sra mkhregs can zhig skyes te/ de rim gyis shing la lba skyes pa bzhin je cher 'gro/ /nad kyi rgyu ni man ngag rgyud las/ rgyu ni 'grams 'khrugs kha zas ma smin pas/ / ngan khrag rgyas te rlung gis bsgril nas 'byung / / zhes bshad pa bzhin/ rgyu gtso bo zhig nas dwangs ma ma smin par khrag ngan la gyur ba'am 'bras kyi gsos su gyur to/ /man ngag lhan thabs su gnyan rims sha rus rtsa bem 'bras zhes pa dang 'bras kyi rgyu ni gnyan tshad spyi dang 'dra ba la/ drag shul rkyen dang sa bdag klu gnyan 'gas/ / ngan khrag chu ser rkun bu la sogs pa/ / rlung bsgril nas lus kyi lhan skyes srin dang bsdongs/ / zhes bkod pa bzhin gnyan nad kyi rgyu phyi rol du gnas pa'i dug can srin bu pad+ma ta'am srog 'phrog gi rigs rnams dang / mi lus kyi lhan skyes su gnas pa'i srin bu dag kyang gnyan 'bras kyi rgyu ru 'gyur ba gsal bor rtogs 'dug pa dang

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 41 gzhan drag shul gyis bzos pa'i mtshon rma sogs stabs ma legs na cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og log nas 'bras su nad 'gyur byed pa'i gnas lugs kyang bstan no/ / yang brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyu rkyen te thog mar lus chags pa'i dus nas bzung gzugs dang grib ma bzhin lus la lhan skyes su gab pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i rgyu de ni 'bras nad ldang ba'i dus gdon zas spyod dang phrad na ldang la gal te ma 'phrad na ldang mi thub pa dang gab pa'i tshul du gnas pa las lus srog la gnod pa ci yang gtong mi thub/man ngag rgyud du/ 'di rnams lhan skyes nad yin gso mi nus/ / zhes pa ltar lhan skyes rma 'bras kyang 'di'i shugs bstan du yod pa bsam gzhigs bya'o/ /2 rten ni yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa las/ kha zas khengs po rab tsha dang / / rtsub dang skam dang tsha skyur zos/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin kha zas khengs po ste tshod ma sogs btsos pa yun lon nas dri ngan par mnam zhing mkhregs por gyur ba dang / shin tu rno zhing tsha ba'i zas lan tshwa dang su pan yun lon dang / sha mar com pa sogs rnying pa'i rigs bsten drags pa/ rab tu rno zhing tsha la rtsub pa'i zas spyod chang btung ba sna tha dang tha ma kha 'then pa lta bu/ sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo las 'bras kyi rkyen ni mi gtsang klu yi nad/ tsha dang lus kyi drag shul dang / rims kyi tsha ba bcags ma legs/ snad dang 'thems las byung ba dang / sha sungs chang sungs 'thung las byung / zhes gsungs so/ /4 dbye ba ni sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po las sha 'bras rus 'bras

42 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadang / 'dre 'bras khrag 'bras rlung 'bras so/ / zhes dang / man ngag rgyud du 'bras nad dbye ba gnas dang nyes ba rigs kyis dbye/ gnas kyi dbye na phyi 'bras nang 'bras gnyis/ phyi la sha rus rtsa yi 'bras dang gsum/ nang 'bras glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma dang / pho ba rgyu long gzhang dang lhang ba dgu/ de rigs rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang /mtshon dang bye 'bras dbye ba bco brgyad do/ / zhes pa'o/ /gsumapa/ rgyun mthong 'brasand rigasakyi nad rtags/'bras nad kyi rtags la phyi 'bras kyi nad rtags bshad pa dang nang 'bras kyi nad rtags bshad pa gnyis/1 phyi 'bras kyi nad rtags/ (1)phyi 'bras spyi'i nad rtags ni/rgyud las gsungs ba bzhin rtsa rgyud phra la 'dar bar 'phar ba/ 'bras kyi skrangs pa brtan par gnas ba ste 'dre 'bras ltar 'pho 'gyur mi byed pa/ lums bcos byas kyang 'dul dka' ba/ ma smin pa'i dus su na zug med pa'am chung ba/ skrangs pa de mtha' mtshams mi gsal ba/smin pa'i dus su 'bras nad kyis lus kyi dngas ma 'phrog ste cher rgyas pa dang / lus zungs kyi dwangs ma rgyu ba'i bu ga'i rgyu lam bkag pa dang /'bras nad ni khrag dang rmen bu/ lus zungs rgyu ba'i bu ga la brten nas lus phung yongs su mched de don snod sogs la gnod pa gtong ba brgyud gnyan kha rgyas te dang ga 'gag pa/ tsha ba rgyas pa dang zungs khrag zad pa/khyad par du lus stobs shor te sha skem pa'o/ /(2)phyi 'bras bye brag so so'i nad rtags bshad pa la/ rus

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 43 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ rus 'bras rus pa mdog 'gyur rtsi nyams zos/ rnag chu sro ma khu tshigs 'byung ba yin/sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo ru/ rus 'bras spang la phur btab 'dra/rus pa shing la 'bus zos 'dra/ zhes bkod yod pa bzhin rus pa'i mdangs nyams nas sngon por gyur ba dang / 'bras gnas sa'i rus pa de rim gyis rtsi bzhin phye mar 'gyur ba/ phyi nas rnag dang chu ser mdog dka~X po nang du sro ma dang khu tshigs kyi rnam pa can te rus pa'i phye ma ldan pa 'ad/ zlog/ spang la phur ba btab pa bzhin gzer dmigs 'pho 'gyur med pa shin tu zug chen po 'byung / rma khar sha'u mi skye ba/ rus 'bras mang che ba ni na tshod kyi sgo nas lo bco lnga man gyi byis pa la 'byung / rus 'dzer dang rus srin la nor nyen che/ phog gnas gtso bo ni so ma ra dzā las/ rus 'bras phal cher lkog ma brang dus dang / sna dang khrum khrum :sna / /nga / phal cher de rnams dag tu'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ji ( 2)rtsa 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ man ngag rgyud du/ rtsa 'bras rtsa thog skrangs shing 'khrug la 'phro/ zhes dang / so ma ra dzā las/ rtsa 'bras rtsa dang nye bar skrangs/ / phal cher ske dang yan lag go/ zhes smras pa bzhin 'bras gar gnas kyi rtsa thog skrangs pa dang na zug glog 'phro ba bzhin gzer 'khyug byed pa dang / phog gnas gtso che shos ni yan lag go / 'di la yang nang gses su dbye na gnyis te ston zla bzhin du 'phro ba dang rtsa 'bras sha sha men bu 'dra ba bcas gnyis so/ /

44 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig( 4) sha 'bras kyi nad rtags ('dir bshad pa'i sha 'bras ni byang khog la ma yin par phyi'i sha dang tshil pags par skyes pa'i 'bras la zer)ni/gong smras phyi 'bras kyi spyi rtags thog kha shas ni pags pa mthug po chags pa dang de nas rim bzhin skrangs pa cher rgyas byed pa/ skrangs pa ni sra mkhreg nyung ma rlon pa 'dra ba dang gting zab can yin/ 'brong rtse be bum las/ sha 'bras sha bem mdog sngo zug gzer chung / gson shi ma phyed sha ro sbangs zan 'dra/ sha 'bras skrangs che bem la zug gzer chung /(bem ni tshor dka' ba'am tshor ba nyams pa)zhes spangs che zhes bstan pa bzhin sha 'bras ni 'bras kun gyi nang nas rgya khyon che ba yin pa ste mang che ba ni li smi gnyis nas lnga'i yas mas su yod do/ /2 nang 'bras kyi nad rtags bshad pa/ nang 'bras sam khong 'bras kyi spyi'i nad rtags ni be+e sngon las/ spyir skran lta bur rig pa'i tshe sra ba'am mi mngon par gting du nub cing zas la 'khren pa zhes pa dang /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nang ni shin tu mi bzod cing / gting ring skran ltar sra ba yin/ grog mkhar lta bur mtho ba dang / me dang mtshon ltar myur ba'o/ / zhes pa ltar nang 'bras ni zhogs pa zas ma zos pa'i sngon la gan rgyal nyal rjes myong goms can gyi sor mos reg na kha shas ni rtogs nus shing ngo bo sra ba yin/ kha shas ni mi mngon par gting zab kyi ngang rgyas pas yun gyis dang ga bkag 'gro/me dang mtshon ltar 'phral mar 'phrog 'gro ste sha khrag zad pa shin tu myur/smin nas gyen thur gnyis gar brdol bar 'gyur/ zhes smin rjes bla gnyan gyi sdong zla mang zhing khrag 'khru skyug byed/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 45 ( 1) bye brag glo 'bras ni/ slong rkyen gyi sgo nas bshad na glo 'bras phog mkhan gyi nad pa'i 905ni tha mag 'then mkhan yin/ be+e sngon las/ glo 'bras ni mid pa na zhing hril hril byed snyam dang kha zas mid pa dka'/ zhes dang / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/lte ba yan chad smin khar 'dzag ces bshad pa bzhin lud pa lu ba/smin rjes lud pa khrag can yang yang 'dzag pa dang / glo gnas brang khog dang rtsibs rus rgyab kyi tshigs bzhi ba dang lnga ba na ba/ 'bras kyis glo ba'i dbugs rgyu ba'i bu ga phra mo rnams bkag pas dbugs hril hril byed pa/ srog 'dzin rlung gi rgyu yul gre ba dang brang gzhung la shugs rkyen thebs te de'i byed las zhan par btang bas zas mid dka' ba/dbugs rgyu ba la skyon byed pa dang / mthar khrag zad sha skom sogs kyi nad rtags ston/( 2)snying 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ bai sngon las/ snying 'bras ni snying 'phar zhing gzer la dran pa mi gsal zhing mun sros pa ltar sems/zhes dang / yan lag brgyad par/ snying byung yan lag kun gzir snyam/rab rmongs mun gros snyam du byed/ snying 'phar na bar 'gyur ba yin/zhes pa ltar spyir snying 'bras mang che ba ni rlung las gyur ba yin pas de'i rtags ni de la rlung gyur nad tshabs drags/ dmar nag ring zhig lon nas ni/ 'byung zhing smin pa dbyibs mi snyoms/ ran zhing mgo 'khor sbos pa dang / g.yo zhing 'pho la sgra dang bcas/ zhes dang rgyud las rlung gyur sbo 'khrog mi brtan mgo bo 'khor/ zhes dang gzhan yang 'brong rtse be+e bum las/ de dag gnad snying byung na gso ba dka' zhes gsungs pa

46 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaltar go ba len dgos snyam/( 2) mchin 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ be+e sngon las/ mchin 'bras ni dbugs 'gag zhing mgo 'khor ba dang skom dad che la mchin steng na/ zhes dang mkhris gyur zangs ltar dmar rtsa gnag skom dad tshad rims rmongs bag skyed/ ldang zhing smin pa myur ba yin zhes yan lag brgyad par gsungs/ de min gong bkod spyi rtags skabs brjod pa'i rtags rnams ston/ mdor bsdus na smin pa myur pa ste mang che ba zla gnyis nas gsum ma gtogs 'tsho mi thub pa/ mchin steng ste g.yas phyogs kyi rtsibs rus 'og na ba/ tshad rims kyi sdong zla rgyun par yod pas skom dad che la mgo 'khor ram na ba/ mig sprin ser bor gyur pa dang dang ga 'gags pa/ lag pas sbar myul byas na mchin pa skrangs pa'am rgyas yod pa/ lus stobs shor ba dang khrag zad pa/ skya rbab kyi sdong zla yod pa/ gzhan yang mchin 'bras kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni so ma ra dzā las/ lci dang bcud can rul sungs dang / zhes dang / na tshod kyi sgo nas mang che ba lo bzhi bcu yan chad la 'byung / mchin nad leb rgan (mkhregs 'gyur)mchin pa'i khrag skran la nor nyen yod/(4) mcher 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ man ngag rgyud las/mcher 'bras sbo 'khrog byed cing dbugs mi bde/ zhes pa dang /rtagasagatso bo ni mcher pa skrangs ba/ sra mkhregs su gyur ba/ myong na mcher ba'i ngos 'jam snyoms min pa/ spyir rus 'bras dang khrag 'bras/rmen bu'i 'bras kyi rkyen mcher ba la zhugs pa las mcher 'bras rkyang ba ni dkon/ mcher skran dang mcher rgyas la mi 'dzol ba gal che/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 47 (5) mkhal 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ yan lag brgyad par/mkhal mar byung na rked pa rgyab rtsibs logs su ni na bar 'gyur/ zhes pa dang / rgyud las/ mkhal 'bras chu sri brtsir snyam rked pa na/ dri chu'i nang khrag 'dres pa/ rtsibs logs na ba/ spangs rdog yod pa/lus stobs shor ba/ phog mkhan mang che ba bad rlung gi rang bzhin can dang lo bzhi man chad kyi byis pa yin/(6)pho 'bras (kong sprul zin tig tu pho thog zer)kyi nad rtags ni/thog mar pho ba na ba'am sbos nas mi bde ba'i tshor snang shar/ sha skem pa/dang ga 'gag pa dang skyugs pa/ khrag skyugs pa/ dri chen gyi mdog nag por gyur pa dang zas mid ma thub pa sogs so/ / man ngag rgyud las/'bras nad phog gnas ni phal cher pho long mid pa'i 'brel mtshams mang /zhes bstan pa bzhin pho 'bras kyis 'bras nad yongs kyi 'chi tshad kyi 48 895zin yod/de min man ngag rgyud las/ lto sbos zas 'khren mid pa na/ zhes pa ltar zas za 'dod che ba zas 'phral skyug cing mid pa na ba'o/ /(7)rgyu long gi 'bras nad kyi rtags ni/ be+e sngon du/ zas skom sogs zhu rjes na la skyugs bu 'ong / gdong ba dang rkang bol g.yo zhing 'khru bar 'gyur zhes bkod pa bzhin rgyu 'bras ni thol byung du lus stobs shor ba/ dang ga 'gag pa/ rgyun par lte 'og na ba dang bshang ba nag po yin pa'am 'khru ba 'byams pa/(〈)long 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ brang khog gi g.yas smad du skrangasardog myong nus pa/ 'phral du grod khog na ba dang zas la dang ga

48 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigazhan pa/ be snabs dang khrag 'khru bar byed pa sogs me drod nyams pa'i rtags 'byung ba mtshams 'jog mi byed pa/ khrag zad pa dang lus stobs nyams pa/ na tshod kyi sgo nas lo lnga bcu yan chad la phog pa mang /(9)gzhang 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ be+e sngon las/ gzhang kha na zhing 'phyen gyis dbugs 'gags bshang bar rnag 'dres pa 'byung zhes dang / yan lag brgyad pa las/ gzhang du rlung ni thur 'byung 'gags/zhu dang ma zhu phyed nyid zhu/ de dag 'or nad lta bur bshad/ ces phog gnas mang thos ni gzhang dang rgyu ma'i 'brel mtshams yin/ gong bshad bzhin bshang bar khrag gi gos gyon pa'am 'khru bar byed pa/ lus zungs nyams pa/ dri chen nang rnag 'dres pa'am dmar dri khyad par can bro ba/ bshang ba dang 'phyen gtong skabs na zug drag po gtong ba/bshang lam du sor myong byas na 'brum rdog sra mo mang po gzhang ngos su mi snyoms par gnas yod pa dang sor rtsar khrag 'gos yong ba red/ na mkhan ni mang che ba dar ma dang rgan pa'o/ /( 10) lhang bu'i 'bras kyi rtags ni/ be+e sngon las/ lhang bu'i 'bras ni chu 'gags shing na zug che la chu so na ba 'byung zhing / zhes dang / yan lag brgyad par/ chu so 'doms par byung brla na/ zhes thog mar dri chu khrag can 'byung / lhang 'bras kha cig la skabs skabs su dri chu khrag can 'byung la kha cig la ni rgyun du gcin khrag 'byung bar byed/khyad par du gcin 'gags dang / gcin sri byed/ lhang 'bras smin rjesaganyan kha rgyas pas de dang mthun pa'i rtags 'byung / phog mkhan mang che ba lo bzhi bcu drug bcu'i bar yin/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 49 ( 11)na 'bras kyi nad rtags ni/ yan lag brgyad pa ru/ de bzhin bud med bu btsas pa'am/ sprum pa'am nu zho yod pa dang / nu zho med pa'i nu ma yi/ rtsa sgo kha phye phyin gyur nas/ phyi yi khong 'bras mtshan nyid can/ skrang zhing sra ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ bu mo rnams kyi nu rtsa'i sgo/phra bas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / rlung ni rgyu lam 'gag pas 'khrugs/skrangs dang gzer ni skyed cing rgyu/ zhes rgyas par 'chad yod mod/bod la ni phog mkhan nyung / deb thog bkod pa ltar na yo rob nub mar na mkhan mang mo mchis la/ gtso bo bud med bu ma skyes pa dang gnyen sgrig mi byed mkhan yin no/ /( 12)mid pa'i 'bras (ming gi rnam grangs su bad kun mgul 'gags dang / mid 'chus/ gre thogs skye 'ching /)kyi nad rtags ni/ 'bri gung tshe dbang bstan pa'i gces bsdus phan bde snying nor du/ gre 'gags zhes dgu ru dbye yod/ rje zur mkhan bas/ mid 'chus byung ba'i mngon tshul ni/ 'ju byed mthu nyams zas mi zhu/ mnyam gnas rlung gis ma phyed pas/ myag byed dag gis zas ma 'brul/ bad kun be snabs pho ba dang / brang dang glo yu rnams su bsags/ rlangs pa sprin dang na bun 'dra/ mid pa'i sbubs su chags pa las/ zil ba be snabs mgul bar 'byung / dper na phyugs po'i zho skyogs la/ zo sho chags pa lta bu'am/ 'og tu me btang steng khang la/ du ba chags pa lta bu yong /de rtags lus kyi mthu nyams shing / sha dang zas skom mid pa dka'/dbugs kyi 'dren brngub dka' ba na/ mgul ba 'gags pa zhes bya yin/ zas skom 'khris shing mi thar bas/ mid 'chus ske 'ching zhes

50 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapar 'dod/ ces bstan pa ltar yul ngad can grang ba'i yul dang na tshod lo bzhi bcu nas bdun cu bar/ rten gyi sgo nas phog mkhan pho las mo mang / slong rkyen rno zhing tsha ba'i skom chang rgod dang / skam mkhregs tsha drod che ba'i rigs sogs bsten drags pa dang 'brel ba zab/mid 'bras thog ma'i dus nad rtags zas mid dka' ba tsam las mngon gsal dben/ 'bras rgyas pa dang rim gyis zas mid dka' ba dang zas mid par rgyu skabs bkag snyam byed/ de nas bag leb lta bu zas mkhregs po mid dka'/ rim gyis gsher ba'i zas kyang mid mi thub par zas shin tu sla mo'am skom kho na bsten pa'i gnas su lhung /mid 'bras thog mar phog pa nas mjug tu smin pa'i bar bdun phrag kha shas dang zla ba kha shas 'gor/ tha na lo gcig 'gor ba yang yod/(smin pa zhes pa ni nad rtags mngon gsal shar nas bcos dka' ba'i dus la slebs pa'i don no)mid 'bras kyi rgyu rkyen brtag bcos sogs gang la dpyad kyang bad kun gyi shan ha cang che phyir lhan skyes rma'i le'ur ma bstan par rgyud kyi bad kun gso ba'i le'ur bsdus pa red/rgyud las/ bad kun mgul 'gags bya pho ba dang / brang dang glo bar bad kun rgyas pa yis/ bad gan rlangs pa glo yu min par chags/dper na dong ba'i logs la zo chags 'dra/ de rkyen mid pa 'chus nas zas mid dka'/ dbugs brngub mi bde sha skem lus stobs 'chor/zas skom med pas pho ba cha nas nub/ mjug tu mid pa 'gags nas 'chi ba yin zhes bstan pa ltar mid 'bras kyang pho 'bras dang mchin 'bras ltar rgyun mthong gi 'bras nad cig go / lhun sdings bdud rtsi

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 51 'gyur med kyis nad kyi brgyud rim dang gso bcos dka' sla'i sgo nas thog mtha' bar te dus gsum du dbye yod/(12)rmen bu'i 'bras (ming gzhan 'bras phreng )kyi nad rtags ni/rgyud las/ 'bras mkhrang sra 'dril gting zug 'phel 'bri chung / / sra la smin dka' nyung gshin 'khyags 'dra dang / / 'bros zhing 'phel rkyen 'gas pa spang bar bya/ / zhes dang / yan lag brgyad par/ kha gcig skam zhing kha gcig skyes/ / yun ring du ni gnas bar byed/ / dur ba bzhin du 'bri zhing 'phel/ / 'brum chen 'bras phreng zhes bya'o/ / zhes smos pa bzhin thog ma'i dus na zug dang gnyan kha med par gnas nges can gyi rmen bu cher rgyas byed pa dang / khyad par du ske'i rmen bu skrangs ba/ 'phel 'gros myur zhing dang thog skrangs rdog cung tsam snyi ba dang sra brtan min pa/ mnan na na zug med/ rmen bu chen po chags tshe skrangs rdog ngo bo sra mkhregs can dang mnan na na zug yod pa/ men 'bras smin pa'am mtha' ma'i skabs la slobs tshe lus kyi gnas mang po'i men bu skrangs ba dang / mchin mcher rgyas par byed pa/ tsha ba rgyas pa lus stobs nyams pa sogs spyi rtags skabs brjod pa'i nad rtags mthong /na tshod kyi sgo nas phog mkhan mang che ba lo lnga yar mar gyi byis pa yin/men bu'i 'bras nad dang ske 'phreng gnyis nor nyen shin tu che/kha gcig gas ske 'phreng 'bras nad du ngos 'dzin byas yod pa dper na 'bras rigs ske 'phreng zhes bya rna gsham skye/ gcig brdol ma sos yang gcigaskye ba lci/ gcig sos gcig skye ba ni yang ba ste/ snga ma thu ba'i rigs yin bcos thabs gzab/ rna shal phan tshun gnyis kyi 'og nas

52 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigani/ rma re skyes te rma de ma sos gong / ske yi mjing zur ltag khung la sogs par/ mang du mched pa 'di ni gso thub pa dka'/ / zhes bshad yod mod/ don dngos su ske phreng ni nub lugs gso rig gis smra ba'i 'dus 'dril gcong nad rmen bu la babs pa'o/ / rmen 'bras dang ske phreng gi 'khrul so bsal ba ni/ ske phreng phog mkhan mang che ba lo nyi shu rtsa lnga man gyi dar ma yin/ skrangs pa brdol nas rnag 'dzag pa dang rmen 'bras ni spyir btang du brdol mi srid/ men 'bras ni sha 'bras kyi khongs su 'du bas sha 'bras nyung gsher 'khyag 'dra zhig lums kun gyis zhig pa'am brdol dka' zhes pa gcig mtshungs so/ / gal te ske phreng rmen 'bras su bgrang na rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang 'gal zhing dngos yod gnas lugs dang lar nas mi mthun no/ /(14)khrag 'bras (zungs kyi 'bras te nyes pa khrag min )kyi nad rtags ni/ sman dpyad zla rgyal las/ khrag 'bras gtar ka do ma snyoms/zhes 'di tsam las zhib cha bkod pa ma mthong / yan lag brgyad par bkod pa'i 6 khrag 'bras ’ ni nyes pa khrag la go ba len dgos so/ / gal te rang re'i gso rig nang bshad pa'i khrag 'bras de nub lugs gso rig pas smra ba'i khrag ril dkar po 'phel ba'i nad dang don gcig pa'i dbang du btang na de'i rtags ni 'di lta ste/ mesgyid skyur ba'am shugs med pa/ gdong skya por gyur pa dang yi ga 'chus pa/ 0khrag zad pa/()khrag rtsa brtol sla ba dang khrag rtsa'i nang khrag mkhregs po chags pa/(kyeganyan kha rgyas pa/ ()men mdud dang mchin mcher spangs pa/ (kyekhag cig la rus par na zug rgyag pa/ ()rkan rnyil skrangs pa/ (rgyal

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 53 spyi'i 'bras 'gog mnyam tshogs kyis bton pa'i 6 khong 'bras zin tig ltar ro )bcas so/ / 'on kyang 'di gnyis don gcig yin min nad ngos 'dzin dang tshad ldan mkhas pa'i bshad pa sogs phan tshun lag len khrod du bsdur ba dang phra zhib kyi zhib dpyod byas nas ngag sbyor bcoms na 'grig pa ma gtogs rig pa'i dpyad 'bras la khungs lung gi rtsa ba'i gdeng tshod ci yang med par byung rgyal smra ba la ni 'jig go/ yang na khrag ril dkar po 'phel ba'i 'bras nad rus 'bras kyi khongs su mi rtogs pa'i nges pa'ang med do/ /bzhi ba/ rgyun mthong 'brasand rigasakyi gsobacosartsa don/gso tshul phyi rgyud las/ khong 'bras smin nas gso bar dka' ba'i phyir/ smin du mi gzhug gsar dus gso ba sgrims/ zhes khong 'bras la gtso bor dmigs nas bstan yang don du khong 'bras tsam ma zad 'bras nad kun smin pa'am tha ma rgyas pa'i skabs shin tu gso dka' phyir/ smin du mi gzhug par thog ma'i skabs nas thabs tshul sna tshogs kyis brtag ci thub byas te gsar pa'i dus su sman bcos byed thub min 'tsho 'chi'i 'gag 'phrang yin/ spyir 'bras nad kun ma smin pa'i skabs sam thog ma'i skabs 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin byed thub na nad pa'i gso tshad dang tshe tshad je ring gtong bar don snying zab mo yod pas thabs shes 'dra min gyi brtag dpyad byas te 6 thog ma'i skabs midang 6 bar ma'i skabs mingos 'dzin pa ni shin tu gal bo che zhig go /yang lhan thabs su/ nad rkyen gnyan yin khong sman rtsa lto sbyong /

54 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigand dngos 'bras yin lums 'dul chu tshan gzhug ces smras pa bzhin gnyan nad kyi sdong zla med pa'i 'bras ni mi srid pas sman bcos skabs yid la bcangs dgos so/ /1 phyi 'bras kyi bcos thabs ni/ rgyud dang lhan thabs zla zer/so ma rā dza/ khyad par du 'brong rtse be+e bum sogs su shin tu zhib phra'i bcos tshul bshad pa rnams ha cang mang bas 'dir yig tshogs la 'dzems nas mi 'dren pas don gnyer can yin na de rnams la gzigs/'dir de rnams kyi khyad chos dang dmigs bsal mtshon pa'i bcos bsdus tsam bkod na/rgyud las/ phyi 'bras dang po 'dul dang bar skyon bsal/ sha'u gso zhing tha ma rmen brtas bya/ zhes gsungs yod/ dang po 'bras 'dul thabs ni rgyud rang nas bstan pa rnams dang sha 'bras rtsa 'bras rus 'bras so so'i kha 'dzin sdebs dgos/ kha zas ni phyogs med 'jig zas btang la zhig dgos te nya sha dang phag sha sgo nga la sogs la phan pa'i zas dus med du btang nas bzhig dgos/gzhan yang lhan thabs rus 'dul che 'bring chung gsum dang /'bri gung ba'i rus 'dul zab mo'i man ngag 'brong rtse'i dur rus bzhi pa sogs kyi dugs dang lums kyis 'dul dgos/ thul ba'i rtags ni skrangs pa 'joms shing hrem hrem med par mnyen la bde ba na de'i stong du me btsa' bzhag nas tshos par bsreg yang na skrangs thul zhing tsha 'khyug byed pa dang rnag smin pa la rnag thur mas dbug la 'jib dang khrus kyis sha ro'i rul bcad la 'byar gyis bcos/ lums la skyed med

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 55 na bar du sha ro'i skyon bsal byed dgos/ gong du nad rkyen gnyan yin zhes smos pa bzhin khong sman gnyan 'joms kyi sman dang / gsham du khong 'bras bcos skabs 'chad pa'i 'bras nad kyi gnyen po rnams lag len dang nad bab la bstun nas rig pas 'phrul te bsten dgos so/ /2 khong 'bras bcos thabs las/ (1) mid 'bras la/'brong khrag brgyad pa/ spyang lce brgyad pa/ spang rgyan bcu ba/ mkha' 'gyu basbya sbyor/ bad tshad yod na grub ril kha tshar can dang man ngag ba la za/ /ni shing thog gi rigs dang sngo chod gsar skyes bston pa dang /chang sogs rno zhing tsha ba'i zas skom dang / khyad par du ma tshos pa dang tshig pa'i zas ni dug bzhin spang dgos so/ / bcos rgyas pa kong sprul zin tig gi gre thogs bcos par gsal/( 2)glo 'bras la/ man rgyun glo nad skabs kyi zangs thal lnga ba/zangs thal nyer lnga rigs gnyis/ bse ru nyer lnga tshad ldan/ spyir bse ru dngos ma 'bras rigs kun la phan pa che bar mthong / dngul rin bco brgyad/ yang na nad rtags kyi babs dang bstun te skabs bcos 'di ltar te/ glo langs shing khrag lu na thang chen nyer lnga/ dbugs 'byin rngub dka' ba dang brang na bar wa glo nyer lnga/ rlung 'phel ba/khra/ zad pa la a gar bco lnga sogs rlung sman gyi rigs ltag sprod byed da sa/( 2)mchin 'bras la/ g.yu rnying nyer lnga'i rigs/ gi dgu/ gi tig gur kum mchog bdun/ gser tig yang na kha gur steng gi
