56 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigawang dang 'bam po'i khan da bang bskyed pa'i grang thang gtong dgos/skabs bstun sman bcos ni thog mar mchin gnas su na zug gtong skabs gur khyung / dang ga 'gags pa dang khrag zad pa/ mchin nad gzhan gyi sdong zla yod pa'am mchin mcher rgyas na zla shel lcags bdun dang so bdun/ lag pas myong skabs mchin ldebs su skrangs dog sran ma ltar mkhregs po mngon na mchin nad leb rgan gyi sdong zla byung ba yin pas g.yu rnying nyer lnga gtong / tsha ba chung ngu 'byams pa dang / rtsa rgyud phra la mgyogs pa/ dri chu'i mdog dmar smug tu gyur pa dang ku ya mthug pa/ mig sprin ser po chags pa sogs tsha ba'i rtags byung na gnyen po gi dgu dang gi tig gdong mdog nag por gyur ba dang / lus stobs shin tu nyams pa dang sha zad khrag zad kyi skom por gyur ba/ man rgyud du bsten pa'i rmen bu'i gnad brgyad skrangs pa/ lus smad dang lte 'og tu chu bsags pa/ rkang pa skrangs g.yo byas pa rnams skya rbab ltar bcos dgos/ gzhan dus kun gnyan gnya' gcog pa gal che/ kha zas ro skyur ba dang kha bska mngar ba'i rigs dang nus pa bsil lci rigs bsten dgos/ ro nus tsha zhing rno rtsub can gyi zas la 'dzem pa gal che/ khyad par du zla zer nas smos pa bzhin chang la 'dzem pa gal gnad do/ /(4)pho 'bras (kong sprul zin tig gi pho thog)kyi rtags ni ma zhu ba dang smug po sogs bla gnyan gyi nad grogs can ma gtogs rkyang ba ni shin tu nyung bas gnas lugs de bstun gyis bcos thabs gal che/dupho ba na ba'am sbos na ru drug ru khyung / ru zhi sogs/()dang ga 'gags na se 'bru bcu gsum sogs/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 57 duskyugs na cong zhi drug pa/ shing mngar drug pa/ smug po g.yul rgyal/ khrag skyugs na gur kum brgyad pa tshad ldan/ thang chen nyer lnga kha tshar can sogs/(kyebashang ba nag po'am khrag can la khrag gcod gur brgyad sogs/dupho bar sha 'bras rdog po skyes yod na de brdol byed dam 'jig sman dkar po drug sbyor dang zhi drug gang rung gi steng la mgron bu'i bsreg thal lam dung dkar bsreg thal bongs nyams sbyar ba sogs/dubyang khog la chu bsags na dmu chu ltar bcos dgos mod/ chu la zungs gnas yod pas glo 'dren lan nas byed mi rung /du bshang ba skam po chags nas babs dka' na zhi lcum dang gyen rgyu'i rlung sman/ 'jam rtsi dang ni ru ha/༷ske men gtso byas men bu mched brgyad skrangs na khyung lnga dang phan kun sogs gnyan sman rigs/ nad gzhi'i sman bcos rin chen grang sbyor/ zhi byed nyer dgu/ gla rtsi kha tshar can/ mang sbyor/ btso zla/bco drag btso thal kha tshar can dang pho sman gzhan rnams la btso thal kha tshar bgyis ba bsten dgos/ nyung lugs rdo zhun/ bde snyoms/ phag grub/ bco drag se 'bru'i sbyor ba la rdo zhun bongs mnyam bsdebs pa/bdud rtsi ril chen dkar/ zas ni rtsam rnying / sha thud rul pa/ khrag rgyu dang ma smin pa'i zas rigs thams cad shin tu gnod cing / tshig hrog gi rigs/ ja snum tshig song pa/ gyong po'i rigs dang pho grib gos grib sogs 'dzem pa shin tu gal che/dpyad ni skrangs pa phyir mngon pa'i dus me btsa' chung ngus reg bya

58 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigal mi gnod pa tsam gyis mtha' nas bskor te nyin re bar la bzhag ste bsreg na skrangs pa mngon gsal gyis zhum 'gro/ཿ5)mngal 'bras kyi rtags ni/ (kyergyu zhabs gzer na zhi byed bcu gadhikāg don na sā ri'i bya khyung / pad rag mdog ldan dang skyer shun brgyad pa/ skyer khyung sogs/()mngal mthar rma rul chags nas dri mnam pa'i khrag chu 'dzad med 'dzag na/ thang chen nyer lnga kha tshar can/ star bu bcu dgu khrag bshig rin chen pha lam/ spyir la rgya ru bcu bzhi dang tshwa bsreg sbyor ba/zhi byed nyer dgu'i steng mgron thal lam 'phrul thang kha tshar byas pa pho 'bras skabs kyi rin chen rigs sogs/ gzhan 'bras nad rigs gang yin rung gzer chen langs skabs rin chen ril bu'i rigs gtong bas na zug 'jog nus/(6)pags 'bras kyi rtags ni/ gong smos sha 'bras ltar lums kyis 'dul ba dang me btsas 'bras mtha' bskor nas bsreg yang na me bum brgyab nas 'bur du thon pa dang / bal skud lhod pos 'bras skrangs kyi rtsa ba nas dam por bsdams te nyin re bzhin je dam du gtong dgos/ gnyen po btang ba dang sbrags bal skud rim bzhin je dam du btang nas mthar khrag gi rgyu ba 'bras skrangs la mi thon pa'i dus te skrangs pa sha ror gyur pa dang rtsa ba chad nas lhung yong ba'am rtsa ba shin tu phra ba'i dus 'breg dgos/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 59 le'u gnyisapa/ gsorig rgyud bzhi lasabastan pa'i 'brasand kyi brjod bya/dang po/ bad kun mgula'agagasasamamid 'brasakyi rgyu rkyen dang brtag bcos/bad kun mgul 'gags zhes pa pho ba dang / / brang dang glo bar bad kun rgyas pa yis/ / bad kun rlangs pa glo yu mid par chags/ /dper na dong ba'i logs la zo chags 'dra/ / des rkyen mid pa 'chus nas zas mid dka'/ / dbugs rngub mi bde sha skem lus stobs 'chor/ / zas skom med pas pho ba cha nas rub/ / mjug tu min pa 'gags nas 'chi ba yin/ /mgul 'gags nad la bcos thabs tsha ba lnga/ bzang po bzhi dang shing kun byi tang ga rgyam tsha sna drangs tshwa sna tshogs tshad dang / srub ka lce tsha'i phye ma sprang rgod sbyar/ cong zhi rgod btul thal sman non po dang /nang nub ltag pa sprad la chu skol dbul/ nya sha ol gong tsha ba khong du bsten/ sman rjes bshal skyugs sbrags la sbyang bar bya/ lhen gsang ske stong tshigs pa bzhi ba bsreg /

60 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaganyisapa/ 'brasand kyi rgyu rkyen dbye bdang soso'i nad rtags/dang bo 'bras la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang / / rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan/ / rgyu ni 'grams 'khrugs kha zas ma smin pas/ / ngan khrag rgyas te rlung gis bsgril nas 'byung / / dbye ba gnas dang zhes pa'i rigs kyis dbye/ / gnas kyis dbye na phyi 'bras nang 'bras gnyis/ /phyi la sha rus rtsa yi 'bras dang gsum/ / nang 'bras glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma dang / / pho ba rgyu long gzhang dang lhang ba dgu / de rigs rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang / / mtshon dang bye 'bras dbye ba bco brgyad do/ / de rtags phyi nang rigs kyis brtag pa gsum/ / phyi 'bras spyi rtags rtsa rgyud phra la 'dar/ / spangs pa sra brtan na zug chung ba la/ / lums 'dul kun gyis zhi bar mi 'gyur ba'o/ /khyad par sha 'bras nyung gsher 'khyags pa 'dra/ / rus 'bras rus pa mdog 'gyur rtsi nyams zos/ / rnag chu sro ma khu tshigs 'byung ba yin/ /rtsa 'bras rtsa thog skrangs shing 'khyug la 'phro/ / de dag gnad steng byung bas gso ba dka'/ / khong 'bras skran ltar reg pa sra ba 'am/ / mi mngon gting nub zas la 'khrin pa ste/ /smin nas gyen thur gnyis ka ra rnag rdol 'gyur/ / glo 'bras mid pa na zhing zas mid dka'/ / snying 'bras dran pa mi gsal mun sros sem/ / mchin 'bras dbugs 'gags mgo 'khor skom dad che/ / mcher 'bras sbo 'khrog byed cing dbugs mi bde/ / mkhal 'bras chu sri btsir snyam rked pa na/ / pho ba

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 61 lto sbo zas 'khren mid pa na/ / rgyu long zhu rjes na la skyigs bu 'ong / /gdong ba rkang bol g.yo zhing 'khru bar 'gyur/ / gzhang 'bras gzhang kha na zhing phyin dbugs 'gag / lhang pa chu 'gags zug che chu so na/ /phal cher pho long mid pa'i 'brel mtshams mang / / de phyir pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces ba yin/ / rlung gyur sbo 'khrog mi brtan mgo bo 'khor/ /mkhris gyur dmar tsha myur du tsha ba skye/ / bad kun mdog skya sgrog cing zas mi 'ju/ / khrag las gyur ba nu ma mngal du 'byung / / rab tu tsha la 'brum pa nag pos khyab/ / mtshon lam la rten rdo la thug pa sogs/ /zhi zhing slar ldang rgyun du gnas bar byed/ / bye 'bras bye sgong tsam sra zug med brtan/ /gsum pa/ phyi 'brasakyi gdulathabasadang bar skyon bsalathabs/ sha'u gsothabs/bcos pa'i thabs kyang de bzhin rnam gsum ste/ phyi 'bras dang po 'dul dang bar skyon bsal/ sha'u gso zhing tha ma sman brtas bya/'bras 'dul sha la mi rus nya yi sha spru rtsa re lcag cong zhi dri chu'i lums/ / rus la pi pi ling dang ra mnye bsnan/ / rtsa la mtshal dang tsha las bran la bdug / yang na sha la bdud rtsi lnga yis bdug / dus la 'ba' cha'am rus sna sna tshogs lums/ / rtsa la bsil ba'i sngo nas gdul bar bya/ / kha zas phyogs med 'jig zas btang la bshig / thul rtags spangs shing hrem med mnyen la bde/ / de yi stong du me btsa' 'tshos bar bsreg / yang na spangs 'dus tsha 'khyug rnag smin

62 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'agyur/ / rnag phug 'jibs khrus rus bcad 'byar gyis bcos/ /skyed med bar du sha ro skyon bsal ba/ / dngul thal rgya tshwa ru rta byang ba bzhi/ / yang na bse ru btsan dug dngul thal dang / / smug po sbal rgyab dom mkhris sbyar ba'am/ byang pa rgya tshwa ru rta shu dag dang / / thar nu 'brug rus sbrang smyon tsha ba gsum/ / rma med thur mas sman lam gtod la gzhug / rma can rengs bu'am shog bu la byugs dgab/ / dam gyis sbyar la zhag gsum za ru gzhug / ser ga byung nas gson gshin mtshams su brdzangs/ / 'bam po phug ron brun dang sbang 'jibs bya/ / yang na so thog ze tsha sbrang sbyar bcad/ / chod pa dka' na lcags kyis non par bsreg / rus la stag sha lce tsha khab len gsum/ / sbrang smyon sbyar byugs chod dka' brud dam bsreg / gson gshin sprad cing byer na mgo ltar bcos/ / rtsa la 'bras bu'i thang rjes mang du gtar/ /rtsa 'brum mtshan do 'phar rtsa me yis mnan/ / rtsa nas sbyang zhing khong nas rtsa kha bsdam/ / 'phro chad sha ro gong bzhin bsal bar bya/ / rtsa kha skor na dom mkhris thal pa gnyis/ / spru 'bru bu ram ril bus rtsa kha bgag / spru rtsa zho dang sbyar bas rma kha g.yog / skyon sol dag nas bkrus la 'tsho sman gdab/ / skams na zhos sbang rlon na phrum sar btang / / sbos na phying mar brtse na snying rtsa bya/ / tha ma rmen chags brtas bar bya ba ni/ / ngur blug klad pa tsha dang sbang gar byug / khru gang 'og sa khur rtsa rus sna rnams/ / dri chu btsos bdugs rmen mi ldang bar byed/ /

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 63 bzhi ba/ khong 'brasakyi spyi dang bye brag gi bcosathabs/khong 'bras smin nas gso ba dka' ba'i phyir/ / smin du mi gzhug gsar dus gso ba sgrims/ / dang po smyung byas bong nga byi tang ga / dug nyung sgron shing pho ba ris bskol blud/ / stobs che spos dkar dur byid a ru ra/ / hong len drod sman ba chu sbyar bas bkru/ / yang na nim ba tong len 'bras bu gsum/ / shing mngar pa tol dur byin kyi lce ba/ / sran chung khu ba mar bskol sbyang bar bya/ / skabs su 'jam rtsi nu ri ha spel btang / / kyi lce bsdus khur tig ta byi tsher ba/ / tsan dan gla sgang ut+pal skyu ru ra/ / lca ba ra mnye 'o ma mar bskol blud/ / brag zhun gu gul ba gcin mig la byug / ston ga'i 'bam po sos ga'i dbyi mong gnyis/ / khan byas te sna ma tshig pa la/ / bu ram btab bsres rgya tshwa kha ru tsha/ / tsha ba gsum sbyar ril bu khye'u sus bsten/ / 'jam rtsir btang zhing phyi nas dmigs la byugs/ / drod la bsgor zhing yang na 'ju sla bsten/ / zhig rtags mthong nas gang nye rtsa nas drang / / 'khru na sman thun bskyed pas khong 'bras 'joms/ / des ma sel na a ru ba chur bsdus/ / gong bzhin khar+shas tsha grang gang yang 'joms/ / tha ma se 'bru'i sbyor bas nad rjes bcad/ / khyad par brag zhun a ru spos dkar gsum/ / gzhir bzhag glo la cu gang shing mngar bsnan/ / tsan dan dzā ti skyu ru zho sha snying / / mchin par ba sha ka dang gur kum bsnan/ /mcher bar pi pi ling dang li shi bsnan/ / mkhal mar btsod dang sug smel sdig srin bsnan/ / pho bar kha ru tsha dang bca' sga bsnan/ / rgyu

yo bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigalong rgyam tsha gser gyi me tog bsnan/ / lhang bar sdig srin gzhang la ni rus bsu/ / don snod gar babs rang rang rtsa la gtar/ / smin nas rang don nad de btang snyoms bzhag / nang nas smin tshe phyir 'byung rma ltar gso/ / rlung 'bras khrus btang rtsa ba lnga bskol blud/ / khrag mkhris pu shel tse btsod 'bras bu gsum/ / shel ta shing mngar yur skyes spa shug 'bru/ / sman mar bza' byug gang nye'i rtsa la gtar/ / bad kun sbyangs rjes dur byin yung ba nas/ / skyer ba til byug bye 'das me yis bsreg / mtshon 'bras mang gtar lums dang rul gcod sbyar/ / chu lums me btsa' shin tu bsngags par 'dod/ /lnga ba/ nam tshong yan gyi 'brasand dmasna 'brasadang so'abras/ gre 'brasakyi brtag bcosabashad pa/1 sna la 'bras byung sna nad sha lu yin/ brud dang gcod sman gtar lums skem gyis bcos/ phal cher 'tsho dka' sngon gyi las nad yin/ zhes sna la 'bras byung na sna nad sha lud yin te thog mar 'bras bcos pa ltar gyi cha byad kyis brud pa dang / de rjes rgya tshwa rgyam tsha la sogs kyi gcod sman 'debs shing sna rtse gtar/ mi'i rkang mgo dang nya 'a spru nag gi rtsa ba/ re lcag sogs chang la btsos pa'i lums bya zhing /mthar chu ser sman sogs kyi skem gyis bcos dgos kyang phal cher 'tsho dka' ba ste sngon gyi las nad yin no/ /2 so 'bras so rtsar spangs shing rnag tu 'gyur/ bcos thabs srub ka rgya tshwa na sham byugs/ rnyil nad ltar bcos ma phan brud la bsreg

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 65 2 gre 'bras phyi nang myur skrangs rnag tu 'gyur/ bcos thabs gre 'bras dugs lums gtar rjes bsreg rna shal 'og shong me btab ro mi ldang / zhes gre 'bras la mkhan pa spru ma nya khu'i dugs lums bya zhing lce rtsa rtse chung gang nye gtar rjes 'bras gang byung bsreg cing slar yang rna shal 'og gi gshong du me btab na ro mi ldang ngo / /le'u gsum pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdusapa dang de'i rang 'grel lasa'abrasand kyi rnam bshad/da ni khong 'bras kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya ste/ / kha zas khengs bu rab tsha dang / / rtsub dang skam dang tsha 'gyur zos/ / nyal ba'i spyod pa mi bde bas/ / khrag nad skyed 'gyur de dang des/ / pags pa sha tshul nus pa dang / / khrag dang chu ba chu ba che/ / phyi dang nang du skrangs gyur pa/ / rtsa ba che zhing nad tshabs che/ / zlum po'am 'jong par gnas pa gang / / khong 'bras de ni rnam pa drug / nad dmigs sna re 'dus pa dang / / khrag dang smas pa las byung ba'o/ /'dir phyi'i yan lag de dang der/ rab na mdud pa 'dra la mtho/ / nang gi shin tu mi bzad cing / / gting ring skran ltar sra ba yin/ / grog mkhar lta bur mtho ba dang / / me dang mtshon ltar myur gsodabyed/ / lte ba chu so mchin mcher pa/ / glo dang snying lto brla rtsa dang / / mkhal ma gnyis sam gzhang du'ang 'byung / / de la rlung gyur

66 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigand tshabs drag / dmar nag ring zhig lon nas ni/ / 'byung zhing smin pa dbyibs mi snyoms/ / ran zhing mgo 'khor sbos pa dang / / g.yo zhing 'pho la sgra dang bcas/ / mkhris gyur zangs ltar dmar rtsa gnag / skom dang tsha rims rmongs bag skyed/ / ldang zhing smin pa myur ba yin/ / bad kun las skya g.ya' dang bcas/ / slon zhing bsil la sla ba dang / / glal zhing lci la yi ga 'chus/ / 'byung zhing smin pa yun ring thogs/ / 'dus pa las gyur 'dren ma yin/ / 'dir ni phyi nang gnyis mtshan nyid/ / don gyi dbang las shes par bya/ / 'brum bu nag pos khebs shing gnag / rab tsha na zhing rims kyis 'debs/ / mkhris pa'i rtags ldan phyi'am nang / / khrag gyur bud med nyid la 'byung / /mtshon la sogs pas sman pa yis/ / rma byung mi 'phrod bsten pa las/ /rma kha'i tsha ba rlung gis phul/ / khrag bcas mkhris pa 'byung bar byed/ /khong 'bras bla brnan nad mang zhing / / khrag mkhris mtshan nyid can dag /da/ / bla brnan de yi dbye ba yang / / gnas kyi dbye ba las bshad lte bar byung na skyigs bu ste/ / chu sor gcin 'gags rnag tu 'gyur/ / mcher pa dbugs mi bde mchin par/ / dbugs 'byung 'gag skom mgo 'khor 'gyur/ / glo bar byung na lkog nad 'gyur/ /snying byung yan lag kun gzir snyam/ / rab rmongs mun sros snyam du byed/ / snying 'phar na bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lto ba rtsib logs phrag pa'i bar/ / na zhing lto sbos 'byung bar 'gyur/ / chu so mdoms bar byung brla na/ / mkhal mar byung na rked pa rgyab/ / rtsib logs su ni na bar

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 67 'gyur/ / gzhang du rlung ni thur 'byung 'gags/ / zhu dang ma zhu phyed nyid zhu/ / de dag 'or nad lta bur bshad/ /lte ba yan chad smin khar 'dzag / lte ba man chad gzhang du 'dzag /lte bar gnas pa gnyis kur 'dzag / khong 'bras kyi ni nad dmigs rnams/ / 'dzag las rma ltar shes par bya/ / de las 'dus pa las gyur dang / / snying dang lte ba chu sor gnas/ / phyi lam nang du bye ba'am/ / smin te kha nas 'dzag pa ni/ / nyam chung bla brnan ldan pa spang / / de bzhin bud med bu btsas pa'am/ / sbrum ma'am nu zho yod pa dang / / nu zho med pa'i nu ma yi/ / rtsa sgo kha byer phyin gyur nas/ / phyi yi khong 'bras mtshan nyid can/ / skrang zhing sra ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bu mo rnams kyi nu rtsa'i sgo/ / phra bas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / rlung ni rgyu lam 'gags pas 'khrugs/ / skrang dang gzer ni skyed cing rgyu/ /da ni khong 'bras kyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ khong 'bras ma smin thams cad la/ / 'on nad lta bur gso ba dang / / rgyun du khrag ni dbyung bar bya/ / smin pa la ni rma ltar gso/ / rlung shas che la rtsa ba lnga/ / bskol bas rma ni bkru ba dang / / thang shing sogs sde shing mngar dang / / til sbyar rgyam tshas rma bsku bya/ / bkru sman dang ni ldan pa yi/ / dur byid kyis ni rnam sbyangs shing / / bi da ri yi sde bskol ba'i/ / dur byid kyis ni rma 'byor bya/ / mkhris gyur 'o ma can chus bkru/ / sle tres shing mngar til gyis bsku/ / btsod dang rgya shug pu shel tse/ / pa ya su dang ser po gnyis/ / 'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar dang / / 'o mar bcas pas rma 'byor bya/ / yang na n+ya gro dha sogs

68 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapa'i/ / myu gu shun pa 'bras bu bsku/ / bad kun las gyur dong ga'i chus/ / bkru zhing phye dang ser po gnyis/ / dur gyid dang ni til gyis bsku/ / yang na rgya sran dan ti yi/ / sha ma dur byid tsi tra ga seng phrom rgyam tsha ba gcin bcas/ / til mar gyis ni rma 'tshob bya/ / khrag dang glo bur las gyur ba/ / mkhris pa'i khong 'bras lta bur gso/ / ma smin nang du byung ba la/ / ba ra ṇa sogs sde bskol bar/ / u sha ka yi sde tshan btab/ / snga dro khong 'bras can la blud/ / bkru sman bcas par bskol ba'i mar/ / de gnyis dang ni ldan par blud/ / ni ru ha dang snum 'jam rtse/ / de dag gnyis la sbyar bar bya/ / bza' dang btung dang bsku ba dang / / sbrang rtsi na le sham dkar sbyar/ / nad dmigs ji bzhin blud na ni/ /khong 'bras ma smin 'joms par byed/ /kyi lce nim pa 'bras bu gsum/ / shing mngar pu tse shel cha mnyam/ / dur gyid pa to la'i rtsa ba/ / re re cha ni bzhi par bya/ / sran chung spun pa med srang brgyad/ / de bskol mar dang bcas pa blud/ / khong 'bras skran dang me dbal dang / / lus tsha rmongs bag myos rims 'debs/ / skom dang brgyal slon snying nad dang / / khrag mkhris mig ser mdze nad 'dzems/ /kyi lce ba ni phul gang dag / brgyad 'gyur chu ru bskol nas ni/ / de yi khu ba phul gang dang / / skyu ru ra yi khu ba dang / / 'o ma mar ni phul re dang / / tig ta byi tsher kra yan ti/ / gla sgang ra mnye ta ma la/ / tsan+dan ut+pal dzi ban ti/ / gcig tu bsdus te bskol ba yi/ /mar de yon tan snga mar mtshungs/ / rgun 'brum 'bra go ma du ka / bi da ri dang nye shing bcas/ / pa ru sha ka 'bras bu gsum/ / de btsos khu

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 69 ba mngar bskol la/ / 'o ma bu ram shing kun dang / / skyu ru ra yi khu ba dang / / a ru ra yi lde gur bcas/ / bskol te bsgrangs pa de nang du/ / kha ra sbrang rtsi bzhi char btab/ / yon tan snga ma 'drar shes bya/ / nad dmigs ji bzhin rngabs rwa sogs/ / yang na gtar gas khrag dbyung bya/ / khong 'bras smin par gyur pa la/ / khong par gnas pa phyir 'bur bar/ / shes nas de ni bcing bar bya/ / gzer ba der gnas gong bur 'dug / de ngos btsir bas tshor ba chung / / tsha ba la sogs chung gyur na/ / smin pa yin pas khong 'bras ni/ / brtol te rma ltar gso bar bya/ / nang gi char gnas khong 'bras ni/ / smin pa'i mtshan ma'ang 'di nyid yin/ / smin nas bu ga rnams gyur te/ / de ni steng ma 'og tu dbyung / / rang nyid rdol ba'i nad de ni/ / zan phan byin zhing btang snyoms gzhag / zhag bcu'am bcu gnyis bar du ni/ / sman pas bla brnan las bsrung bya/ / rnag ni legs par mi 'dzag na/ / ba ra ṇa sogs chu dron nam/ / shi kru sbrang rtsi blud pa'am/ / de dang sbyar ba'i nas thug blud/ / rgya shug rgya sran nas kyi ni/ / yu sha dang ni bza' ba sngags/ /zhag bcu yan chad kyi lce ba/ / mar ram seng phrom dag gis ni/ /nyams stobs ji bzhin sbyang bar bya/ / sbyangs nas tig ta sbyang rtsi blud/ / 'di la kun kyang skran lta bur/ / nad thabs ji bzhin gso bar bya/ / khong 'bras kun dang gnas skabs dang / / thams cad du ni gu gul gtang / / de bzhin brag zhun rang rang gi / sbyor bar bcas te khu ba blud/ / 'bad de smin pa las bsrung bya/ / smin na shin tu gso

70 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadaka' yin/ / gzhan yang myur du tsha byed pas/ / khong 'bras zhes ni de la bshad/ / gal te gcin snyi las gyur na/ / gcin snyi ba yi gso bar bya/ / nu mar byung la 'di ltar ni/ / mi bcing thams cad rma ltar gso/ / dbral tshe nu zho 'dzag pa dang / / nu sor nag por mi gnod k+tañjadī zho/ / ma smin gnas skabs thams cad du/ / de yi nu zho btsir da ni khong 'bras gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ de la 'bras so cog ma smin pa'i tshe na ni spangs pa gso ba'i cho ga ltar so so'i rtags dang mthun par gtar ga bya ste khrag dbyung ngo / / smin zin pa la ni dral la rma gso ba'i cho ga ltar bya'o/ /de nas rlung las gyur pa'i rma la ni rtsa ba lnga dang lan tshwa shas che ba dang bskol ba'i chus rma bkru bar bya'o/ / gzhan yang me pa da ru'i sde tshan dang / shing mngar dang lan tshwa dang til dang lhan cig sbyar bas rma bkru'o/ / yang na bkru sman gang yang rung ba'i nang du dri bi tsa btab ste/snum chen po bzhi gang yang rung ba bsres te blud la khrus byas te lus dag parabya'o/ / de nas rma 'drub par bya ba'i phyir ba da ri'i sde tshan dang dur byid bsres pas rma bsku bar bya'o/ / mkhris pa'i rma la ni n+ya gro dha la sogs pa'i 'o ma can gyi shing las byung ba'i 'o mas bkru bar bya'o/ / de nas shing mngar dang / til dang / a ru ra 'di gsum gyis bsku'o/ /rma 'drub par bya ba'i phyir btsod dang / pu shel tse dang / shug pa dang /pa ya su dang / ser po rnam gnyis dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / shing mngar 'di rnams 'o ma dang lhan cig bskol te 'o ma ni du mar ni lus pa

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 71 bsku'o/ yang n+ya gro dha'i sde tshan gyi shing dang / 'o ma dang / 'bras bu dang / shun pa dang / mar bskol bas bskus na 'drub par 'gyur ro/ / bad kun las gyur pa la ni dong gra'i sde tshan skol bas rma bkru'o/ / de nas phye dang ser po rnam gnyis dang / shing nye rong dang /til mar dang 'di rnams kyis bsku'o/ / yang na rgya sran dang / dan da dang / sha ma dur byin dang / kru trug tres dang / seng phrom dkar po dang / rgyam tsha dang / til dang ba gcin dang sbyar bas bskus na rma 'brub par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du glo bur du snad pa'am khrag las gyur pa'i 'bras la ni mkhris pa las gyur pa la ji ltar gso ba bzhin du bya'o/ /khong 'bras nang du ma smin pa la ni mar gyi sde tshan bskol ba'i nang du u sha ma'i sde tshan gyi phye mas btab ste bad kun gyi dus las mol ba dang blud par bya'o/ / yang na bkru sman gang yang rung ba mar dang sbyar ba'i nang du gong gi sman sde tshan gnyis kyi phye mas btab pa blud do/ / yang na nad ma smin pa la ni bkru sman drag po dang / 'jam rtsi mas gtang bya ste de yang gong gi sde tshan gnyis las nad gzhi gong dang mthun pa sbyar mas gtangabya'o/ / dang por nad ji lta ba bzhin du sbrang rtsi dang na le sham dkar pos btab pa'i bza' ba dang btung ba dang bsku ba byas sam blud na khong 'bras ma smin pa 'joms par byed do/ / gzhan yang kyi lce ba dang / shing mngar dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / nim pa dang / pu shel tse 'di rnams cha snyoms pa dang / dri ba ta dang / pa ta la'i rtsa ba 'di gnyis kyi lce ba'i gzhi 'gyur dang / sran chung de'i brgyad 'gyur

72 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigarnams chu dang tshul bzhin bskol nas blud na khong 'bras dang / skran dang / me dbal dang / lus tsha ba dang / dran pa nyams pa dang / sa bon mangs pa dang / skom dad che ba dang / brgyal ba dang / slon pa dang / snying na ba dang / mdze dang / mig ser gyi nad dang 'di rnams la phan no/ / yang na kyi lce ba srang bzhi chu sung sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bskol te bzhi cha lus pa dang / skyur ba'i khu ba srang bzhi dang / 'o ma srang bzhi dang / mar srang bzhi dang / tig ta dang / tra yan ti dang /byi tsher ba dang / gla sgang dang / ta ma la gi dang / ra mnye ba dang / dzi ban ti dang / tsan+dan dang ut+pal dang / 'di rnams zho gnyis re cham chom brdungs la gcig tu bskol la mar 'ba' zhig lus pa blud pa'am/yang na rgun 'bru 'am/ ma du ga'i me tog dang / 'bra go dang / bi ta ri dang / nye'u shing dang / pa ru sha dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / 'di rnams bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du mar dang / 'o ma dang / bu ram shing gi khu ba dang / skyur po dang 'di rnams cha mnyam ste a ru ra'i phye mas btab nas bskol la mar lus pa dang grang ba'i nang du sha kha ra dang /sbrang rtsi dang mar gyi bzhi cha dang bsres nas blud na phan yon gong ma dang 'dra bar shes bar bya'o/ /de la nad tshabs che chung dang sbyar bas gang skrangs pa'i steng du rngabs rwa dang / ku ba dang / srin bu pad pa dang gsum gyis khrag dbyung ba'am/ yang na gtar ga 'di bzhi gang yang rung pas khrag dbyung ngo / / de la 'bras che chung 'dra bar smin pa'i mtshan ma ni phyi rol du 'bur bar snang ste/ de yang phyogs gcig tu 'dus pa dang 'dug ste/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 73 steng du lag pas reg na rab tu na zhing mnan na gshong bar 'dug la lus tsha bar byed do/ / de la ni gong gi bkru sman gyis byug go / de la 'bras smin pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas mtshon gyis dral te rma gso ba'i cho ga bstan par bya'o/ /khong 'bras nang du smin pa'i mtshan ma yang de ltar blta'o/ / khong 'bras smin nas gong 'og tu mched par byed do/ / de yang smin nas myur bar dpyad ma byas pa dang / kha zas mi mthun pa zos pa'i nyes pas rma skrangs pa mched cing 'brul bar 'gyur ro/ / de yang zhag bcu gnyis kyi bar du gong 'og tu mi mched par bya ba'i cho gas bsrung bar bya ste/de yang bar na la sogs pa'i sde tshan bskol ba'i khu ba dro 'jam tsam 'am/yang na shi kru dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'am/ yang na nas dang / rgya shug dang /rgya sran gyi khu ba btung ba'am/ bza' ba'am/ btung ba ni rab tu bsngags so/ / zhag bcu nas ni kyi lce la sogs pa'i mar gong du smos pa'am/ yang na seng phrom dkar po dang sbyar ba'i mar gong du rlung gi skabs su bstan pa blud la sman gyi stobs kyis nad 'jil bar bya'o/ /de nas tig ta'i mar mdze nad kyi skabs su bstan pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba cung zad sbyin no/ / skran gyi bcos thabs ji rnyed 'byung ba thams cad khong 'bras la yang thabs des gso bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang khong 'bras kyi nad thams cad la gu gul dang / brag zhun gnyis gang yang rung bas zas dang sman thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /khong 'bras ni smin du mi gzhug ste/ mi smin pa'i cho ga la 'bad par bya'o/ / ci ste smin na ni shin tu nyen che ste gso bar dka'o/ / khong

74 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'abras zha phas bya ba ni myur du smin par byed pa'i rang bzhin yin no/ /'bras khong du na zhing tsha ba la ni legs par brtags te gcin snyi ba'i nad gso ba bzhin du 'di yang thabs de ltar gso bar bya'o/ /bud med kyi nu mar 'bras byung ba la ni smin par bya ba'i cho ga mi bya ste/ rma'i skabs las 'byung ba'i dpyad bzhin bya'o/ / myur du smin na shas che ba dang 'jam pa'i phyir tshabs cher 'drul ba'i skyon no/ / rang smin pa dang nu sor gyi mtha' skor gnag mtshams kyi nang rol tu mtshon mi gdab par bsrung ste/ gzhan yang gang yang rung bar mtshon gyis dral ba'i las bya'o/ / 'bras de na yang rung mi na yang rung / smin yang rung ma smin yang rung ste/ rtag tu nu ma las bzho bar bya'o/ / de nas shing nye rong gi phye mas rlung shas che ba'i nad yin na ni snum shas cher btab ste byin la khrus byas te lus dag par bya'o/ / de la snum ni 'di dag ste/ a mra'i 'bras bu'i sman mar ram e raṇ+ḍa'i sman mar ram su gu ma da'i sman mar ram/ mi tra ga'i sman mar ram 'di rnams kyi mar gang rnyed pa dang sbyar ro/ / de nas rlung las gyur pa la phan pa'i sman tshogs zhib tu btags te chu dang mar tshul bzhin bskol te chu du mar lus pa dang / bkru sman drag po mas gtang ba'i thabs du mas gtang bar bya'o/ / de nas sha khu dang bcas pa'i zas sbyin no/ / de'i 'og tu shing mngar gyi phye til dang bskol bas lus bsku bar bya'o/ /rlung las gyur pa'i 'bras smin pa la ni rlung la phan pa'i sman dang dugs dang bsku byug la sogs pa bya ste/ smin nas dral la rma gso ba'i cho ga ltar bya'o/ / mkhris pa dang / khrag las gyur pa ma smin pa la ni gong

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 75 du bgrang ba'i cho ga bstan pa bzhin bya'o/ / smin nas dral la rma gso ba'i cho ga ltar bya'o/ / rtag tu bar ma chad par khrag kyang dbri'o/ /bad kun las gyur pa la ni skyer ba'i phye ma gcin dang sbyin no/ / sbyin par bya ba'i cho ga ma gtogs pa phye ma bad kun las gyur ba'i 'bras gso ba'i cho ga rnams 'dir bya'o/ /bad kun las gyur pa'i 'bras rang smin pa'i tshe na ni dral te/ su ma na'i me tog dang / go bye dang / ang go la na sadha paṇa dang / pa to la dang / nim pa dang / yung ba dang / byi dang ga dang / dug mo nyung dang / 'di rnams til mar dang sbyar la rma dag par bya ba'i phyir blud pa ni rab tu bsngags so/ /tshil las gyur pa'i nu ma'i nad la ni byi'u dug pa'i sde tshan btags te ba gcin dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na klad pa bkru ba'i sman btags pas dugs byas la smin pa dang / nu sor gyi mtha' nag por mtshon gyis mi gdab ste phyi rol nas gtsags bus legs par dral nas rnag phyung la sbrang rtsi dang rgyam tsha dang nag tshur sbyar bas rma bkrus te dar skud kyis btsem mo/ tshil las gyur pa'i nu ma'i rma dag par bya ba'i phyir ldong ros dang / ba bla dang / su ma na dang / pi pi ling mu la dang / go bye dang / 'di rnams til mar dang dro 'jam tsam sbyar bas rma bsdo'o/ / ji srid rma ma 'drub kyi bar du snum dang bcas pa'i dugs bya / chu/ so'i gnas su 'bras byung ba la ni ras snum can gyis dugs byas la ras kyis sked par bcing ngo / / de'i 'og tu bshang ba'i sgo dang /

76 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'abras bu'i bar srubs breng breng 'og tu 'bru'i kha 'dra ba'i mtshon gyis dral te/ rnag 'dzag tu 'dzug la dmu rdzing gso ba'i thabs bzhin du dbug pa dang / sbu gu'i rma bkag pa rnams bcing ba dang / sman gyis dag par byas nas rma 'drub pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /khong 'bras long ga'am rgyu ma la 'byung ste rlig pa'i 'og tu phyin pa dang / rlung las gyur pa'i 'bras gso ba'i cho ga bzhin du bya'o/ /gzhan yang ba spru ba sung brgyad dang / rtsa ba bcu ba dang / a sha gan dha dang / e raṇ+ḍa dang / nye'u shing dang / rtsa drur ba rnam gnyis dang /'dam bu dang / rtsa ku sha dang / bu ram shing gi rtsa ba dang / ma ta ka la dang / 'di rnams kyi rtsa ba re re la yang srang bcu bcu cham chom brdungs te chu srang nyis stong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang bskol la srang nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug lus pa dang phyir phyung la btsags te grang ba'i nang du bu ram srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang 'o ma bre do dang / er ṇ+ḍa'i mar bre do'i nang du pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / lce myang tsha dang / shing mngar dang / la la phud dang / rgun 'brum dang / dong gra dang / 'di rnams lhan cig tu bskol la/ 'o ma du mar lus pa ni su ku ma ru zhes bya ba'i bcud kyis len pa yin te/ sman mar 'di ni tsha ba dang / rlung dang / lam du 'gro ba dang / bzhon pa la sogs pa la 'gro ba'i tshe yang bsrung mi dgos par bza'o/ / de yang gzhon nu rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / bud med rnams dang / skyid de ba rnams dang / bud med mang po'i khyim thabs rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ / dpal skyed pa dang / rtsod pa zlog parakhyed de/ rtag tu bsten na sdug cing mdzes pa dang lus sha skyed pa

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 77 dang / de bzhin du rlig rlugs dang / khong 'bras dang / skran dang /gzhang 'brum dang / mo mtshan dang / pho mtshan gyi nad dang / rlung nad kyis nyam thag pa dang / skrang pa dang / dmu rdzing dang / dreg dang //chin pa na ba dang / rtug skam 'di rnams zhi bar byed pa'i mchog yin gzhang la khong 'bras 'byung ba la ni snum 'chos dang / khrus dang /'jam rtsi mas gtong la sogs pas thog mar zhi bar byas la des zhi bar ma nus na dang po yang 'jam rtsi byas te rgyu zhabs kyi spu mtshams g.yas g.yon du mtshon zla ba bkas pa lta bu bsregs pas dbug la/ rlung gis 'gags pa de dal gyis dbyung ngo / / de la dbug pa'i tshad ni sman pa kha cig na re mthe bong gi tshigs dang po nub pa tsam zabs su gtang ngo zhes zer ro/ / dral ba ni dang po pags pa phug la mthe bong gis rma kha'i pags pa bteg ste de nas de'i 'og tu mtshon gyi rtse mo drang por zabs su mi gtang bar rtse mo lte ba phyogs su tshad bzhin du gtang ngo / / yang na sman pa kha cig na re mchin pa'i khong 'bras la ni bad kun dang rlung gi khong 'bras gso ba'i thabs ltar bya'o/ / sman pa kha cig na re/ mthe chung dang / srin lag gi tshigs dang po'i tshad tsam gtang ngo / / zhes zer ro/ /

78 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigale'u bzhi ba/ som ra dzā las 'bras nad kyi rnam bshad/dang po/ 'brasand kyi rgyu rkyen dang / dbye ba/ nad rtags/de nas 'bras dang sur+ya ni/ / rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad kun no/ /rkyen ni mi gtsang klu yi nad/ / tsha dang lus kyi drag shul dang / / rims kyi tsha ba bcag ma legs/ / snad dang 'thems las byung ba dang / / sha sungs chang dag 'thungs las byung / / sha 'bras rtsa 'bras rus 'bras dang / / 'dre 'bras khrag 'bras rlung 'bras so/ / sha 'bras shin tu mkhrang bar skrangs/ / nyungs gsher dang 'dra nges ba med/ / rtsa 'bras rtsa dang nye bar skrangs/ / phal cher ske dang yan lag go / rus 'bras lkog ma brang rus dang / / sna dang khrum khrum pus mo dang / / phal cher de rnams/ dag tu'o/ / chu ba la zin bcos par dka'/ / 'dre 'bras dag la nges pa med/ / khrag 'bras gtar kha do ma snyoms/ / rus 'bras so dang rus pa la/ / sha 'bras mdzer pa bcad pa 'dra/ / rtsa 'bras la yang gnyis yod de/ / ston zla bzhin du 'phro ba dang / / rtsa 'bras sha sha men bu 'dra/ / rus 'bras spang la phur btab 'dra/ / rus pa shing la 'bus zos 'dra/ /gnyisapa/ 'brasand gsothabs/dang por 'bras kyi bcos pa ni/ / dang por gdul ba shin tu

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 79 gces/ / mi dang lug rta la sogs pa/ / lha ba can dag brdungs pa'i lums/ / kun la de yis gdul bar bya/ / yang na mtshe dang lan tshwas slongs/ / gdul ba dag ni shis pa ste/ / bsad pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ / sga dang pi pi ling dang ni/ / glum dang sbyar bas ('phral du skrangs ba 'tsho ba la/ / re lcag bcos ba'i dugs kyang bya/ / rus pa 'gog par dka' ba la/ / rag na rdo yi dugs kyang bya/ / sha chod dag na bya bra bcos ba'i dugs kyang bya)bsad pa'o/ / gso ba rnam pa gsum yin te/ / go stod g.yer ma bag phye'o/ / sha 'bras (sha 'bras bcos pa'i thabs/ / sman gyi sbyor ba 'di lta ste/ / dang po sngon po'i ril bu sbyar thabs la/ / thar nu'i lo ma dang / / dur byid thar nu re lcag /mtshal dang stag sha'i rtsa ba dang / / de rnams zhib btags lums kyis bsdu/ / ran tsam sman ni gtang bar bya/ skabs su thar nu'i ring so gtang / / des ni skyon rnams gcod pa'o/ / sha ru bskyed pa'i smag dag ni/ / rgu grus sha 'u ris dang ni/ / stag sha dang ni dom mkhris dang / /de rnams bu ram dag gis bsdu/ / sman rnams ran tsam gtang bar bya/ / de ni sha 'bras bcos pa'o/ / dbyi mong stag sha'i lo ma dang / /de rnams zhib btags mkhris pa ran tsam smad nas gtang bar bya/ /ser po ril bu sbyar thabs la/ / thar nu re lcag ldong ros sbyang rtsis bsdu bar bya/ /ril bu bya zhing shing mngar tshad mar gtang bar bya/ / de ni skyon can gcod pa'i sman/ / de ltar sha ro chod pa dang / / sha'u bskyed pa'i sman rnams gtang / / stod na skrangs na tsha ba'o/ / bya 'bras btsos pa'i dugs dag bya/ / gdul zhing rtsa 'bras ni/ / gtar ba dag gis

80 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigabacos pa'o/ / rus 'bras gdon zhing bsreg pa ni/ / rus pa dag la shin tu bsngags/ / bsreg pa lcags dang mer bya'o/ / rtsa la yang ni bsreg par bya/) rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa/ / rus pa dag la bsngags pa ste/ / dom mkhris mtshal dang phag mkhris ni/ / rtsa 'bras dag gi sman yin no/ / brag byi'u sha dag shin tu bsngags/ / mi mkhris phag mkhris gtang bar bya/ / sha 'bras dag la lan tshwa dang / / pi pi ling dang nye'u shing ba'o/ / rus pa spyi gtsug mtshog rgya sogs/ / bsreg pa shin tu gces pa'o/ / ske dang mkhal ma nu ma'i rtsa/ / gtar ba 'grams pas rtse'u chung gtar/ / nu ma snod kyi rtsa la gtar/ / pus mo brla phugs rtsa bo che/ / tshwa sna sman mar blugs pa'o/ / spod gsum til mar dag dang byug / khong du bzang po drug po gtang / / rtsa la btsod dang lca lo rtsa/ / chu chung rtsa ba 'dab ma dang / / gla ba'i khu ba phug ron brun/ /btsun mo re ral dag dang ni/ / lce pog dkar nag dag dang sbyar/ /rtsa dang rus pa sha yi gnad/ / kun gyi thun mong ma yin no/ / rus pa sha ni skrangs med par/ / na tsha che ba rus la zin/ / yung gsher 'khyags 'dra rus la zin/ / chu ser che bar rus la zin/ / chu ser dkar la skrangs pa ni/ / bad kun dag gi skrangs ba'o/ / nag la chu ser tshigs canarlung / / dmar ser tshad pa skye ba mkhris/ / dong ka dur byin ra dug pa/ / ldum rtsa re lcag pa dang ni/ / de rnams lde gus gdul bar bya/ / sha chos par ni bsreg par bya/ /

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 81 le'u lnga ba/ zur lugs kyi 'brasand gsoba'i sman sbyor brgyad/dang po/ zur mkhar ba'i khyad chosa'abrasasman nag po'i sbyor ba/rma a tha/ be+eḍūr+ya la na mo/ 'bras sman nag po'i sbyor ba la/ /mgon po (bong nga)nag po yan lag rags/ / thod skam (sharu)lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ / phyag na sbrul (dres thag)gyi zhags pa bsnams/ / dag byed (sug pa )lha mo li khri'i (sgroser)mdog / yab sum lnga sbyor ga lur gnas/ / me dpung 'bar (bsregs thal)ba'i dbus su bzhugs/ /thal bas sha ngo ma lus gcod/ / 'bras rigs kun la thengs sos yin/ / de stong so so'i kha sgyur ni/ / sha 'bras dbyi mong thar nu bsnan/ / rus 'bras bse 'brum dwa ba bsnan/ / rtsa 'bras chu drul rgyan 'brum bsnan/ / kun kyang mer gzhug rlangs pa bkag / dharmas 'gro la phan sems kyis/ / kong yul klu brag phu ru bris/ / 'dis kyang 'gro phan 'grub gyur cig /gnyisapa/ 'brasasman dung thalam/oṃ a tha/ bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ / 'bras bcos

82 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigagadams pa zab mo bri/ / rno gsum (sngo tsha ba gsum sgog skya dung )thal ba byang khra dang / / rgya tshwa mtshal dkar sbrang rtsod sbyar/ / ril bu rmar brdzangs rlangs pa bkag / 'di yis 'bras rigs gang yang gcod/ /de nas rus ro 'gogs pa ni/ / byang ba rgya tshwa thar nu'i thal/ / dung 'gron thal ba spyi zhur mtshal/ / gangs chu sbrang rgod gong bzhin sbyar/ /rus skyon che na btsan dug thal/ / dbyi mong khaṇ+ḍa sbyar byas na/ / rus skyon mo da la don par nges/ / de rjes sha'u gso ba ni/ / sha ru rta yi rje ngar thal/ / mkhris sna tshogs tshad mtshe yi phye/ / ka ra sbyar la btab na 'tsho/ / dge ba'i nad las thar bar shog /gsum pa/ 'brasabacosathang chu'i rdo sbyor/na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'bras bcos thang chu'i rdo sbyor yod/ / thang chu gsar ba legs bzhus la/ / thang phrom btsan dug thal ba dang / shu dag re lcag ka mo nya(thar nu)/ / srub ka re ral mtshal dkar dang / /mu zi bre ga rgu drus pa/ / star bu chu rtsa tha rams pa/ / ba yag 'bu sug nas ma dang / / stag sha byi'u sran mdung rtse dmar/ / sbal rgyab gangs thigs bye'u mgo dang / / g.ya' (byarag nor bu)ma nag mo ma rdzir (rdo phag mchin)/ / rdo rgyus rdo thal khab len dang / / cong zhi rigs lnga gang tshogs bsags/ / lug ru ser bo mde'u 'byin dang / / par pa te sbyar 'byar byas phan/ / thang chu ma 'dzoms mar nag la/ / dus chen gsum (dud pa ma shor nag tsam bsregs pa'i thal ba btab la gdu)bsregs thal ba dang / / 'di rnams sbyar (chu chod cing ro ma snag tsha 'dra/ de grang ba dang

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 83 sman bsre )bas mchog tu phan/ / dge bas 'bras nad zhi bar shog/bzhi ba/ zur mkhar ba'i khyad chosabad kun mid ltosabadud rtsi'i bumabacud/yo a tha/ sman bla drang srong mkhas la 'dud/ / ā tsa ra yi gdams pa mchog / dzā ti gsum bshal 'di la don gsum ste/ steng nas zla ba lta bu'i chu rgyun dang / bar du sman gyi zhal gdams/ 'og nas nyi ma lta bu drod thur du 'bebs pa'i thabs te/ 'di la nyi zla ga'u'i bshal 'debs zer/ dang bo rtsa sgo phye/ bar du nad sbyang / tha ma dpyad dang gsum las/ dang po dar tshul gyi thang btang / de nas ka lko la'i thang btang / de nas sga dang lcam pa'i thang btang / de nas rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ ro 'dzin gos dang bral ba yi/ / dzā ti pha la (dan rog)bdun nam dgu / na le sham dang sku la mnyam/ / zhib btags chu skol phul la btang / / 'khru na chu skol lcag gis brabs/ / 'di ni nyi zla'i rgyun bshal zer/ / bar gyi zhal gdams lde mig ni/ / dur byid se 'bru ka ko la/ / yang yang lcag gis bskul bar bya/ / 'og nas drod kyi 'bebs tshul la/ / (pad+martsa ri)gcig skyes sdor ldan bag tsam la/ / chu rtsa rus rnying khu ba su ra dang / /mi rta bong bu 'phyi ba'i rus pa rnams/ /btsos pa'i lums su 'og sgo dbyi rked gzhug / ma phan 'jam rtsi dang ni ni rus drang / / phan yon thur sel gyen log dang / / glang thabs dug dang ma zhu'i rigs/ / grang ba rtug skam mid 'chus sel/ / gcod ran 'bras dang zho yis bcad/ / mid 'chus nad las thar bar 'gyur/ /

84 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadharma sā mis yi ger bris/ / dge bas sdug bsngal nad sel shog /lnga ba/ zur mkhar ba'i ༅ chosa'abrasabacosa'abamapo'i sbyor ba/lko a tha/ dug gsum rgyu 'bras nad sel be+eḍū r+ya/ / drang srong rigs 'dzin brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ / khong gi 'bras dang srin rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ / zab mo'i man ngag 'di bzhin bri/ / ston ga'i 'bam po gsum gnyis la/ / sos ku'i dbyi mong sum cha sbyar/ /zhag gcig chur sbangs khaṇ+ḍa bya/ / 'bri mar mar khu phul do btang / /bur dkar bya sgong lnga tsam gdab/ / yun du dkrugs la kha tshwar ni/ /rgya tshwa kha ru lce myong rgyam tshwa rnams/ / tshad ldan sbyar na gtong ba bdud rtsi 'dra/ / tsha ba'i skran dang 'bras la 'di lta ste/ / gtso bo gnyis dang a ru rdog po lnga/ / khaṇ+ḍa tshul bzhin byas la gong gi kha tshar gdab/ / nyin mtshan dus gnyis bya sgong re re bsten/ /chung 'bring chen po rigs pos dpyad la gtang / / zhib btags pho ba bde la chu skyur chod/ / gyen thung gnyis nas 'bras skran ro ma 'byung / / de bzhin byung na gtar ga mi dgos te/ / ma byung stod du gnas na ru thung gtar/ / smad du gnas na lo rtsa gtar ba bsngags/ / sman ma zhi na drod dugs rgya tshwa btang / / zhig nas skran 'bras bshal gyis sbyang / / gtar sreg gang dgos tsha grang skabs dang bstun/ / brang ti'i thengs sos nyams yig 'di/ / dharma swā mis gsal byas nas/ / phyi rabs don du bris pa dge/'bam po sribs dang rdza la skye/ / lo ma lcam pa'i dbyibs can kha dog

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 85 nag po sdong bu khong stong bong ring ba me tog spru ba dkar bo 'dra ba la de las che ba bcad na 'o ma 'dzag pa la dri ma che ba ro cung zad tsha ba yod/ces gsungs so/ /drug pa/ zur mkhar ba'i 'brasasman non po lnga sbyor/rma a tha/ mkhas dbang gu ṇa'i zhabs pad 'dud/ / rnon po lnga sbyor man ngag bri/ / cong zhi sga skya 'om mo se/ / thar nu ngur thod kong bur blugs/ / bye mas dud pa ma shor ba/ / sol mer bcug la nus ldan bsreg / tshos tshad nam mkha'i me tog yin/ / sngo 'am nag na gus pa med/ / de phyir gzhogs sgyur nyin yun bsregs/ / thal ba de la kha sgyur ni/ / 'bras nad sha rus gar song yang / / bra ba rna dmar sha dang sbyar/ / mdzer ba'i rigs la sbrul sha bsnan/ / sha ro gcod na ldong ros bsnan/ / 'bras dang mdzer ba sha ro la/ / 'di las zab pa log na med/ / dharma swā mis khyad chos yin/ /bdun pa/ zur mkhar ba'i 'brasabacosagasang ba myur lam/rma a tha/ ye shes mkha' 'gros gnang ba'i gdams pa 'di'i byed lugs la/ / cong zhi bre gang zhib btags la/ / 'o ma bre do dag la gdu/ / de nas sbrang rtsi bre gang gdab/ / 'di rnams tshos tshad ran pa dang / / pi pi ling ni khyor ba do/ / gur kum brag zhun thun gnyis gnyis/ / kha tshar btab la legs par dkrugs/ / de rjes ngad pa yal ba dang / / zangs rtsi ba dang zangs thal dang / / dom mkhris rnams ni

86 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigazhib btags la/ / ngad yal dus su kha tshar gdab/ / de ni lto stong ran par za/ / rjes su chu ni sri byung na/ / bong bu nag po'i sgro ba dang / / rgya mtsho gser gyi bye ma gnyis/ / thang du btang na chu sri sel/ / gtar sreg dpyad ni mi bya zhing / / sha dul btsong sgog spang par bya/ / 'di ltar byas pas 'bras la phan/ / gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes yin/ / yi ger gdab par mi rigs te/ / dharma swā mis bris pa'o/ /brgyad pa/ 'brasasman zab mo/oṃ su ste/ 'bras nad gso ba'i man ngag ni/ / zhum me dha (ali sha)sha ra tshil sbyar/ / sman (bde bas khog mar bzhu/ rlangs pa bkag)la btang la de nang gzhug / g.yer ma bsros la khong du btang / / 'bras //sa ma lus 'di yis 'joms/ / dge bas lhan skyes nad sel le'u drug pa/ 'bri gung gces bsdus las 'bras nad kyi brtag bcos/dang po/ rusa'adulaman ngag dang phyi 'brasakyi sad mda'/reng bu/ 'debasasman/ byug sman/ gshagasabacos/rus 'dul zab mo'i man ngag bstan pa la/ mi rta khyi phag sha rus

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 87 btsa' ma lnga/ nya phyis dung mgron nya dus 'brug rus lnga/ rus sna bcu yin chu ser sman brgyad ni/ so thal gnyis dang til gnyis zi ra gnyis/gu dkar nag gnyis re rnam pa brgyad/ de rnams cha nyams zhib btags logs su bzhag dben pa'i gnas su rdza ma'i snod nang du/spos dkar cha gcig tsha la cha gsum ni/ gar chang cha gnyis la bsings sman kun dang / ji ltar 'tsham pa'i 'bru mar rnying pa blug gdon gyi lud phyir 'grul bsrung sol me la/ dkrugs shing bsdus te gar lhang song ba'i tshe/ gong gi phye ma btab la ma 'dregs dkrugs/ dro 'jam dril btub dus su rdo steng byo/ gtun brdungs 'them byas spu rdul mi 'chor ba'i/ snod nang bcings la dkris ma byed pa'i tshe/ me nyir bsros te rma steng dar gyis bkab/ de steng rus 'dul glan la skyi dkar dkris/dkris ma brje dus rnag dang chu ser rnams/ chu dron gyis bkrus 'di yi phan yon ni/ chu ser grang babs rma gsar rma rnying dang / 'bras bu spangs pa rnag tu 'gugs pa dang / rtsa chad rus chag rma yi thab sogs la/gnyen po 'di mtshungs med de kun la gsang / sha rus rtsa yi 'bras nad kun/ the tshom sman gyis brtag pa ni/ gu gul dkar nag ldong ros dang /ba bla mu zi mtshal rnams mnyam/ rma can rma med dogs sar byugs/min na sman de mi 'byar zhing / yin na byugs shul sha ro 'gyur/ dmar mkhrang reg na brtse dang rnag chu 'dzag re ba de re 'ga' na la bcos bskyed chung / de yang 'bras yin gsang ba'i sman gcig gi shun pa rdza nang ma tshig btsan skam bya/ de nyid cha gnyis kha tshar cha gcig ni/ dar tshur tshur dkar ba bla ldong ros mtshal/ rgya tshwa 'jib bu pad ma dkar

88 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadamar dang / tshwa gsum rdo thal shu dag sbrang rtsi sbyar/ reng bu rmar gzhug rma khar skyi lhan 'geb/ dus skyon che na gtso bo cha gsum la/ rdo thal mtshal thal mtshur ldong rgya tshwa dang / dar tshur byang ba dung mgron phur thal dang / shu dag gri rus gla rtsi thal ba gsum/ sbrang smyon reng bur gar yod gnas su bskyal/ shu gcod rus 'gog zug rngu sel bar byed/gso sman gtso bo cha gcig gur kum mtshal/ shing mngar yung ba chu rtsa stag dom dkar/ phyi ma rma chas dbyar dgun dus dang sbyar/ rus sman sde bzhi bzang drug gsang sman gnyis/ gla dom dar tshur sha skyi rtsa gsum dang / ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma rma khar btab/ nad rgyu khrag yin gang nye yang yang gtar/ skrangs po rngabs ras 'jib la khrag ngan dbyung /nad rkyen gnyan yin khong sman rtsa ltos sbyangs/ nad dngos 'bras yin lums 'dul chu tshan gzhug dur rus rnying ba tshil zad nas tsam brdungs/ sla ngar rdza srub du ba ma shor bsreg phye ma zhib btags mar nag spos dkar sbyar/ me chung yun du bsdu tshad snag tsha 'dra/ ngal yal tshe na sbal mdung cog la ma/ gtso bo tsha la cong zhi bzang po yi/ phyi ma btab dkrugs nad dmigs khyab par byugs/ tel ge bkab bzhag zhag gsum song nas spo/ kun gyis phan dkar rus 'bras la/ dra bcos bya ba mkhas pa'i lugs/ gnyan pa'i gnad rnams phal cher la/nad 'khrugs che na gnad dang bstun/ khyad par 'bras nad 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ gnad la 'dzem bag bya mi dgos/ rus pa sbos dang de steng du/khab btsugs tshor ba med pa'i sar/ the tshom med par skyon che steng /nang nas khong srung gsum yar btang / bla gnas sar 'dzem gri non ni/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 89 sel mes tshos bsreg tsha dras byas/ de nas sha rus phyed par phye/ chu grang rgyun bran ser mo sogs/ btab kyang reg bya nyams bar bran/ rjes la spra ba snum btsos brdzangs/ de steng sha gsar dmar po ni/ gri gtsags byas pa'i 'byar gyis mnan/ khrag chad zhag lon kha phye la/ snyung bu rno bas rus skyon rnams/ cung zad ma lus brud cing brdar/ 'di dus snying stobs bskyed par bya/ de nas gso ba'i sman byas shing / nad tshabs 'bring la lcags bsreg ga tel pa gsor gyis tshos par bsregayang na spras tshugs brgya stong bsregs/ de nas btsog sman gso sman ༵༵༵/da de steng hreb 'dul 'byar gyis mnan/ de yis thub par the gnyisapa/ bad kun mgul 'gagasakyi zasaspyod dang sman dpyad/ 'brasarigasaskye 'phreng gi bcosathabasasogs/khyad par bad gan mgul 'gags ni/ nad 'di phal cher 'tsho dka' 'ing / dkor sogs mi dge sngon las rnam smin dang / khyad par gyen rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs rkyen las 'byung / 'di ni bad kun skya bo 'khrul med du/ gsungs kyang nad 'di'i mngon tshul rtags byung dus/ man ngag bsil sbyor zhag 'ga' bstan pa gnad/ ces gsungs pa ltar dang thun mong ma yin pa man ngag gser gyi sgrom bu/ bka' rgya ma sbyor tshul ni/se 'bru (zhi lnga)star bu (zhi gsum )'u su rnams (zho bzhi)so phag bskol khu rdo ka ra rnon tsam btab nas rta byas te 'thung / ma nu (zho gang )se 'bru (zho gang ) rdo ka ra 〈zho gsum) rdo zho (zho do) rnams 'gam phye yin/

90 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaltag sprod nang nub gnyis kur bsten/ gu rgya/ sa ma ya rgya rgya/ gzhan yang rig pas dpyade nas bad kun ldan 'dus yin na bde byed snyoms ldan dang / smug po 'dres na smug po g.yul rgyal dang / bad kun ser po 'dres na cong zhi drug pa dang pad ma 'dab brgyad sogs blta reg dri gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad de gtong ngo / / sman bcos dang byang khog yul thig las rang gi lag len ltar me dmigs rnams su me btsa' gdab pa dang / khyad par rgya gar pha dam pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zur du yod pa ltar ting 'dzin dang sngags dang / sman bcos dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gzugs ris ltar lag len la goms par byas nas thog mtha' bar gsum du me dmigs kyi gnad rnams su me btsa' btab ste bcos na nad 'di las grol ba yang mang ngo / / gong ltar zas spyod gnyis bsten dgos pa gnad du che/ nad 'di phal cher sngon las yin pas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la 'bad pa dang phyag bskor sbyin gtong sogs la 'bad pa gal che'o/ /ske 'phreng bcos pa'i skor ni/ 'bras rigs ske 'phreng zhes bya rna gsham skye/ gcig brdol ma sos yang gcig skye ba lci/ gcig zad gcig skye ba ni yang ba ste/ snga ma thu ba'i rigs yin bcos thabs gzab/rna shas phan tshun gnyis kyi 'og nas ni/ rma re skyes te rma de ma sos gong /ske yi mjing zur ltag khung la sogs par/ mang du mched pa 'di ni thub pa dka'/ 'bras rigs kun la khong sman byi la'i sha tshil g.yer ma sbyar ba yun ring bsten/ yang na re lcag pa yi chig thang sdud/ zla 'od nor khyung rgyun du bsten pa gces/ dngul chu rin chen bco brgyad pa yang

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 91 'phrod/ dngul chu (zho gang )so mar dzā (zho gang skar lnga)spos dkar (zho gang skar lnga)kha che (zho gang skar lnga)li shi (zhi gsum)dzā ti (skar gsum)ka ko la (skar gsum)7rtsi (skar gsum)gu gul(skar gsum)cugang (skar bzhi)sug smel (skar bzhi)a ru (zho do)sman chen (zho do)ru rta (zho gang )shu dag (skar bdun)bcas sbyar ba 'di la dngul chu rin chen bco brgyad zer/ byi la'i mgo rus mgron thal sre mong sha mtshal dkar ldong ros sbyar ba rma la 'debs/ dpyad du sran phyi 'dam thag byas pas 'byar steng ngam/ yang sgog pa srab mor byas pa glang/ de'i me btsa' 'jog pa gal che zhing / skrangs mthar me btsa' chung ngus bskor ba la/ dbus su me btsa' cung zad che ba 'jog rdol na rma khar sre mong sha glan dgos/skrangs pa ma brdol bar du bsreg dgos so/ / dang por gong bshad thang / de'i rjes su zla 'od nor khyung dang / yang na dngul khyung sogs kyis na zug gcod/ rgya sman lugs kyi khong sman yang bzang / rjes gcod du/ lag pa gnyis gshog pa ltar gyen du brkyangs nas dpung 'og na gzhong yod pa gnyis dang / gru mo na gshong yod pa gnyis/ rkang ba'i phyi rting dreg mtshams sogs la me btsa' gdab/ rgyud du tshigs pa dang po dang / drug pa bdun pa rnams bsreg nas 'bros khung dgag gsungs/ bad kun gyi nad la bad kun skya bo/ bad kun ser po/ bad dzin smug po/ bad kun mgul 'gags/ bad kun gre thogs sogs mang du yod pa las/ de'i nang nas gre thogs 'di la dbye na/ rlung thog spu thog gre thogs gri 'byar sogs bzhi yod pa las/ slong rkyen na lugs sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zur du yod pa las shes

92 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapar bya/ snyigs ma las kyang cher snyigs ma'i dus 'dir khyad par bad kun mgul 'gags gre thogs sogs kyis mi rgan gzhon med par gdung zhing 'chi ba las de la zas dang spyod lam gnyis gtso che/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ bad kun nad la rtsol bcag dro sa bsten/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / spyod lam drag dal ran par bya zhing 'khor 'dzing dang 'ur zing byed sar mi 'gro ba dang khams kyang dwangs dgos pa sogs gnad do/ /'phar spyang sogs kyi bsad sha dang / rbab shi'i sha ra sha sgog btsong /skyur rigs/ 'o bskol/ ra 'o rnying rigs kyi zas rnams spang dgos/gzhan yang kha phor mi bsre/ /le'u bdun pa/ kong sprul zin tig las bad mgul dang pho thog gi brtag bcos/dang po/ bad kun mgula'agagasakyi nad rtagasadang bcosathabs/ bsreg mig 'dzemabya sogs/ bad kun mgul 'gags sam gre thogs gi rtags/ brang rgyab dang phrag mig gzer/ brang tsha/ skabs su gre ba dang lce thog tu spu yod pa 'dra ba dang / phreng rdog lta bu yar 'gro phyir 'gro byed pa 'byung /rgyud du dbye ba bco brgyad tsam gsungs kyang bsdu na tsha 'gags grang 'gags gnyis su 'du ba las/ tsha 'gags zug shin tu che/ rtsa cung zad grim/ chu mdog ser/ grang 'gags zug gzer chung / rtsa stong

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 93 zhing lhod/ chu mdog sngo/ de gnyis ka la thog mar man ngag bsil sbyor tshad ldan 'ag shas bston/ de rjes tsha 'gags bad khrag shas che ba yin pas/ spang rgyan bco lnga dang nyer lnga/ mkha' 'gro bcu sbyor rgod g.yag khrag gis 'phul ba rnams phan che/ grang 'gags la nyang lugs rdo thal nyer bdun/ gnyis ka la be khrag nyer lnga tshad ldan/ 'brong khrag drug pa'am brgyad pa/ go yu bcu bdun/ bad khrag shas che na skyu ru nyer lnga/rga lo la skyu ru bungs skyed/ spang rgyan dkar po 'khor sman gcig dang cha mnyam bsnan pa zab cing / gur kum bcu gsum dang bdud rtsi sum sbyor bsres pa'am de gnyis ltag sprod btang / mar babs nas nyen dang pho bar 'dril na pho thog bcos bya/ yar babs nas lce la 'brum pa byung na gri lcags kyi tel pas bsreg lce rgyas/ skad 'gags pa sogs byung na lce rtsa gtar/ zas rtsam yib/ sha thud rul ba/ rgyu khrag ma smin pa'i rigs thams cad shin tu gnod cing khyad par lug sha rnying ba zos na bcos su med pas rtag tu spang / gre thogs pho thog gnyis kur tshig hrog gi rigs/ ja snum tshig song ba/ gyong bo'i rigs rnams dang /phor grib gos grib sogs grib rigs shin tu 'jom pa gal che/ snga dro za 'thung nyung tsam byed/ phyi dro lto chas shin tu 'jom/ skyugs 'phrod/rjes gcod tsha 'gags la gsal na thong rtsa dang / mi gsal na rtse'u chung zhad tsam gtar/ grang 'gags la ke stong lhen gsang tshigs bzhi ba bsreg spyir me btsa' snga mi rung zhing rjes gcod la legs/ gnam chos lugs sogs kyi sngags rnams dang / lag 'khor gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas pas phal char la de kho nas phan pa'ang 'byung / yang gnyan

94 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigand tsha shas med pa'i rigs la yul nad tshang bzhi dang / gdab pa'i dmigs 'bros phreng dag spyi'i 'bros 'phrang gnyis rnams su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ ske stong tsa ra khung nas gyen du tshon phyed bcal ba nad tshang 'og ma/ de nas gyen du sor phyed bcal ba nad tshang bar ma/ol mdud kyi mgo ni nad tshang chen mo/ de nas gyen du tshon phyed bcal ba nad tshang gong ma ste/ de bzhi la bsreg na nad gtor zhing srog la rgol nges pas rnam pa kun tu spang bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ nad phog nas zla ba gcig gi bar du sngar bshad pa'i zhi byed rigs bsten/ de nas zla ba gnyis pa la me btsas bsreg de las snga na 'tshang la phog pas 'tsho dka' zhing / phyi na 'bros tshar bas phan gnod med/ 'on kyang cung phyi na 'phrang sngon ma chod kyang rjes ma gang yin de bkag pas en tsam phan/de la thog mar rke stong tsa ra khung dang / nad tshang 'og ma'i g.yas g.yon nas thad du gzhal ba'i tshon re'i sar bcas gsum la bsreg de nas zhag gsum nas nad tshang bar ma'i g.yas g.yon tshon re'i sa/ de nas zhag gsum na nad tshang chen mo'i g.yas g.yon mtshon sa/ de nas zhag gsum nad tshang gong ma'i g.yas g.yon bcas rim bzhin sreg pa ni 'bros 'phrang dgu 'gag pa'o/ / de nas zhag gsum na phyi'i 'bros 'phrang bsdam pa ni/ ske stong nas g.yas g.yon phrag mig bar ling ling 'phar ba'i rtsa rtse yod pas g.yas su bros pas mchin thog dang / g.yon du bros pas pho thog tu 'gyur ba yin pas phrag mig nas ske steng bar tshon re dang tshon phyed re spel mar gcig rjes gcig mthud du me btsa'i phreng ba gdab/ de rnams kyi bar du sngags zab mo lag blangs can chu dang

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 95 mar la btab nas nad tshang rnams ma gtogs pa kun la byugs/ nad tshang bzhi bor me sngags gang yang mi gdab pa gnad shin tu che'o/ /gnyisapa/ bad kun pho thog la sman dang gtar bsreg sngagasakyisabacosathabs/bad kun pho thog zas skom khar song tshad yar skyugs nas lus po je skam du 'gro ba thams cad kyis shes sla zhing las nad lta bus bcos dka' yang / myid dkyus nad thur du babs nas pho bar 'dril ba la rdo thal nyer lnga'am nyer bdun gyis bshigs/ grang shas ma zhu'i rgyur byas pa'i pho thog la nyang lugs rdo zhun/ bde byed snyoms ldan/ cong zhi cur nis/ bco lnga drag sbyor/ be khrag nyer lnga/ se 'bru'i rigs la rdo zhun sbyor ba bsdebs pa 'bri gung gces bsdus ltar zab/ khyad par se 'bru dar gdugs can/ se 'bru nyer lnga sman byings dang bungs nyams pa'i rdo thal bsnan la star khaṇa gyis 'dam btags byas nas ril bu dril ba la bdud rtsi ril dkar zer ba ste de gnyis shin tu zab/ de la se 'bru dar gdugs ni/ gtso bo se 'bru/ de dang bungs mnyam pri yang ku/'khor sman a ru/ li shi 'ong zhi/ 'u su rnams cha mnyam pa ste sman 'di pho kha gzer ba sogs pho nad kyi rigs thams cad la zab cing skran la'ang shin tu 'gro ba zhig go / zas spyod 'jom bya gong gi mgul 'gags skabs ltar spang blangs gal che/ dpyad la khrag ni gtan nas mi rung / sman yun ring bsten pas je drag song nas rjes gcod nyen gsang / me mnyam kha gsum/ skran gsang bcas me btsa' lngas bsdam/

96 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigade rjes thu tshabs che chung dang bstun pa'i bdun gsum mam zla ba gcig tsam gyi mtshams su/ brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams/ de nas yar tshon ring gang gi mtshams/ yang tshon ring gang mtshams gcig bcas gsum bzhag snga phyi'i me btsa' brgyad po dus gcig tu bzhag kyang chogade dag gis gyen du ded thub pa'i nad rtags byung nas sman mus mi skyur bar 'thung / rim gyis bdun gnyis gsum gang rung mtshams ske stong tsa ra khung la gcig des g.yas g.yon nas gyen gseg tshon ring re gzhal ba'i tsaṇ+ḍa gnyis kyi sne tsam la re re ste gsum bzhag yang bdun gnyis gsum phan chad mtshams sngar bzhag pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa'i sne gnyis nas tshon re gyen du gzhal ba'i mtshams su re re/ yang tshon gang re yar gzhal ba'i mtshams su re re/ yang de 'dra gcig bcas khyon bsdoms g.yas g.yon gnyis la gsum gsum drug dus gcig tu bzhag pa ni me btsa'i ra ba dgu skor zer/ de rnams ske rmen dang ma thug pa'i sha mig tu gdab/ spyir ol mdud nas g.yas g.yon phun re'i mtshams gnyid log yang phun gang mtshams tsaṇ+ḍa/ yang phun gang mtshams rtsa nag gnyid log yod pa'ang shes par bya'o/ / mi mkhas pa kha cig ol khrod stong nas gyen du me btsa' bzhag pa ni mi srog myur len yin pas spang bar bya'o/ / de rjes lce la 'brum pa rdol/ lce rgyas/ skad 'gags pa sogs byung na nad gyen du thon pa'i rtags legs pas lce rtsa g.yas g.yon gang rung gtsag bu rnon pos hrad hrad byas nas gtar/ khrag rjes chod dka' na rus sreg glan/ tshan mo 'thung bas chod pa'ang yod/ da dung ma chod na mgo thog chu phyar ba dang / kha nang chu 'khyug gis yang yang

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 97 bkang ba dang / khrag gcod sngags gdab/ lar khrag gcod sngags rnon po zhig gtar ga byed pas ma shes thabs med pa yin no/ /lce la 'brum pa rwa lta bu byung na zangs sbubs su drangs la lcags tel gyis bsregapho thog gre thogs gnyis kur shes shing nus na/ 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ta/khyung nag sa 'og gdon 'joms/ dus 'khor khyung khra sogs khyung khra'i rigs gang rung gi rjes gnang zhus nas bsnyen pa tshul bzhin bskyal ba shin tu zab cing gdon rgyab che ba phal cher la smad dpyad las kyang sngags dmigs zab che bar snang / sman sngags gnyis bsdebs na phan kha lhag par che zhing / grol ba'i rtags su dbang bo'i sgo rnams nas rnag khrag chu ser srog chags sogs dngos su don pa'am/ rmi lam du byung yang phan nges pa lag blangs can no/ /gsumapa/ kong sprulalugasakyi mid 'chusakyi sman sbyor khyad par can 'ga'/bad kun mgul 'gags sman skor las/ /spang rgyan dkar po ṭ+wāṃ.ar nag/ snying zho shaX tsan+da (dkar po)phyi dzā tiṣ+ṭha cu gang / sro lo dkar boX gur kum bye 'bras gsum (ar/ b.raXskyurak+ta)sle tres)tigha dang /li shi/ shing mngar) spang rgyan bco lnga 'dis/ glo nad gre pa/ ༵༵/ dang mig mi gsal/ /bad kun stod brgyang mid 'chus sel

98 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaspang rgyan nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ / spang rgyan dkar po tsan+da gnyis/ / a ru sle tres ba le ka / kuṇ+ḍa kā ri 'bras bu gsum/ tigha hong len skra bzang dang / / ba sha ka dang gur kum dang / / shing mngar sro lo kyi lce dang / bong dkar stang zil khrang rkang ser/ / gang chung rtsi dmar rkang gcig (dmar po khrag rkang )dang / / brag spos dkar po yar 'dren (sbalag rtsa ba )rnams/ / gtso bo cha gsum 'khor cha re/ / mkhris ba che na lci 'bru dang / / za ba g.ya' kyi zangs rtsi sdeb/ / rlung la dzā ti ru rta bsnan/ / bad kun star bu 'u su sbyar/ / tsha ba 'gram 'khrugs rims dug dang / / khrag nang gre ba 'gags la mchog / gtar ga mi dgos khyad chos yin/ /sman mchog mkha' 'gro bcu yi sbyor ba ni/ / cong zhi gser mdog shing mngar brag zhun dang / / sga skya se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling / / byi tang rgyam tshwa bur dkar rta la sbyar/ / bong nga nas tsam gsang sman zhal shes yin/ / rgod g.yag khrag 'phul mgul 'gags 'joms pa'i mchog /yang gcig mkha' 'gro bcu yi sbyor ba ni/ / 'di na mkha' 'gro'i gsang sman khyad par can/ / dom mkhris gla rtsi rgya tshwa gser mdog dang / / bzang drug g.yag rgod rak+ta chang sbyar 'phul/ / thun gnyis kyis kyang nad las grol lo skad/ / sbyar thabs btang thabs man ngag gud du bsten (man ngag gud sbas ni/ sman kun bungs mnyam thun gsum bcad/ gcig g.yag rog dar ma'i khrag phul gang gis 'phul/ gcig chang rgan snying khus 'phul/ gcig chu bskol tsha mos 'phul ba man ngag zab mo i thi)/ /

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 99 mid 'chus spyi sman rdo thal bzang bo drug / gser mdog gla rtsi dom mkhris rgya tshwa dang / / da li ma nu 'u su skyu ru ra/ / hong len ba sha ka dang tsan+da dmar/ / tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / / cong zhi bul tog gangs tig tshwa la dang / / brag zhun gi waṃ rgyam tshwa pi pi ling / /se 'bru sbrang sbyar ril bu sran 'phos dril/ / tho rangs btang bas mid 'chus pho bar babs/ / gre thogs spu thog pho thog tsha 'gags rnams/ /'di yis mi sel nad ni yod ma yin/ / nyang ral gter ma phyag len myong bas grub/ / ces so/ /be khrag nyer lnga (nyang gter) be khrag (be rgan thang khrag) bya khyung lnga/ / bzang drug rgya ru bse ru sha ba'i rwa/ / rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa dang ni/ / tsha ba gsum dang cong zhi spang rgyan dkar/ / bya rgod go bo la sogs ol mdud ni/ / tshogs tshad legs sbyar rgod (g.yag)khrag rta la bskyon/ / mgul 'gags gre thogs pho nad nges par 'joms/ /mid 'chus nad la 'brong khrag drug pa ni/ / gser mdog gla rtsi gu gul dang / / li shi dom mkhris 'brong khrag drug / bad kun mid 'chus nad la bdud rtsi yin/ / brgyad pa de steng cong zhi spang rgyan dkar/ /bsnan pa yin zhes sgra 'dzin thos snyam sems/ /'brong khrag a ru gser mdog dom gyi mkhris/ / gla rtsi gur kum pi bying sdi ba ris/ / gu gul dkar nag sbyar ba'i 'brong khrag brgyad/ /sa go/ bre/ ma nu 'bri rta sa 'dzin dang / / yu mo ol krong da li cu gang dang / / gur kum li shi shing mngar spang rgyan dkar/ / ru rta a ru rgun

100 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'abrum tsan+dan dmar/ / se 'bru ut+pal pi ling ka ra sbyar/ / go gre bcu bdun bad kun ske nad dang / / pho ba'i nad sel lag blangs shin tu zab/ ya/nga gcig man ngag go gre bcu gsum ni/ / go gre ma nu da li dang / / 'u su ko la sug smel dang / / gur kum gser me re skon pa/ /pri yang dngul chu mtshal sbal rgyab/ / legs sbyar phye mas bad kun mgul dīgags nad/ / mid dkyus mid 'byar ske nad ma lus sel/ / zhes le'u brgyad pa/ de'u dmar ba'i gsungs lasamid 'chus kyi sngags bcos sogs/dang po/ mid 'chusakyi rtagasadang dbye ba/bad kun mgul 'gags brang dang glo bar rgyas/ / gnas tshul zo ba'i ngo la 'o chags bzhin/ / dang po gre ba tsha la mid pa dang / / brang rgyab ske stong nyen sna'i tshigs pa na/ / zas skom mid dka' lud pa ljan ljin mang / / mid pa log cing bya rog mig gnyis gzer/ / dbugs rngub dka' snyam sha skam lus stobs 'chor/ / gre ba tsha skam zas skom mi thar zhing / / thar kyang pho bar mi slebs brang du sdod/ / zos dus glo langs skyug cing skyigs bu 'byung / / bye brag rigs mang stod smad bar

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 101 gsum la/ / mgo dang mid pa pho ba gsum la 'bab/ / stod babs tsha klad spu byi mtshul rdib dang / / rngog byi zhes zer bar babs rgyan 'brum skem/ / gru gu tsha ba gyen log gor ling zer/ / smad babs tsha grang grol tshul dang ldan/ / mtshul sob sngog la byer bas gre ba tsha/ / rgun 'brum skem ni mid zhabs pho ba'i khar/ / rmen gnyis yod pa cher skyes mid pa 'gags/ / zas skom mid par mar 'gro yar la ldog / gru gu gyen log med pa pho ba'i bar/ / gru gu 'dril ltar gyen thur yar mar 'gro/ chu sngon nyog can skyug cing skyigs bu 'byung / / tsha ba khol lang gre ba khol bur skem/ / thu drags res mos 'pho 'gyur ci yang byed/ / re 'gar brnangs 'dra skabs skabs mes tshig 'dra/ / tsha ba spu byi mchin khrag pho bar bsags/ / mchin pa cher rgyas pho ba mnan pa 'ong / / brang tsha chu skyur khrag skyug sbom tshad che/ / mchin pa na zhing pho bas zas mi 'ju/ /grang ba spu byi pho ba'i me drod nyams/ / zas skom mi 'ju grol ma spu byi ni/ / pho ba srin bus gang bas zas skom skyug / gzer che'i skabs su ril ril 'gul snyam byed/ spyir ni mgul 'gags tshig smra dbugs 'byin dka'/ / bad gan grum bu ma zhu'i gnas su 'phel/ / pho mchin mi bde zas skom 'khru skyug byed/ nywa bzhi mig rus na la chu tshan skyug /yan lag tshigs byer skrangs dang rengs 'khums byed/ / de ltar so so'i nad rtags mngon gyur nas/ / sman dpyad bsrung ba gsum gyis gso ba ni/ / sman dang dpyad la rgyud dang slob dpon gyi/ /gnyisapa/ mid 'chusaspyi sman nyung ralagater ma/man ngag zhal shes spyi sman bzang po drug gser mdog gla rtsi

102 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadom mkhris rgya tshwa dang / da lis ma nu 'u su skyu ru ra/ hong len ba sha ka dang dom mkhris dmar/ tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / cong zhi bul rtog gangs thigs tsha la dang / brag zhun gi wang rgya tshwa pi pi ling /se 'bru sbrang sbyar ril bu sran 'phos tsam/ / tho rangs btang bas mid 'chus pho bar babs/ / gre thogs pho thog spu thog tsha 'gags rnams/ /'di yis mi sel nad ni yod ma yin/ / nyang ral gter ma phyag len myong bas grub/ / go gre ma nu spyang lce bri yang ku/ / khyung lnga li shi drug dang ru rta drug / gur kum sbyar bas mid 'chus mtha' dag sel/ da li cu gang shing mngar tsan dan dkar/ / ru rta a ru ra dang ka ra sbyar/ / li shi drug pa lo brgyad dri chus dbul/ / glo nad gre ba tsha skam skad 'gags sel/ / a ru ru rta shu dag gla ba'i rtsi/ / sman chen sbyar ba'i khyung lngas gnyan lhog 'joms/ / be khrag nyer lnga be khrag bya khyung lnga/ bzang drug rgya ru bse ru sha ba'i rwa/ / rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa dang ni/ / tsha ba gsum dang cong zhi spang rgyan dkar/ bya rgod go bo la sogs ol mdud rnams/ / tshogs tshad legs sbyar tsha grang rta la bskyon/ / mgul 'gags gre thogs pho thog nges par 'joms/ 'brong khrag gser mdog gla gul dom mkhris dang / / li shi sbyar btang mid 'chus mtha' dag sel/ / de steng pi ling spos dkar rgya mtshal sbyar/ / mid 'chus tsha grang kun la bdud rtsi 'dra/ / spang rgyan bco lnga ni/ spang rgyan a gar nag po snying zho sha / tsan dan dzā ti cu gang sro lo dkar/ / ru rta 'bras gsum sle tres ba sha ka / li shi shing mngar spang rgyan bco lnga 'dis/ / cham tshad gre bar babs dang dbugs mi bde/ / bad rlung stod du 'khyil dang

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 103 gzer che dang / / khyad par bad tshad sel la 'di rang bsngags/ /mkha' 'gro'i man ngag spang rgyan bco lnga ni/ / spang rgyan dkar po bsil gsum dang / / shing sngon shing mngar a ru ra/ / hong len re skon brag zhun rnams/ / 'og mas gong ma rim bzhin bskyed/ / bad kun tsha 'gags grang 'gags dang / / mid 'chus sgrim dang skom dad dang / /gre ba'i nad rigs ma lus 'joms/ / stod gzer snying srog na ba la/ /tsan dan dkar dmar ru rta bsdeb/ / pho mchin mi bde na ba la/ / pri yang ku dang 'u su bsdeb/ / 'di las zab pa'i man ngag med/ / smug po khrag tu skyug pa la/ / ra ma sngon po'i 'o ma'i nang / / ba sha ka ni btab btang mchog / kun la rang rang gnyen po 'phri bsnan shes/ /zas ni 'ju dka' rul skyur sngo bad rigs/ / ra phag nya yi sha khrag (lhog pas shi ba'i sha dang ra sha sogs/)rjen btsos gyong / / 'khyags pa la sogs rtag tu spang bar bya/ /gsumapa/ bad kun mid 'chusand kyi bsreg dmigs/bad kun mid 'chus rlung nad stod brgyang la/ / bya rog sna nas g.yas g.yon tshon re dang / / de nas phun re bcas dang de 'og tu/ /tshon gang de 'og tshon gang 'phar ba'i sar/ / bya rog mig dang go chen go chung bsregs/ / (mthe bong gi tshigs mgo nas sen dreg dkar nag mtshams su gzhal tshon gang zer/ tshon phyed sor gang yin/ sor phyed phun gang yin zhes rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin)de yang bya rog sna zhes bya ba ni/ / sko stong nas thur tshon do phun gang sar/ / bya rog sna zhes gzhan yang dpyad de

104 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadag / so sor dus dang skabs babs shes nges dgos/ /bzhi ba/ bad kun mid 'chusasngagasakyisabacosathabasasogs/1 sngags 'bum rdo rje go khrab las/ mid 'chus mi dge'i sdig sgrib yin phyir phyag skor ba/ / 'byung bzhin so so'i las kyi dge la brtson/ / nyams chags las sgrib sbyang ba'i thabs la 'bad/ / sman mdo sman gzungs mdo chog grangs mang bsgrub/ / 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ṣa khyung nag dang / khyung khra la sogs dbang zhu bsnyen na zab/ / srung 'khor sngags dang za yig bsten pa ni/ / de yang 'phags yul ti l+li pa dang ni/ gangs can ljongs nas nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang / / ras chung rdor grags 'ja' tshon snying po sogs/ / gsang gsum gcig bsdus lho sprul rje drung dang / /mi tra dzo ki mi 'gyur rdo rje dang / / sngags 'bum rdo rje'i go khrab la sogs pas/ / rgyud lung man ngag kun gyi bcud bsdus pa/ / nyams myong lag len khol bur phyung ba la/ / gnyen po lha gsum gcig tu dril ba'i sngags/ / (treḥlha khro rma badz+ra pa ni h+ya gri wa ga ru ṭa hūṃ phagasaḥ)khyung nag sngags dang nad brgya skun 'joms sngags/ /(khro ga ru ṭa ka wa asnyi ma la sā hā/ e ma hoḥphan noḥ phan noḥsā hāḥbastan 'gyur nas gsungs so)mgul 'gags 'joms sngags mi tra dzo ki'i lugs/rma ag sod/ yig sod/ li sod/ ling sod/ nā ga shri phu sod/gnam lcags rdo rje rtses brus/ (zhes khri bston btab la btang / mgul 'gags sogs la pha lam 'dri ba mi tra dzo ki'i gdam pa yin)gzhan yang srung dngagaso ba'i sngags/ yo mi tri thi thi dbal dbal sod/ ulha re phud

bod lu gas 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 105 sod/ oṃ nā ga ti lu bu shi rma ja 'gom sprul leng sod/ u shi phu sod/rma nā ga ti lu bu shi rma ja 'gom sprul leng sod/ u shri phu sod/ rma shin ti shin ti sarba bi ti mug nyan sā hā/ bad kun gre thogs pho thog skya smug ser gsum sod srung shig rak+ṣa/ sngags 'bum rdo rje'i go khrab las/nad brgya 'joms pa'i spyi sngags ni/ / rma pad+ma sha wa ri phagasaḥ nan par shigaḥ nag nanaḥ tat+ya thā/ sarba wi ri taḥ ha na ha naḥbadz+ra nar k+ṣa rak+ṣa sā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsregs gsol 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / tat+ya thā/ hu re hu re/ hu ṭa ga ha na sā hā/ cho ga 'di ni lag pa la bzlas brjod byas nas lho ba mnyes na ma zhu ba'i nad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / za yig cha re byas pa'i cha lnga 'di/ / kha byang bzhin du bdun phrag re re bsten/ / snga phyi snga dro dgong mo so sor bza'/ / phan yon mid bcos gre thogs pho thog dang / / mgul 'gags la sogs bad kun za yig go / mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gtar kha las byung ngo / / k+shi rgya rgya rgyaḥ/ 2 lho sprul rje drung pa'i gter nas byang ba'i mgul 'gags 'khor lo dang shog dril/ stopho nad bad kun bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/
gnam chos za yig mid dkyis ma la phan zhes gsungs 'dug

108 bod lu gas 'bras nad gso riga'agyed/ / dga' mgur gyur nas rang sar yal/ / skye med stong ba'i ngang la bzhag / bad kun spyi khyab na ba la/ / āḥdakar das zhes lus kun khengs/ / lus sbyin dkar 'tsher mchog tu shis/ / pho ba'i nad la pho ba kha sbubs nas/ / nad dang be snabs thams cad rdo ro ro/ / wa chu lta bur babs pas sa phyogs gang / / gdon dang nad bdag rnams kyis 'thung bar bsgom/ / bad gan skya bo zas mi 'ju ba la/ sbyo sbrang lcags kyi mchu can mang po yis/ / pho ba bad kun bcas pa zos par bsgom/ / bad kun smug po la sogs gcong nad la/ / pho ba la sogs lus kyi gnas thams cad/ / yi ge āḥyig dkar po mang po yis /lus kyi nad kun thams cad gang bar bsgom/ / mid 'chus mid skyug na ba la/ / mi nad zhe sdang sbrul gyi mgo / kha nas 'dzul nas pho bar bslebs/ / pho ba mid thag bcas pa zos/ / thu lu dkrugs nas shul yang bsregs/ / lhag ma khyung gis lhas med zos/ / mid 'chus la phan the tshom med/ / ma zhu la sogs pho ba'i nad/ / kun la phan pa dmigs pa'i nad/ / gan rkyal nyal la lag mthil du/ / āḥyig re re gsal nas su/ / rab tu yang yang mnye bar bya/ / de sogs sa gdon 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni/ / bya khyung rigs lnga la sogs bsgoms shing bsnyen/ /de ltar rnal 'byor thabs kyis bcos ba yis/ las zad ma gtogs 'tsho ba myong bas grub/ / slar smras pa/ rgyud don man ngag myong ba'i lag len dang / / dam pa gong ma'i gsung gi go yul rnams/ / gcig bsdus man ngag bdud rtsi 'chi sos 'di/ / rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams la phan phyir bris/ / mkhas 'dod ma yin rigs pas gtan tshig

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 109 dben/ / grags 'dod ma yin gal gnad ma bor tsam/ / brjod 'dod ma yin 'di med bya thabs med/ / che 'dod ma yin tshig tshogs spros pa bral/ / de na khol bur len bde 'di ru spros/ / 'di bris legs byas rnam dkar dag pa'i 'od rlabs kyis/ / srid gsum dug lnga'i mun pa rten dang 'brel bcas kun/ / ma lus gzhoms shing blo gros ku mu/ yi 'dab/ / phyogs brgyar rgyas bas kun mkhyen gong 'phang grub gyur /da ka/ na mid 'gags kyi bcos khyad par can ni/ dang bo byung ba'i dus su man ngag bsil sbyor zhag 'ga' bsten/ lu ba mang na spang rgyan bco lnga cong zhi'i khu bas dbul/ de rjes cong zhi rgod btul gyis gzhi bzung la/ / sga pi pho dbyi mong tsi tra ka ste tsha ba lnga/ rgya rgyam kha gsum/ dza sug ko gsum/ sngo'i tsha ba gsum/ se 'bru byi tang ka ru rta la phud rnams sbyar ba'i phye ma chu bskol tsha mos dbul/ skabs su ri sho spyang tsher shu dag dur byid rgyam tshwa pi ling rnams kyis skyugs sman btang ste/ nad pa gan rkyal bsnyal/ skyugs lud byung dus lus ma 'chus par bslangs te sgro sogs kyis skyugs sna drangs/ skabs 'ga' bshal sman rnon pos sbyangs/ yang na sbyong skyugs sbrag ma bya/ gdon gang gnod bcos rim gro bya/ de nas khong sman gla rtsi a ru ra/ dom mkhris bzang drug ma nu bzhi po thun re sbyar btags cha gsum byas pa'i thun gsum po/de las/ dang por thun gcig g.yag rog po'i khrag dang chang bzang phul gang sbyar pas khong du btang / slar yang rus 'don sman thun gnyis po khrag chang dang sbyar te re re bzhin btang bas/ sngon las ma

110 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigagatogs thun gsum po des nad las grol ba bden rdzun lag tu blangs pas gsal/ dpyad du thong rtsa gsal na zhad tsam gtar/ mi gsal na lce rtsa'am/ rtse'u chung zhag tsam gtar/ pho ba na shas che na se 'bru lnga par cong zhi rgod btul byas pa bsres te btang / tshigs pa bzhi ba bsreg nya sha dang ol gong tsha ba btang / tshogs bsags rim gro sgrib sbyong gang 'os bya/ des mgul 'gags nad las bde myur du grol bar 'gyur ro zhes/ dpe zhig las mthong /le'u dgu ba/ man ngag lhan thabs lasarma 'bras dang gnyan 'brasakyi lta ba/dang po/ bad kun mgula'agagasakyi na lugs/ gsobacos/ bshal skyugs/ gzas/bad kun mgul 'gags zhes bya pho ba dang / brang dang glo bar bad gan rgyas pa yis/ bad gan rlangs pa glo yu mid par rgyas/ dper na mdong mo'i logs la 'o chags 'dra/ 'di la thog mar bar dang tha ma'i rtags/ dang po gre ba tsha la mid pa dang / brang dang ske stong nyen sna tshigs pa na/ zas dang skom sogs mid pa dka' snyam byed/ bar du zas dang skom gnyis mid pa dka'/ gre ba na la lud pa ljan ljin mang /mid pa log cing bya rog mig gnyis gzer/ dbugs rngub dka' snyam sha skam lus stobs 'chor/ tha ma gre ba tsha skam zas mi thar/ thar kyang

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 111 pho bar mi slebs brang du sdod/ zos dus glo langs skyug cing skyigs bu 'byung / dbugs 'tshub ngar sob che la mid pa 'gags/ thog mar bar gyi nad rtags mkhas pas 'tsho/ tha ma'i rtags kun tshang na 'chi bar 'dug bad kun mgul 'gags nad 'di 'tsho dka' zhing /dkor sogs mi dge sngon las rnam smin dang / khyad par gyen rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs rkyen las 'byung / 'di ni bad kun skya bo 'khrul med du/gsungs kyang nad 'di'i mngon tshul rtags byung dus/ man ngag bsil sbyor zhag 'ga' bsten pa gnad/ de rjes cong zhi rgod 'dul gzhi bzung la/ tsha ba lnga dang tsha sna tshogs tshad dang / bzang po bzhi dang sngo yi tsha ba gsum/ se 'bru byi tang ru rta la la phud/ sbyar ba'i phye ma chu bskol tshan mos dbul/ skabs su ri sho spyang tsher lhum rtsa dang / dur byin rgyam tshwa pi pi ling sbyar ba'i/ skyug sman zos (skyug sman spyi dang lag len mi 'dra ba'i zab gnad)nas nad pa gan rkyal nyal/ skyug long byung nas nad pa ma 'chus bslang / sgro 'am gzhi rgyud (kyirtse mo )bldad pas skyug sna drangs/ skabs 'gar bshal skyug sbrags mas sbyang ba dang / rdo zho cong zhi'i chu tshan mar btung la/ yang yang skyug gzhug de dag gang gis kyang / ma sel rgyud don star bu pañca'i steng / spyang tsher bsnan pa'i 'dren kyang e 'phrod blta/ gzhan yang thong rtsa gsal na en tsam gtar/ mi gsal rtse chung zed tsam gtar pa'ang yod/ ske stong nyen gsang tshigs pa bzhi ba bsreg nya sha ol gong tsha ba khong du btang /tshogs gsog rim gro sgrib sbyang gang 'grub pa sogs/ mid 'chus mgul 'gags nad las grol ba mthong /

112 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaganyisapa/ gnyan 'brasalasasha 'bras/ rtsa 'bras/rusa'abras/ khong 'brasabacasakyi rgyu rkyen dbye ba brtag bcos/gnyan rims sha rus rtsar bem 'bras zhes pa/ rgyu rkyen dbye ba brtag bcos lnga yis bstan/ rgyu ni gnyan tshad spyi dang 'dra ba la/ drag shul rkyen dang sa bdag klu gnyan 'gras/ ngan khrag chu ser rkun bu la sogs pa/ rlung sgril lus kyi lhan skyes srin dang bsdongs/ sha rus rtsa la zhen pas 'bras zhes brjod/ dbye ba skabs 'dir phyi nang gnyis su bsdus/ phyi la'ang sha rus rtsa yi 'bras dang gsum/ phyi rtags rtsa rgyud phra 'dar skrangs mnan sra/ sha yi 'bras ni nyung gsher 'khyag pa 'dra/rus 'bras rus pa mdog 'gyur rtsi nyams zos/ yang na dus steng lcags kyi gzer btab 'dra/ de yi brtag pa gul nag ldong ros dang /babla mu zi mtshal nyams dri chur sbyar/ rma can rma med gang yin dogs sar byugs/ min na mi 'byar yin na 'byar ba la/ shul du sha ro byung na 'khrul ba med/ khong 'bras skran ltar reg pa sra ba'am/ mi mngon gting nub zas la 'khren pa ste/ smin nas gyen thur gnyis kur rnag rdol 'gyur/ bcos thabs sman dpyad zas spyod rnam bzhi ste/ sman ni spyi ru khong la khyung lnga'i steng / dngul chu klu bdud rdo rje brag spos dang /gsang ba'i sman bsnan btang bas khong gnyan bsrung / bye brag phyi 'bras mi rus nya yi sha spru rtsa re lcag cong zhi gzhir bzhag steng / sha la bdud rtsi lnga bsnan lums kyis 'dul/ rus la pi ling ra mnye 'ba' cha

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 113 dang / rus sna sna tshogs rtsa la mtshal tsha la/ bsil ba'i sngo sna bsnan pa'i lums kyis 'dul/ ma zhu kun la sga dang pi pi ling / pho ris go snyod g.yer ma lcam 'bru dang / lan tsha shu dag bi sha glum klad sbyar/'ag 'ga' bcings la de rjes rma yod na/ rgya tshwa dom mkhris sga dang pi ling pho/ dwa pa rgu drus thar nu dbyi mong gi lca gu rdo thal re lcag lce tsha dang / bul tog sbrang rgod sbyar pa'i bcu bzhi pa'i/ reng bu ma chod bar du rma nang brdzang / yang na re lcag bi sha spyang tsher rtsa/ wa dang ri bong brun rnams nus ldan bsregs/ dngul thal dom mkhris gu gul dkar po bsdebs/ reng bu gong bzhin zhag 'ga'i bar du 'jug yang na sha yi 'bras la dbyi mong shun/ srub ka thar nu sbrang rgod bzhi sbyar la/ rus 'bras dngul zangs sha 'bras rgya tshwa dwa/ phag tshil rnams sbyar rtsa 'bras de ba'in du/ rgya tshwa rgu drus ldong ros sbrang rgod de/ gsum ga bi sha dang bcas sbyar la byugs/ chod na rgu drus ba bla yung ldong ros/ dom mkhris ka ra go tsan thang chu byugs/ de yis sha'u myur du skye bar byed/ khong 'bras smin du mi gzhug gsar dus bcos/ dang po smyung bya bong nga byi tang ga dug nyung sgron shing pho ba ris bskol blud/ de nas spyi bcos skabs kyi khong sman bsten/ ma thub khyung lnga'i steng du byang khra dang / chu ser sman gsum bsnan pa'i rgyun bshal lam/ drag po gnam lcags zil ba'i bshal gyis sbyang / zas spyod gnyan tshad spyi bzhin bsten dgos kyang / cung zad yang pas sha gsar la sogs pa/ rtsa chu'i babs dang bstun de rig pas dpyod/ /
