114 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigagasumapa/ rma 'brasalasaphyi 'brasaspangasapo dang / rma can/rusa'abras/ nang 'brasabacasakyi rgyu rkyen dbye ba brtag bcosasogasabashad pa/lhan skyes rma ngan 'bras nad ces bya ba/ rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bzhi/ rgyu rkyen ngan khrag rgyas pa rlung gis bsgril/dbye ba phyi 'bras gsum dang nang 'bras dgu/ nyes pa'i nad rigs drug dang bco brgyad gsungs/ skabs 'dir phyi 'bras nang 'bras rnam pa gnyis/ phyi 'bras (la yang sha 'bras )skrangs po yod dang rma can dang /rus pa'i 'bras dang nang 'bras gcig ste ba'i/ skrangs (rtags ni phyi'i sha 'bras) pa sra brtan nyung gsher 'khyag pa 'dra/ byugs lums zhi dka' zug chung yun ring zhen/ rma 'bras steng mkhregs sha'u gsos pa dka'/ rus 'bras sha'u mi chags rus mdog nyams/ gang yang gnad steng byung na gso dka' gsungs/ nang 'bras mi mngon gting nub zas la 'khren/ smin nas gyen thur gnyis kur rnag rdol 'gyur/ bcos thabs sha 'bras mi rus nya yi sha spru rtsa re lcag cong zhi dri chu'i lums/yun ring bsten na de yis zhi bar 'gyur/ ma zhu rnag tu 'gugs na byi brun dang / phug ron byi brun chang btsos lums bsten pas/ rnag tu 'gugs sam gu gul (lag len dkar nag gnyis ga)mu zi dang / a ru sha chen nas zan mchil ba'i brun/ zhib btags sbrang smyon (byis pa'i chu rang shas che)byis pa'i chu sbyar byug bal 'dab steng bku shog bu'am dar gyis bcings/ skyon med zug 'byil skrangs pa rang zhir 'gro skyon

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 115 can (zhag gsum bzhag pas) mdog 'gyur skrangs thog rnag mgo yong /de dag khug nas rang rdol 'byung ba'am/ min na brdol ba'i rma de a sas bdug rjes la gtso bo cha gnyis gur kum mtshal/ shing mngar yung ba chu rtsa stag dom dkar/ phye ma rma chas dbyar dgun dus dang sbyar/rus sman sde bzhi bzang drug gsang sman gnyis/ gla dom dar tshur sha skyi rtsa gsum la/ ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma rma dar bkab/ nad rgyu khrag yin gang nye yang yang gtar/ skrangs po rngabs ras 'jib la gtar khrag dbyung / yang na dwa tsha pad ma thar nu dang / rgya tshwa sbrang smyon sbyar ba skrangs por byugs/ shog bu hel ge la sogs bkab pa yis/ chu bur byung na 'bras nad gting 'don byed/ nad rkyen gnyan yin khong sman rtsa lto sbyang / nad dngos 'bras yin lums 'dul chu tshan gzhug dur rus rnying pa tshi zad nas tsam brdungs/ sla ngar rdza sbub du ba mi 'chor bsreg phye ma zhib btags mar nag spos dkar sbyar/ me chung yun bsdu du chad snag tsha 'dra/ ngad yal tshe na bal 'dab cog la ma/ gtso bo tsha la cong zhi bzang po yin/ phye ma btab dkrugs nad dmigs khyab par byug tel ge bkab bzhag zhag gsum song nas spo/ khong sman dngul chu rin chen sbyor ba bsten/ cong zhi bre gang 'o ma bre dor gdus/sbrang rtsi bre gang blug la btsos dkrugs pa'i/ zho tsam song dang pi ling khyor ba gang / gur kum brag zhun tsha la dom mkhris dang / zangs thal brag spos btab la legs dkrugs pa'i/ lde gu lto stong bsten na bdud rtsi 'dra/ skabs su khrag dang chu ser gnyen po shis/ kun gyis phan dka' rus 'bras 'dra bcos bya/ de yang gnyan sa'i gnas la 'bras

116 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigazhugs kyang / 'dzem cha mi dgos rus sbos de steng du/ khab btsugs tshor ba med par 'dra ba de/ khong bsrung khyung lnga gnyan 'bras dus bzhin bsten/ bla gnas sar 'dzem gri rno sol me bsreg tsha dras sha rus 'bras phyed phye ba yi/ / chu grang rgyun bran sen mo sogs btab kyang /reg bya nyams par bran la spu snum btsos/ brdzang zhing steng du sha gsar dmar po ni/ gri thag byas pa'i 'byar sdom khrag bcad la/ zhag song kha phye kyung nos rus skyon rnams/ / ma lus snying stobs bskyed la 'drud cing brdar/ rjes la gong bshad gso ba'i sman rnams gdab/ kha zas skyur dang lan tsha dug bzhin spang / gzhan rnams phyogs med 'jig zas btang la bshig khong 'bras sman gyis bshig la bshal gyis sbyong / /le'u bcu ba/ sman bsdus e las 'brasand kyi rnam bshad/'bras bcos ni rgyud ltar las/ / phyi 'bras sha rus rtsa gsum gyi 'bras bcos tshul gter ma byung ba nyid tshig mthun par/ gser bre dang / 'brong rtse be bum dang / dkon rgyal ba'i gces btus sogs gces btus drug las byung ba gzhan lhan thabs su yod la/ de las brtag pa ni/ zla (rma 'bras kyang bcos tshul mthun/)drug 'das nas nad ngan 'bras zhes bya/ / 'bras rigs bco lnga bsdu na gsum du 'dus/ /sha 'bras rtsa 'bras rus la zin pa'o/ / sha 'bras skrangs che bem la zug gzer chung / / gson gshin ma phyed sha ro spyang gzan 'dra/ / rtsa 'bras

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 117 mthor zhing rtsa khrid rnag chu mang / / yas mar 'pho skyen byi khung chu shor 'dra/ / nus 'bras gting zug sra mkhregs rnag chu nyung / / 'gyur med spang la be phur thebs pa 'dra/ / 'di dag spyi gtsug mig tshil mjing dkyil dang / / bdud khung mtshul gseb mchan 'og rkang pa'i mthil/ / rgyu zhabs byin dkyil mtshan mar zin sogs spang / / 'gram pa brang rus rkang bzhi'i ther la zin/ / mdun rgyab rtsib steng pran rtse bcos pa sla/ / zin nas bzang ngan gzhung chen gzhan la'ang blta/ /zhes dang / brtag thabs ni rjes bshad dam/ yang na/ gu gul dkar po mu zi a ru ra/ / sha chen byi'u nas zan mchil pa'i brun/ / zhib btags sbrang smyon byis pa'i chu yis sbyar/ / spangs par byugs la steng du bag 'gag bsku/ / shog bu'am dar gyis bcings la zhag gsum bzhag / skyon med zug 'jil spangs pa rang zhir 'gro/ / skyon can mdog 'gyur skrangs thog rnag 'go yong / / skyon tshol man ngag skrangs 'brum chu snyung yin/ / zhes dang / des rnag tu ma khug na/ nyams yig las/ phug ron byi'u nas zan mchil pa'i brun/ / bya rgod la sogs mi yi brun rnams dang / / re lcag pa dang 'bras 'dul rnam pa lnga/ / chang la btsos la zhag gsum lums su gzhug / tsha na gtar zhing kyi lce hong len bsnan/ / grang na bsreg cing gar po klad pa bsnan/ / nad stobs chung na de yis chog pa yin/ / 'di ni dpal ldan phyag pa'i phyag len no/ / zhes dang / skrangs stobs che ba la 'dul gyi man ngag rdo rje brag 'joms sbyar/ khong sman dngul chu'i sbyor ba'am klu bdud bco brgyad pa sogs sam rjes bshad sogs sbyar/ rnag tu khug na sha ro gcod pa'i

118 med lugs 'bras nad gso rigasman gang rigs kyi khu ba rma nang du gtig / de tshe nus 'bras la smug po gzong brkos lta bu sbyar ba'am sha rus gnyis ka la phan pa'i reng bu rjes bshad bzhin gzhug / de nas sha'u gso ba'i sman gyis rma gso/ / rus 'bras sel dka' na/ / rtsa'i gnas lugs brtag la rma bzos nas rus pa dang thug nas dus pa brud la/ me bsregs nas slar sha'u gso ba'i sman sogs kyis bcos pa ste brtag thabs nas bzung rus 'bras brud thabs/ sha'u gso thabs rnams tshang bar 'bri gung gces btus su yod pa ni/ sha rus rtsa yi 'bras nad kun/ the tshom sman gyi brtag pa ni/ /gu gul dkar nag ldong ros dang / / ba bla mu zi mtshal rnams mnyam/ / phye ma lo brgyad chus sgrus la/ / rma can rma med dogs sar byug / min na sman de mi 'byar zhing / / yin na byugs shul sha ror 'gyur/ (sman sbyar zhag gsum ngos nas gso/)dmar mkhrang reg pa brtse dang rnag chu 'dzag / res bde res 'ga' na la bcos skyed chung / / de yang 'bras yin gsang ba sman ('dre tsher ma 'am dug tsher ba dbyibs spyang tsher 'dra ba tsam bong shin tu ring ba sdong bo gru bzhi'i rnam pa me tog rgya kha 'char ba zhig go / lhang mthil rtsa ba yang zer/) gcig gi / shun pa rdza nang ma tshig btsan skam bya/ / de nyid cha gnyis kha tshar (rnams kun khyon bsdoms) cha gcig ni/ / dar mtshur mtshur dkar ba bla ldong ros mtshal/ / rgya tshwa 'jib (byang bul bzang po ) bu pad me dmar nag dang / / tsha gsum rdo thal shu dag sbrang rtsi sbyar/ / reng bu rmar gzhug rma kharaskyi lhan dgab/ / rus skyon che na gtso bo cha gsum la/ / rdo thal mtshal thal mtshur ldong rgya tshwa dang / / dar mtshur byang ba dung 'gron

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 119 'phrul thal dang / / shu dag gi rus bla rtsi tsha ba gsum/ / sbrang skyon reng bu gar yod gnas su bskyal/ / sha gcod rus 'gog zug rngu 'byin par byed/ / gso sman gtso bo cha gcig gur kum mtshal/ / shing mngar yung ba chu rtsa stag (sha)dom (mkhris )kar/ / phye ma rma chas dbyar dgun dus dang sbyar/ / rus sman sde bzhi bzang drug gsang sman gnyis/ / gla (rtsi )dom (mkhris )dar mtshur (tshal) sha skyi rtsa gsum dang / / ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma rma dar bkab/ / nad rgyu khrag yin gang nye yang yang gtar/ / skrangs po rngabs ras 'jib la khrag ngan 'byung / / nad rkyen gnyan yin khong sman rtsa ltos sbyang / / nad dngos 'bras yin lums 'dul chu tshan gzhug / dur rus rnying ba tshil med nas rtsam brdungs/ / sla ngar rdza sbub du ba ma shor bsregs/ / phye ma 'ib btags mar nag spos dkar sbyar/ / me chung yun gdug du tshad snag tsha 'dra/ /ngad yal tsha na sbal mdung cog la ma/ / gtso bo tsha la cong zhi bzang po yi/ / phye ma btab dkrugs nad dmigs khyab par byug / tel gis bkab bzhag zhag gsum song nas spo/ / kun gyis phan dka' rus 'bras la/ / dras bcos bya ba mkhas pa'i lugs/ / gnyan pa'i gnad rnams phal cher la/ / nad zhugs tshe na gnad kyang rdzun/ / khyad par 'bras nad zhugs pa'i tshe/ / gnad la 'dzem bag bya mi dgos/ / rus pa sbos dang de steng du/ / khab btsugs tshor ba med pa'i sar the tshom med par skyon che ste/ / nang nas khong (khyung lnga sogs gnyan rigs spyi 'joms)bsrung sum yar btang / / bla gnas sar 'dzem gri rnon ni/ /sol mes tshos bsregs (tshabs chen gnyis gsor gyin)tsha gras (rus la thug

120 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapa)bya/ / de nas sha rus phyed par phye/ / chu grang rgyun bran sen mo sogs/ / btab kyang reg bya nyams par bran/ / rjes la spra ba snum btsos brdzangs/ / de steng sha gsar dmar po ni/ / gri btsabs byas pa'i 'byar gyis mnan/ / khrag chad zhag lon kha phye la/ / skyung bu rno bas dus skyon rnams/ / cung zad ma lus brud cing bdar/ / 'di dus snying stobs bskyed par bya/ / de nas gso ba'i sman bya zhing / / nad tshabs 'bring la lcags sreg gi / tel ba gsor zhing tshos par bsreg / yang na spra tshugs brgya stong bsreg de nas gcod sman gso sman btab/ / de steng hreb 'dul 'byar gyis mnan/ / de yis thub par the tshom med/ / ces so/ / de ni bye ring gi 'bras bcos gnyis kyi don bsdus yin la ma 'dus pa lhan thabs su yod do/ / sha ro rus ro rnag ro chod dka' na/ / rgyun du mi zhun lo mar slan par shis/ / zhes dang / zas kyang rgyun du tsha skyur spang ba dang / gso dus bcud can za ba dang / / 'dul dus nya phag sha dang sngo ngad sgog btsong bsten no/ /gling stod chos rjes/ / phyi 'bras bcos thabs 'di ltar bya/ / thog mar mi rkang btsa' ma'i mgo/ nya sha spru ma'i rtsa ba rnams/ / zhib btags chang ngam rang chu yi/ / khu ba byas te bcing lums bya/ / rus 'bras rnams la mi rta khyi'i/ / rus pas gtso byas rus sna tshogs/ / me la nas ldan bsregs pa'i thal/ / chu ser sman gsum kha tshar btab/ / mar khu chu chod steng du btab/ / snum dreg 'dra bar gyur pa na/ / de nyid rus gnyan 'bras steng dkri/ / rus 'dul gdams pa khyad par 'phags/ / nang nas khyung lnga la sogs bsten/ / de rjes 'bras steng me

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 121 btsa' bya/ / zhes bshad cing / / khu tshur 'bum dang gser bre las khong sman ni/ / 'bras bcos gdams pa bshad par bya/ / sha 'bras rus 'bras rtsa 'bras mkhal 'bras mang du 'byung bar bshad/ de la sha 'bras skrangs la na ba dang / / rus 'bras khol zhing gting nas na ba dang / / rtsa 'bras 'khyug cing 'bus nas na ba dang / / mkhal 'bras ro smad gnyer po che nas bol gong gi bar du na ba la/ mkhal ma rlugargyu long yang gzer/ spu na gu'i gong tsam nas dpyi g.yas g.yon gyi me long du skrangs nas na ba dang / chu ser dang rnag 'dzag pa 'ong / brla sbom phra dang bol gong gtogs pa'i mtshams su reg mi bzod pa 'ong /rked pa chag snyam byed/ res gtad med du drags/ res rkyen med du langs 'ong / 'di rnams zla ba gsum nas ma drags na 'bras su ngos 'dzin/ 'bras rigs gang byung yang bzhi sbyor la/ cong zhi bzang ba dar tshag ma bre gang / ba dmar zal gyi 'o ma bre gsum/ rked pa yan chad la byung na sbrang dkar bre gang / man chad la byung na sbrang smug bre gang / 'bri mar srang gsum/ cong 'i/ de rnams 'o ma bzhur ba'i dwangs ma/ snyigs ma pho nas spris chags 'o ma bre gang tsam du song ba lcags kyi snod du sbrang mar cong zhi rnams bsres la btso zhing chu ma chod tsamagyi lag pas bcad nyan tsam la phog la/ (gser brer/ sman gyi kha tshar rnams gdab/ de legs par dkrugs la bya'i sgong tsam re dus gsum la za bar bya'o)de la 'bras rigs gang yin yang spyir gtong ba'i kha tshar sman la/ pi pi ling spar gang / mkhris pa'i rigs rnyed tshad bzang ba re re gser zho re'i bungs re tsam btang / mkhris sna nyung na zho re las bungs

122 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigache bar btang / / sngo sman la rtswa a ba dang / rwa cho char yag gis khyer zhing rul ba phyi shun med pa'i phye ma rnams dang / de rnams kyi steng du khyad par ske mjing dang 'gram pa la btab ste so 'tham pa dang 'gram pa skrangs na/ spyi sman bzhi sbyor gyi steng du bye brag gi kha tshar la/ cu gang /gur kum/ li shi ga wang / a ru ra/ ba sha ga brag zhun/ ru rta rnams bsnan/ khyad par du nu ma 'khyags shing brtse ba'am/ ro smad kyi yul la rnag khrag 'dzag pa byung na/ sman gong ma rnams kyi steng du/ ar nag dzā ti/ snying zho sha kha ru tshwa/ li shi gu gul dkar nag tsan+dan/chu ser sman brgyad gang 'dzom rnams bsnan/ rked pa man chad la mkhal 'bras su 'dzin pa byung na/ gangs sbal bzang po'i sha rnams bsnan/ sbrul sngo khra'i sha gser mu zi btul ma/ a ru ra/ sha chen/bre ga mkhal ma zho sha rnams bsnan/ gzhang 'brum dang gzhang gzer langs pa byung na/ spyi sman steng du mdze tshwa thun gsum btab/ brang dang mchan 'og la rnag 'dzag pa byung na/ ga bur nyer lnga ba bston/ mig dang mkhur tshos la nye na brag zhun dang gur kum thun gsum gsum/tig ta/ hong len/ ba sha ka rnams bsnan/ nu ma la byung na/ rtsa mdud che zhing gnyan pas/ gser mu zi btul ma/ brag zhun/ gur kum thun gsum/ ra mo shag rtswa a ba/ ba ru ra/ sbrul sha sbal shaka ra rnams bsnan/ de ltar spyi dang bye brag gi kha tshar gyi sman de rnams zhib par btags la btab cing legs par dkrugs la/ bya sgong tsam du dus gsum du za bar bya'o/ /rus 'bras byung na/ khong sman 'dra la/ khyad par dus 'bras

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 123 sel byed yin pas/ de 'don par byed pa la/ dngul chu/ ka ra/mkhris sna dum re/ gur kum/ cu gang / gi wang / brag zhun/ star bu/mtshal dkar rnams btang la/ ba chus dngul chu bshig la/ ril bu nyungs kur tsam re rma khar bcug dar dmar pos kha bcings/ sbang mas rma dkris byas pas/ rus sel 'thon zhing mchad do/ / bcos thabs 'di la gtar sreg spang bar bya'o/ / sman mar gyi sbyor sde 'dis lan cig la yang phan par nus shing / nad tshabs shin tu che na lan gsum bsten zhing rgyun bsring bas nges par phan no/ / khong 'bras la tig ta 'bring po'i sman mar gyis phan par gsungs/ zhes so/ /le'u bcu gcig pa/ man ngag bka' rgya ma lasa'abrasand kyi rnam bshad/dar mo sman rams pa'i man ngag bka' rgya ma las/ 'bras nad kyi brtag bcos zab mo bzhugs so/ / rma a tha/ 'gro rnams dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyi/ / zug rngu'i nad las skyob mdzad pa'i/ / sman pa mchog dang de yi sras/ / brgyud par bcas la gus btud nas/ / sha rus rtsa rnams gdung ba yi/ / 'bras kyi brtag bcos bstan pa la/ /dang por gdams pa chig brgyud rgya/ / rtags ni chu ser rkun po nyid/ /lus kyi lhan skyes srin dang bcas/ / sha rus rtsa la zhen pa la/ / 'bras nad ces su bshad pa yin/ / de dag ngos 'dzin rtags thabs ni/ / sha

124 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'abras nyung gsher 'khyag pa 'dra/ / rus 'bras lcags gzer btab pa 'dra/ / rtsa 'bras sbrul nag khros pa 'dra/ / de la sad mda' sman gyis brtag / gu gul nag po ldong ros dang / / ba bla mu zi mtshal rnams mnyam/ / zhib btags phye ma lo brgyad chus/ / sbrus la gang na'i sar byugs pa/ / min na 'byar de mi 'byar 'ing / / yin na byugs na 'byar de nas bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa/ / dang po lums kyis 'dul bar bya/ / tsha ba gsum dang go stod dang / / g.yer ma lcam pa lan tshwa'i phye/ / glum klad sbyar ba zhag 'ga' bcings/ / de nas 'bras 'dul dngos gzhi yi/ / sbyor tshul zab gnad 'di ltar ston/ / phyi yi 'dul la chen po dang / / 'bring dang chung ngu rnam pa gsum/ / de yang sha 'dul rus 'dul dang / / chu rgyus 'dul dang rtsa 'dul las/ / dang po chen po'i sbyor ba ni/ / mi rta khyi dang phag pa'i rus/ / sha ru btsa' ma de lnga bo/ / nas tsam brdungs la nus ldan bsregs/ / gtso bo yin pas cha lnga dang / / dung dang 'gron bu nya phyis dang / / 'brug rus nya rus lnga bo ni/ / gong gi phyed cha thub par btang / / de steng mi rta khyi sogs kyi/ /rus pa sna tshogs legs bsdus pa'i/ / khaṇ+ḍa chu ser sman brgyad kyis/ /kha tshar btab pa bre gang tsam/ / rdo sman rdo rgyus mthing rgyus dang / / ba nu sbal rgyab pho mo mtshal/ / mdung rtse gangs thigs gser gyi rdo/ /dngul rdo stong zil gser zil dang / / smug po dri ldan mardzi ra/ / khab len rdo klad rdo mkhris dang / / khrag mgo bye'u mgo rdo phag mgo/ gru bzhi brag zhun rdo zho dang / / cong zhi rgod 'dul ba bla dang / / ldong ros la sogs rdo sman gyi/ / rigs rnams tshogs tshad ('byor ba srang re) khyad

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 125 par du/ / 'bol ba'i rigs rnams cha che tsam/ / mi sha nya sha sbrul gyi sha(srang re)/ / phag la sogs pa'i sha dang ni/ / g.yag god ra la sogs pa'i khrag(sna tshogs srang khrag)/ / mi khyi spyang ki sogs kyi brun/ / ra yi ril ma (srang re)phur mong dang / / dud pa (phul gsum)slang dreg (srang phyed re)sgo nga sbyin(phulagasum)/ / gser thal dngul thal (phul gsum re)seng phrom thal/ / shug pa ba lu mtshe mkhan pa/ /'om bu smyag shad se skyer dang / / nye shing ra mnye ba spru ba/ / lca ba spyi zhur myang rtsi spras/ / bra ma shel ta chu ma rtsi/ /lug ru ser po chu rug pa/ / btsong dang 'bam po la (sngo sman rnams re re cha snyoms nus ldan bsregs pa phul phyed do re)sogs dang / / a ru ba ru kham bu'i (srangare)tsig / bse ru rgya ru gna' ru dang / / kha sha (zhobyed re)ba 'bri glang gi rwa (zhilngare)/ / dngul chu mu zi mtshal dkar sogs/ / zhib btags snum ni bskol bar sbyar/ / de yang tsha grang mde kha ni/ / bsgyur bas gnad du tsha bas na/ / tsha shas che la chu rug pa/ / tsher sngon chu 'thung og dkar dang / / tig ta re skon a bi ṣa/ / rgya spos dang ni spang spos pa/ / dpa' ser yug shing pu shel tse/ / rgya skyegs ske tshe (gong sngo sman bsdoms pas phyed do)kyi lce sogs/ /bsil ba'i sngo sman sna tshogs dang / / cu gang (srang re )tsan dan dkar dmar sogs/ /la sman bzang po dag kyang sdebs/ / grang ba'i rigs la tsha phabs (phul gang re)bul/ / shing tshwa sgog skya tsi tra (dra ba la sogs sung re re sngo so so phul re)ka / tsha ba gsum sogs drod sman gyi/ / rigs rnams rig pas brtag la btang / / dzā ti li shi (srang re) la sogs kyang / / skabs 'dir 'debs pa mkhas pa'i lugs/ / gnyan nad

126 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'ajoms pa'i bi ṣa (srang gsum )nag / chu rtsa stag sha re lcag pa (srang drug re)/ / thar nu shu dag la sogs dang (zho bzhi)/ / gla gul (srang gang )dag kyang bsnan na shes/ / bse ru thal (spang re ) ka rdo rje dang / / zi ra (srangare) gnyis dang til dkar nag / rtsa kha bsdam par gur kum (srang re)dang / / dom la sogs pa'i mkhris sna tshogs/ /rgu drus brag spos (zhobazhi re) rta lpags pa/ / shing mngar (zho bzhi)rgya mtsho'i lbu ba (sung gang ) sogs/ / rig pa'i mda' yis bsnun la byas/ / de rnams kun gyi dam rtsi la/ / spos dkar (brebacu) mtshal dkar (bre lnga)chang sbyor (gar chang gsum )sogs/ / gdon byung lud yang dben par mi/ / tsha grang snyoms par bskol la gdu/ / de nas gar sdig byung ba dang / / gong gi phye ma blugs la dkrug / dro 'jam bsgril btub rdo steng byo/ / spu rdul mi 'byung snod du bcang / / sbyor lugs lag len zhib par ni/ / mthong ba brgyud pa'i lam nas gsal/ /'bring du sbyor na rus sna bcur/ / chu ser sman brgyad kha tshar btab/ /mi sha nya sha spru nag rtsa/ / re lcag cong zhi rgod 'dul sbyar/ / tsha grang mde kha bsgyur ba sogs/ / kun la gces pa gong du bstan/ /chung ngu'i sbyor ba mi rta khyi/ / rus pa btsa' ma chu ser sman/ / spos dkar mar nag la btab bskol/ / de la mde kha bsgyur ba'i sman/ / gang la gang dgos brtag te gdab/ / de ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du/ / sbyor ba 'di yang yul dus dang / / gnas skabs la sogs dpag ste shes/ / 'di rnams sbyar ba'i phan yon ni/ / sha rus rus pa rtsa 'bras kyis/ rengs 'khums rma rgan rnag 'dzag skrangs/ / chu ser dkar nag gnyan gyi

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 127 rigs/ / rkang 'bam dreg grum sur ya dang / / tshigs nad rmen bu rtsa kha shor/ / sha ro nus ro la sogs pa'i/ / mdor na gsar rnying bcos dka'i nad/ / mtha' dag reg tsam gyis 'tsho ba'i/ / reg 'tsho 'bras 'dul yin zhes bya/ / bye brag gnas kyis kha bsgyur la/ / sha 'bras 'dul na mi sha dang / / nya sha brag spos seng ldeng sogs/ / chu ser sman dang gzhan yang ni/ / sha 'bras gnyen po gang 'os sbyar/ / rus 'bras 'dul na rus sna bcu/ / gang 'dzoms steng du stab seng dang / / stong zil gser zil dngul zil sogs/ rus 'bras 'dul ba'i gnyen po bsnan/ rgyus 'bras 'dul na rgyus pa ni/ sna tshogs btsos pa'i khaṇ+ḍa la/rdo rgyus gsum sogs gnyen po'i sman/ gang 'os kha tshar btab par bya/rtsa 'bras 'dul na gur kum dang / gser skud mtshal dang rdo mkhris sogs/ rtsa 'dul gnyen po gang 'os dang / chu ser sman sogs kha tshar btab/ de ltar legs sbyar bskus pa yi/ phan yon 'bras kyi ba mo la/'dul byed rta ljang shar 'di mtshar/ bar du bka' gros 'gro don rgya/mtshungs med g.yu thog mgon po yis/ / mu zi smug sbyor ma shes na/'bras nad gso ba'i sman pa min/ zhes gsungs de yi lag len la/spos snum chu thag legs bcad dug dbyung la/ rtsa ba'i sman rnams nus ldan bkug pa dang / sha rus gcig thal pa gol sirnyu ra/ mdze tshwa 'brug dus rnam yug stag sha dang / tshwa la re lcag brag spos gla dom mkhris/ khyi la chu rtsa mu zi bzhi dang bcas/ zhib btags phye ma ngad yal dus su bstim/ bya thabs mthong brgyud lag len gtan la dbab/ bse dug 'bras mdze sur ya'i rnag phog rigs/ rma rnying kun 'tsho gsang ba'i

128 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigabaka' rgya 'di/ nam mkha'i mtshan can las brgyud shin tu zab/ byang khra bul tog cha mnyam zhib btags la/ phag tshil bzhus pas dro 'jam dag la btab/ gang nar byugs la me nyis bsro bar bya/ dreg grum rkang 'bam chu ser nad kyi rigs/ gnam lcags rdo rje'i tshul du 'joms pa'o/ / sha ro rus ro gcod pa'i mtshon cha ni/ sman chen bsregs thal rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa mtshal/ sbal rgyal bzang po byang ba ze tshwa rnams/ sha ro gcod pa lcags kyi sta re yin/ rus la dwa rgod shog shing dug shing bsnan/gcod pa'i man ngag smug po bzang bskos yin/ skyon sel sha'u skye ru ma 'dod na/ 'brug rus stag sha brag spos tha rams bzhi/ chu rtsa dom mkhris dag la sbyar la gdab/ gso sman tsha la gar sbrin bya ba yi na/ 'di la zas spyod bya sgong nya sha dang / mi sha phag sha nang khrol sngo ngan zwa/ sgog btsong bsten pa gnad du che ba yin/ gsod dus mngar gsum sha gsar rtsi mar dang / til mar la sogs bcud ldan zas dag bsten/sha ro rus ro rnag ro gcod dka' na/ rgyun du mi zhun lo mar sman mar shes/ khong sman spos khyung dngul chu bco brgyad sogs/ gang 'tshams brtags de btang na bde legs 'byung / skyur dang tshwa gnyis 'bras kyi dug yin pas/ ha la bzhin du rgyun du spang bar gces/ 'di 'dra sa bdag klu yi nad yin pas/ brngan pa byin la sngags kyi char ba dbab/rdzas kyis byug cing rig 'dzin me yis bsreg 'bras bcos 'di ni rgya nag ha rtsi'i lugs/ shin tu zab pas gces bar bzung bar bya/ spos dkar mu zi a ru ra/ sha chen nas zan byi ba'i brun/ zhib btags sbrang smyon byis pa'i chu/ sbyar la spangs par byugs pa'i steng / shog bu'am

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 129 dar gyis bcings la bzhag skyon med zug 'byin skrangs pa ni/ rang zhir 'gro zhing skyon can rnams/ / mdog 'gyur spangs thog rnag 'go yang / skyon bral man ngag skrangs 'dul yin/ skrangs pa gsar rnying ci 'dra yang / spru ma nya skam cong zhi dang / mi rkang bzhi yis skrangs pa 'jigs/ gzhan yang gsar 'gyur las/ 'bras dang shu ba gang la yang / thog mar glang klad dag gis bkrus/ de nas ni la tho ṭha'i phye/btal ba nyi mar gzhig par bya/ sang nyin ni la tho ṭha dang / spos dkar cha mnyam zhib bar btags/ til snum bsres pa'i cung zad mnye/de nas chu ni cung zad blugs/ lhan du nyin phyed tsam gyi bar/ mnyes pas kha dog dkar po 'ong / de nyid byug pas myur du phan/ yang na gnyan 'bur skrangs ba la/ ba gcin sdus bsres skyo ma ni/ drod ma yal bar skrangs por byug ras kyis bsdams la grang ba dang / yang yang brje na gnad du che/ myur du rnag tu smin par 'gyur/ smin nas brtol la sga ser ni/ mer bsreg chur brdar gang rdol sar/ bug pa che chung ci 'dod kyang / yang yang byug pas myur du rdol/ spra tshil bzhus te ras la btsags/ de steng ba mar btsags bcad pa/ blugs te bkrus pas legs par 'dres/ mchu dang rkang lag gas par byug 'phral du phan pa the tshom med/ de sogs lag len myong grub yin/ gong du sbyar thabs lag len ni/ mthong ba brgyud nas gsal zhes pa/ 'di yang gab na blo dman 'gas/ ma rtogs dogs nas gsal bar ston/ de yang sman rnams nad gzhi yi/ tsha grang gnyan shas che chung sogs/ 'thad ldan rig pas brtags la sbyar/ de nyid zhib bar brdar ba'i phye/ sta gon

130 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigabyas la rdza sogs kyi/ snod la gong gi sman rnams dang / 'tshams pa'i mar nag blugs pa'i steng / spos dkar gar chang tsha la gsum/ gong ma rim pas cha cher byas/ gdon zhud byung na lud yong bas/ dben par sol mes bskol zhing dkrug gdus nas gar sdig byung ba dang / gong gi sman phye btab la dkrug dro 'jam dril du btul ba'i tshe/ gtun du zhag bar brdungs nas ni/ spu rdul la sogs mi 'gro ba'i/ snod du legs par bcings byas la/ dgos pa'i dus su las sbyor bya/ 'gro rnams lhan skyes rma sogs zug rngu'i nad/ mi bzad drag pos mnar ba gso ba'i thabs/ 'bras 'dul rgyas 'bring bsdus sogs sbyar ba 'dis/ba mo la ni nyi shar ji bzhin byed/ na mo gu ru be+eḍūr+ya/ gtum (sman chen)po nag po thugs khros te/ sku la gser (churtsa) slog pa gsol/dbu la dar (ralcag)gyi thod bcings shing / khro gnyer (shudagaterab bgrad shel (spos dkar) ral 'chang / gnam lcags (rams) phug (ronabrun)khyer dud chen (dud pa ral ba)'bar(kuzi)/ klad (yung ba)la bya lding (brun )ce spyang 'brang / 'dre 'jigs (gu gul)bka' grol chen mo mdzad/ dgra yul (nad kyi ) dmag drongs nyes gsum bsad/ skyon can 'bras rnams phyi la 'don/ ya ma nag po'i mgo lag bcad/ gnyan lhog skrangs pa pha mthar skyod/ nye ring shan 'byed mkhas pa yin/ spangs kun 'joms pa'i pho nya 'dis/ glo gtad rgya mi mtha' nas skying / ra dug pa dang be ser can/ re lcag shu dag rdo rgyus dang / gu gul dkar nag mu zi rams/ sum khyi spyang ki'i brun rnams dang / phug ron brun ni ser tsam brngos/ de rnams zhib btags mar

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 131 rnying ngam/ phag tshil rnams ni nad kyi babs/ tsha grang gsar rnying dpag la byug chu ser kun dang khyad par gnyan/ rma rkyen 'bras rigs skrangs kun la/ thog med 'gro ba'i phyug ser 'di/ gab pa mngon du phyung nas bris/ mkhas mang dkyil du grags pa ston/ bya khyung sngon pos dar sngon (rams)gyon/ skrangs kyi spyod ku (thar nu)dbul gsol/ khro gnyer (shudag)gnod byed bgegs la gtsigs/ dri ngad ldan (shing kun) pa'i dri la snoms/ sgom ('byi ba) chen zhun mar mdangs ldan pas/ 'bras nad ya ma gnyan dag gis/ reg pa zug zhi rang srog srang / nad yams sna tshogs kha lo bsgyur/ gshin rje'i thebs 'di yis bzlog gso yul 'bras rnams 'di yis 'joms/ bya khyung nag po ra dug (sman chen )pa/ re (lcag)ba (chu)mdzo(chu) (shu)dag dud (dug) ral mnyam/ rlangs ba'i dreg pa sbyar bsdebs pas/gnyan lhog rgod po gnyer zhing spangs/ ram ram 'khyug pa 'khyug 'dzin byed/ gnyan rgod 'phyo ba'i ltag rtsa spu/ 'bras nad bem po chu ser 'byin/ 'gro rnams lhan skyes rma sogs zug rngu'i nad/ mi bzad drag pos mnar ba gso ba'i thabs/ 'bras 'dul che 'bring chung gsum sbyor 'di yis/ ba mo la ni nyi shar ji bzhin byed/ tha mar dam ldan slob bu'i rgyaḥ 'di la lung dang lag len med par longs spyod na/ zhang sdon sogs sman sruje rnams kyis de'i snying khrag rol bar gnyer du gtad

132 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigale'u bcu gnyisapa/ phan bde'i bang mdzod las 'brasand skor gyi rnam bshad/bad kun mid 'gags kyi bcos khyad par can ni/ dang po byung ba'i dus su man ngag bsil sbyor zhag 'ga' bston/ lu ba mang na spang rgyan bco lnga cong zhi'i khu bas dbul/ de rjes cong zhi rgod btul gyis gzhi bzung la/ sga pi pho dbyi mong tsi tra ka ste tsha ba lnga/ rgya rgyam kha gsum/dza sug ko gsum/ sngo'i tsha ba gsum/ se 'bru byi tang ka ru rta la phud rnams sbyar ba'i phye ma chu bskol tsha mos dbul/ skabs su ri sho spyang tsher shu dag dur byid rgyam tshwa pi ling rnams kyis skyugs sman btang ste/ nad pa gan rkyal bsnyal/ skyugs lud byung dus lus ma 'chus par bslangs te sgro sogs kyis skyugs sna drangs/ skabs 'ga' bshal sman non pos sbyangs/ yang na sbyong skyugs sbrags ma bya/ gdon gang gnod bcos rim gro bya/ de nas khong sman gla rtsi a ru ra/ dom mkhris bzang drugam nu bzhi bo thun re sbyar btags cha gsum byas pa'i thun gsum po/ de las/ dang por thun gcig g.yag rog po'i khrag dang chang bzang phul gang sbyar bas khong du btang /slar yang rus 'don sman thun gnyis po khrag chang dang sbyar te re re bzhin btang bas/ sngon las ma gtogs thun gsum po des nad

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 133 las grol ba bden rdzun lag tu blangs pas gsal/dpyad du thong rtsa gsal na zhad tsam gtar/ mi gsal na lce rtsa'am/ rtse'u chung 'ad tsam gtar/ pho ba na shas che na se 'bru lnga bar cong zhi rgod btul byas pa bsres te btang / tshigs pa bzhi ba bsreganya sha dang ol gong tsha ba btang / tshogs bsags rim gro sgrib sbyong gang 'os bya/ des mgul 'gags nad las bde myar du grol bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ / stosreg pa dang 'jol mo'i shas bad kun mid 'chus la phan/ /le'u bcu gsum pa/ mgo log khams gtsang 'brug rgyal gyi 'bras bcos thun min 'ga'/dang po/ bad kun mgul 'gagasakyi rnam bshad rgyasapa/mgul 'gags gyen rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs pho ba'i stod/ bad kun rgyas pa'i rlangs pa mgul bar chags/ mdong ma'i logs la zo sha chags pa 'dra/ thog mar gre ba tsha la min pa dang / brang dang ske stong nyen sna tshigs pa na/ bar du zas skom min dka' ('byin rngub)dbugs mi bde/ gre ba na la lud pa ljan ljin mang / / mid pa log cing bya rog mig gnyis gzer/ sha rnams skam la lus kyi stobs kyang 'chor/ tha ma gre ba tsha skam zas mi thar/ / thar kyang pho bar mi phebs brang du sdod/ /zos dus glo langs skyugs zhing skyigs bu 'byung / / dbugs 'tshub ngar

134 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigasog sgra 'byung mid pa 'gags/ / tha ma'i rtags tshang 'chi ba'i dus su 'dug / snga ma gnyis ni 'bad pas bcos na 'tsho/ / zhes gsungs rgyud kyi dngos bstan de tsam yang / / bad kun skya bo mgul 'gags de nyid ni/ / dus kyi dbang dang sngon las gdon rkyen gyis/ / nad rtags mi 'dra sna tshogs ston gyur yang / / ngo bo mgul 'gags nyid las gzhan ma yin/ / rgyud kyi sbas don bkral te gso bcos skor/ / sman dpyad sngags kyi gdams pa zab mo yang / / sngar med zhing khrom rgya yis gter nas byung / / de phyir bad kun gre thogs ces bya ba/ / mgul 'gags lkog 'gags ming gi rnam grangs so/ / sgos kyi nad rtags brang rgyab phrag mig gzer/ / brang tsha skabs su lce steng spu yod 'dra/ / yang na rtog bor yar mar 'gro ba snyam/ / nang gses dbye ba bzhi dgu bco brgyad sogs/ / du mar dbye yang tsha 'gags grang 'gags gnyis/ /lkog ma 'gags 'dra skud pas bcings 'dra dang / / ske phyi rgyas snyam stod na dbugs 'tshangs 'gyur/ / kha nas rnag bro mchil ma mid pa dka'/ / zas skom min la rung ba tsam du yod/ mchil lud rnag chu sngo rmen thon pa 'byung / / res 'gar mid par rus khab zug 'dra 'ong / / mig rna snying gzer lus kun tsha shar 'ong / / mchin srog ske gsum sprel nas na ba dang / gnyid med skyug snyam sems la sdug snang che/ / res 'ga' nad med sos pa lta bu 'byung / na tshe min tsha skad chen sgrog mi nyan/ ngo dang lce lkog 'brum pa 'ong / / mid pa'i nang tsha rkan phug za/ / 'brum pa'i mgo te shus mi rung / /

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 135 gnyisapa/ gre thogasaspu thog ske 'gagasakyi gsobacosasladang golab rnam dgu bshad pa/rlung thog rlung shas che bcos sla/ / spu thog lhe steng spu yod 'dra/ / de bas zur tsam bcos pa dka'/ / gre 'byar ske 'gags bcos pa dka'/ / gre thogs de bas cung zad sla/ / gre 'gags zer ba'i rigs kyang yod/ gre thogs ngo bo 'dzer ba yin/ mid par de byung gre thogs zer/ pho bar byung na pho thog zer/ / 'dzer mgo bud dus khab zug 'dra/ / rkang lag brkyang dus tsha shar 'ong / / nad 'di gang yang yun lon tshe/ / zla ba bdun brgyad las mi 'tsho/ / 'jug dus ston nam dpyid dus yin/ / byis ba dar mar byung ba dkon/ / gsungs kyang de dus ma nges so/ / ja chang kha zas spyod drags sam/ / zhes sdang 'khor 'dzin mya ngan che/ / rkyen las nad 'di byung ba mang / / bye brag nad de babs sa'i dbang gis ni/ / gol ba rnam pa dgu yi nad rtags 'byung / / de yang pho bar babs pa'i spu byi gsum/ / dang bo bad kun tsha ba spu byi zhes/ / de ni mchin khrag pho bar bsags pa dang / / mchin pa rgyas nas pho ba mnan zhing na/ brang tsha skyur dang khrag skyug mchin pa na/skom dad che la pho bas zas mi len/ / 'di 'dus 'ga' zhig smug po'i nang du 'khrul/ / mi nor rtags su spyi rtags tshang na nges/ / gnyis pa bad kun grang ba spu byi ni/ bad gan skya bos pho ba'i me drod bsad/ / de phyirakha zas gang yang 'ju mi nus/ / gsum pa bad kun grol ma spu byi ni/ / stod du yar skyug smad du thur 'khru zhing / / pho ba srin 'bus gang

136 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'adra gzer drag 'ong / / skyug cing skabs su lam lam 'gul ba snyam/ /mgo dang ro stod la babs rnam pa gsum/ / dang bo bad kun tsha ba klad byi zhes/ / mgo bo 'thom zhing klad pa tsha 'thib che/ / spyi bo lci 'thib rdo leb bkab pa 'dra/ / sna chu kham pa 'dzag pa'i rtags rnams 'byung / / gnyis pa bad kun tsha ba mtshul rdib ni/ / gre ba tsha la mtshul ba sub cing na/ / sngog byil skye zhes mid par rang shugs bsags/ /gsum pa bad kun tsha ba gre 'gags ni/ / ske yi mid sha rta sha cher skyes nas/ / gre ba 'gags pa bzhin du na ba'o/ /mid par babs pa gsum yod 'di lta ste/ dang po bad kun tsha ba 'brum skam zhes/ / mid zhabs pho ba'i bar gyi rmen gnyis de/ cher skyes mid pa 'gags pas sos pa dka'/ mid par yar mar 'gro ldog nyams snang byung / / gnyis pa bad kun dru bu gyen log ces/ pho mid bar du dru bu gyen 'gro ltar/ / kyu ru ru 'gro chu sngon nar mo 'ong / / mid par ri li li yis yar mar rgyug / skabs su skyug 'byung shin tu gso ba dka'/ / gsum pa bad kun tsha ba gong ldib ni/ gre ba khol bur skam la skabs su brnangs/ / res 'ga' bde la re 'ga' mi bde byed/ /skabs 'gar mid pa me yis tshig snyam 'ong / / de rnams mdor bsdus tsha 'gags grang 'gags gnyis/ /gsumapa/ khamasagatsang 'brug rgyalagyi mgul 'gagasabacosathabasakyi lag len dngosam/mgul 'gags nad ni mi dge'i rnam smin dang / / gyen rgyu'i

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 137 rlung 'khrugs rkyen las byung ba ste/ 'tsho bar dka' yang bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa/ / lce rtsar 'brum thor byung na de bzhar nas/ / srin sman 'debs dang lce chung lhung ba na/ de nyid gcod la shul de legs par bsregs/ brag zhun star bu ru rta shing kun dang / / go stod tshar bong sro lo rgyam tshwa dang / sga skya kun dang mnyam pa'i rdo thal sbyar/ / 'u su ma nu g.yag rog khrag dron rnams/ gang rigs btang bas mgul 'gags la phan zhes/ / thog mar man ngag bsil sbyor zhag 'ga' bsten/ / de rjes cong zhi rgod btul gzhi bzung la/ / tsha ba lnga dang tshwa sna tshogs tshad bsags/ bzang bo bzhi dang sngo yi tsha ba gsum/ / se 'bru byi tang ru rta la la phud/ sbyar ba'i phye ma chu bskol tshan mos dbul/ / skabs su ri sho spyang tsher lcum rtsa dang / dur byin rgyam tshwa pi pi ling sbyar bas/ / skyug zos nas nad pa gan rkyal nyal/ skyug langs nad pa ma 'chus dal bus bslang / / sgro'am gzhu rgyud bldan pas skyugs sna drangs/ skabs 'gar bshal skyugs sbrags mas sbyang ba dang / / rdo zho cong zhi'i chu tshan mang btung bas/ / yang yang skyug gzhug de dag gang gis kyang / / ma sel rgyud kyi ltar bu bañca'i steng / / spyang tsher bsnan pas 'dren kyang e 'phrod blta/ thong rtsa rtse chung gang gsal zed tsam gtar/ / ske stong lhen gsang tshigs pa bzhi ba bsreg / pho rub nad byung thog mar nas chur khur/ tshwa sreg sga sbyar ni ru ha yis sbyong / /a ru lcum rtsa'i thang gis rtug rlon bya/ ug chos rtsa ba me tog thang btang bas/ thur sel rlung gyen log pa mang la 'gug de nas khong sman gang 'os bsten par bya/ pho rub la brten bad kun zas skyugs la/ / tsha ba

138 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigagasum dang tshwa sna gsum ko byil/ bsreg thal a ru shing kun la la phud/ / ru rta sbyar ba'am a ru gsum nus bsreg / da lis 'jam 'bras pi ling se 'bru dang / bse yab bu ram sbyar ba btang bas gcod/mid 'gag pho 'gag gang la'ang cong zhi ni/ rgod btul sga skya ma nu tsha la bsreg / byang bul star bu rgya tshwa cung zad bsnan/ yang na gla rtsi dom mkhris a ru ra/ / rgyam tshwa ba ru skyu ru star bu dang / rgya tshwa ze tshwa sbyar phye thun gsum ni/ / nyin gsum snga dro langs ma thag tu ni/ g.yag rgod khrag dron chang bsres phor gang dang / phor phyed lhag dang phor phyed kyis 'thung ngo / / nya sha ol gong tshan mor khong du btang / mid 'chus mgul 'gags nad las grol pa mthong / / khyad par kho bo'i lag len 'di lta ste/ nad 'di gsar dus bcos thabs rnying zhen nas/ zas skom mi thar skyug skyigs byung tshe 'chi/bzhi ba/ gre thogasakyi spyi bcosadang mgula'agagasabasreg dmigs/bad kun gre thogs nad kyi spyi bcos la/ / thog mar man ngag bsil sbyor zhag 'ga' bsten/ a ru se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling sga dang ma nu 'u su bse yab dang / / skyu ru da lis spang rgyan ba ru ra/ / re ral shel tang chu dag sro lo dkar/ star bu ut+pal dom mkhris g.yer ma dang / / brag zhun tshwa sna mgron thal brla ta/ / bu ram pu shel tse dang snying zho she khyad par gsang sman gsum (go bo'i mid pa dang pho ba/ spyang ki'i pho ba dang mid pa/ nya sha) bcas sbyar ba la/ man ngag rtsa ba'i sman

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 139 sbyor sum cu ba/ / snga 'gyur gter ma las byung zab khyad can/ gre thogs tsha grang spyi sman ngo mtshar che/ / zla gcig bar du sman bsten de rjes su/ gnyan dang tsha shas med na 'bros 'phrang bsdams/ / man ngag snyan brgyud me btsa' 'di ltar gdab/ / nad pa lus bsring nad tshang ngo sprod ni/ tsa ra khung nas gyen du tshod phyed na/ nad tshang 'og ma de nas song phyed na/ nad tshang bar ma zhes bya mkhas rnams bzhed/ / ol mdud rtse mo nad tshang chen mo dang / de nas tshon phyed gyen bcal gong ma ste/ nad tshang bzhi la me btsa' sngags gdab na/ nad gtor srog la rgol bas dus kun spang / 'bros 'phrang dgag la snga na tshang la 'phoga'aphyi na 'bros tshar phan gnod med par 'gyur/ / 'on kyang snga bas cung zad 'phyis na legs/ / sman bsten zla gcig song rjes me btsa' bya/ /dang po tsa ra khung du me btsa' gcig / yar la tshon phyed nad tshang 'og ma yi/ / g.yas g.yon tshon phyed gsum ga dus gcig 'jog de nas zhag gsum tsa ra khung nas yar/ / tshon gang bcal mtshams nad tshang bar ma nas/ / g.yas g.yon tshon re bcal ba'i sne gnyis bsreg de nas zhag gsum nad tshang gong ma ste/ / ol mdud nas yar tshon phyed g.yas g.yon du/ / sor re'i mtshams su bsregs pas 'phrang dgu dgag / gzhan du spyi yi 'bros 'phrang dgag ces pa/ / ske stong phrag mig bar du tshon re dang / / tshon phyed spel mar me btsa'i phreng ba gdab/ /lngab/ mgula'agagasagasoba'i sman sbyor/kho bo'i nyams myong sman sbyor lag len ni/ spang rtsi ril bu gre nad

140 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigakun sbyong dang / gsang sman gab pa mngon du phyung ba gnyis/ gre thogs gsang sman gzhan yang gre sbyong dang / / dpa' bo nyer gcig bdud rtsi'i zegs ma sogs/ / phan yon nad babs bstun nas gang 'os bston/ / phan pa'i nyams myong brgya phrag lag blang ba'o/ / gzhan yang dzā ti pha la'i nyis 'gyur ni/ / cong zhi bzang bo btang bar bya/ / de yi nyis 'gyur ka ra btang / / de gsum zhib tu btags pa de/ / snga dro gre bar thun re 'bud/ / glo byung glo sman kha tshar 'debs/ / zhag bcu 'das nas sos pa yin/ / gre 'gag tshabs che na/ bul tog bya bal thun gcig dang / / cong zhi bzang bo thun gnyis btang / / sman rta ka ra thun gnyis rnams/ / zhib btags lto ni zos pa'i rjes/ / gre bar sgro rtses skyel ba yin/ / glo byung glo sman gong dang mthun/ / zhes dang dran 'dzin las/ / spang (rgyan )ljongs skyed byed (gur kum)mdzes byed na chung ma/ / a gar smin pa'i dri bsung 'phro ba'i gdong / / cu gang (dang ka ra)phung ngam lhum rtsa'i mdog ltar dkar/ / bum bzang pi ling li shi'i chus gang ba'i/ / dpag bsam ('bras bu gsum)shing (tsan dan )gi kha brgyan bcas pa la/ / gnyan 'joms (sa 'dzin) dar dkar (gur kum )g.yob 'phreng thogs bzhin pa/ / rdo thal cha mnyam 'thab pas mgul 'gags sel/ / rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i dbus ('brong khrag)/ / gser gyi mi pho rngam brjid can (gser mdog)dom bu thung dkar chibs su chib (dom mkhris)/ / gla ba (rtsi) rog po rol du khrid/ / za 'og (gur kum)mtshal(rgyamatshal)bkra sku la gsol/ / tshan de hril 'jong (liling )rmog mo gsol/ 'dre 'dul (gugul)'od zer

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 141 g.yas nas 'gying / / dri bzang spos (dkar)khug g.yon du 'dzin/ /'ching byed yi dwags rdul du rlog / nyams yig las/ bad kun mgul 'gags cong zhi rgol btul dang / / tsha ba lnga dang bzang bo gsum/ /tshwa sna gsum dang la la phud/ / zhib btags chu tshan dag gis phul/ /khyad par tsha 'gag sel ba la/ / kho bo'i cong zhi'i sbyor ba dang / /bdud rtsi'i zegs ma gang shis bsten/ / spang rgyan bco lnga'am nyer lnga/ /li shi bcu gcig sogs kyang phan/ / grang 'gags sel ba'i sman sbyor la/ / rdo thal sbyor sde khyad par zab/ / yang na dres sam sbyor ba bya/ / skabs su skyugs kyi drangs 'dod na/ / ri sho drug pa'i skyug sman nam/ / bshal na star bu lnga ba sogs/ / gang dgos rig pas dpyad par mdzod/ / 'brong khrag drug pa brgyad pa dang / / go gre'i sbyor ba'ang 'di la 'phrod/ / tsha 'gag grang 'gag gang la yang / / be khrag nyer lnga tshad ldan zab/ / nad 'di pho bar mar babs nas/ / 'dril na rdo thal sbyor bas bshig / nyen dang me mnyam skran gsang nas/ / dkar nag mtshams dang de nas yar/ / tshon ring gang dang yang gang ste/ / brgyad por rim pas mas yar bsreg / lce rgyas skad 'gags gyen thon rtags/ / lce rtsa g.yas g.yon gang rung gtar/ / kha zas yib rul tshig po dang / / khyad par rgyu khrag sha rnying spang / /drug pa/ golabarnamadagu'i bcosathabs/da ni bye brag gol ba rnam pa dgu'i/ / bcos thabs spu byi gsum gyi spyi chings ni/ / tsha ba spu byi gtar dang sbyong gis bcos/ / grang ba spu

142 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigabyi me dang thur mas bcos/ / grol ma spu byi zas dang dpyad kyis bcos/ / de la rtsa sman lnga zhes gter ma ni/ gro gre yu mo srol gong 'bri ta dang / / ba lu ma nu rnams pa lnga ru gsungs/ / tsha ba spu byi'i nad la de lnga'i steng / / hong len tsi tra ka dang gi waṃ dang / / bse 'bras brag zhun tsha la bul rtog dang / / li shi ka ras rta byas lan 'ga' btang / /zhag 'ga' song rjes mchin pa'i gsha' rings gtar/ / grang ba spu byi rtsa sman lnga yi steng / / bzang drug tsha ba gsum dang drod sman rigs/ /yod tshad bsnan pa bu ram rta yis phul/ / 'di la dpyad bcos me btsa' thur ma 'phrod/ / zas spyod drod bsten bsil spang rtsol bcag phan/ / grol ma spu byi rtsa sman steng sga skya/ / ze tshwa rgya tshwa shing kun shu dag dang / / bul tog g.yer ma sbyar ba chang chus phul/ / tsha ba klad byir rtsa sman stong ru rta/ / sro lo a ru ka ra ba lu'i phul/ / tsha ba che na mchin rtsa gtar ba dang / / spyang tsher mdzo mo shing dang ba 'o bcas/ / ka ra'i rta byas skyugs kyis drangs bar bya/ / tsha ba mtshul ldib spang rgyan bcu ba zhes/ / spang rgyan dkar bo bsil gsum shing sngon dang / a ru shing mngar hong len re skon pa/ / brag zhun bcu bo gong ma rim par bskyed/ / sna rtsa thong rtsa rtse chung gtar ga bya/ / tsha ba gre 'gag rtsa sman lnga yi steng / / hong len a phyag gu gul shu dag dang / / ru rta stong zil ka ra sbyar la btang / / tsha ba 'brum skam rtsa sman steng bzang drus / rgya tshwa chu dug 'brong dang dred mo'i mkhris/ / a ru lcags phye g.yag 'brong khrag gis phul/ / dru bu gyen log rtsa sman steng 'bras gsum/ / dur byin dkar po rgya skyegs shu dag dkar/ / gur kum li shi ka ra'i rta byas

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 143 btang / / tsha ba gor ldeb rtsa sman lnga yi steng / / bzang drug chu dug spang rgyan sro lo dkar/ / ru rta tig spang rtsi do bo sbyar/ / tsha shas che na de steng hong len bsnan/ / rtsa brgyud na na gla ba dom mkhris bsnan/ / gre ba'i mdog nag rgya skyegs bsnan la btang / / mchin pa na'am skyug bro khog pa 'khrog / zas sman 'ju ba dka' na bu ram dang / / rgya tshwa byang g.yag mkhris pa dom mkhris bsnan/ / tshabs chen skyugs btang spyang tsher rtsa ba dang / / bra ma'i bar shun bskol ba'i khu ba la/ / 'bri ta po so cha dang ma nu dang / / shu dag sdum stag rnams bcas bskol la btang / / tsha 'gag sel ba'i bsil gsum dpa' bo ni/ / bse ru rgya ru tsan dan dkar po dang / / a ru re ral shing tshwa rgya tshwa gnyis/ / gla rtse ka ra sbyar bas tsha 'gag sel/ / grang 'gag sel ba'i drod gsum dpa' bo ni/ / rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa tshwa sna tshogs tshad dang / / mtshal dkar zi ra dkar nag brag zhun dang / se 'bru pi pi ling ni zhad tsam dang / / rwa sna tshogs chod bsregs thal cong zhi dang / / bu ram sbyar bas grang 'gag ma lus sel/ / de dag bye brag so so'i kha bsgyur la/ / btsod mdud na le sham dang la la phud/ / na ga ge sar puṣ+ṭha ge sar dang / / se 'bru pi ling cong zhi kha ru tsha/ / skar sbyar dang ga mi bde skyug pa sel/ /spang rgyan bong dkar li shi cong zhi dang / / a ru tasnya shing mngar gser me dang / / ru rta rtsa mkhris dang ni spu shel tse/ / skra bzang zil ba kur sbyar chus phul na/ gre ba'i 'brum thom sel bar the tshom med/ / cong zhi se 'bru dang ni pi pi ling / / ma nu gu gul ru rta skyu ru ra/ / ba sha ka sbyar pho ba mchin pa gnyis/ / sbrags shing gzer dang brang tsha chu skyur skyug /

144 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigade 'drar phan pa'i gdams pa khyad 'phags yin/ /bdun pa/ pha dam pa sangasargyasakyi mid 'byar bcosathabs/mid 'byar bcos thabs pha dam pa rin po che'i man ngag mid 'byar dang pho thog bcos pa ni/ thog mar gsung rab klog 'don dang dkyil 'khor zhal bsgyur tsha tsha gtor chu sbyin sogs rim gro zhi chog mang du bya/ de nas sman gyi sbyar thabs la/ dom mkhris gi waṃ gla rtsi rgya tshwa bzang drug dang bcu bo zhib btags nangs snga bar g.yag rog sna ma phug pa 'bras bu ma bcad pa'i khrag dron mo phul gang tsam gyis/ sman thun che 'bring chung gsum bzos la che ba de g.yag khrag gis ded rgyab tu chang rgan nying khu phor gang gis ded/ de bzhin sman thun chung 'bring gnyis kyang nangs ma gnyis la rim bzhin btang / gos dron mo bya/ zas bcud can za/ byis pa lta bu la gtong na sman rta gong gi phyed tsam gtong / / bzang drug 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ / sga skya khyung bzhi tsha (rgya rgyam kha ru) gsum rwa gsum dang / me tog ser gnyis dkar dmar li ga dur/ / dur byin re ral shing tsha cong zhi dang / se 'bru mang sbyor sum cu so lnga ni/ / bad kun mid 'byar dang ni pho thog dang / / 'thab pa pho lhung la sogs kun la phan/ / snyan brgyud zhal gdams tshig brgyud 'di/ / nub tu phangs pas yi ger bkod/ / yang lugs gcig la bzang drug sga skya dmar/ / pi ling pho ris a bar skyur/ / bong nga nag po ru rta chu dag gla rtsi rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa/ / bse

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 145 ru rgya ru ra rgod/ nam mkha' khyung gi me tog dpa' bo ser bo/ yung ba/ tsan dan dkar dmar li ga dur/ re ral dur byid se 'bru shing tsha/cong zhi bcas/ tsha grang lus stobs dang bstun sman thun ran po chu skol gyis phul/ sman zhu rjes su yang chu khol gyis den/ skabs su dar dmar po rtsi can gyi nang du sman phye gri zur gsum tsam btub la dar skud dang nad pa'i srin 'dzub sbrel ba gre bar bzung ngo / / yang na/ shing kun dom mkhris sgog skya bong dkar bzhi zhib btags dar srab tu blugs nas gre bar shong tsam byas la dar skud kyis brtod nas pho bar sleb tsam nas bzung zhing yang yang bskyar pa mchog tu zab bo zhes so/ /mgul 'gag bad kun stod rgyas glo mid par/ / bad rlangs chags te zas skom mid pa dka'/ / brang nyen ske stong na la min pa tsha/ / lud pa ljan ljin mang la nyams stobs 'chor/ / 'di ni gsar du bcos thub rnying zhen nas/ / zas skom mi thar mi pheb brang du sdod/ /skyugs skyig dbugs 'tshub ngar dus mi 'tsho gsungs/ / thog bar gnyis su mkhas bas brtag bcos gzab/ / 'di yi rigs dbye tsha 'gag grang 'gag gnyis/ / ngo bo gyen rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs rkyen las byung / / bcos thabs sman la spang rtsi spang rgyan dkar/ / bzang po drug dang sga skya pi ling dang / / a ru gu gul gla rtsi dri thon tsam/ / da lis khaṇ+ḍas ril bu dril byas nas/ / thog mar zhag 'ga' bsten pa gnyis kur zab/ / de na a ru rgya tshwa dom mkhris dang / spang rgyan li shi gur kum spang rtsi rnams/ / g.yag rgod khrag gam mkha' lding gre khus phul/ /'di la gre nad kun sbyong zhes grags zab/

146 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigade nas mgul 'gag nad grol gsang sman ni/ / sman mchog rgyal bo reg 'bigs bzang bo drug bri ku ra ṇa mkha' lding gre ba rnams/ /cha mnyam rtsa sdom shugs chen cung zad bsre/ gtso bo 'dems kyi ngar rtsi thun bzang sdeb/ / drod ldan lus zungs dmar po'i sho ra dor/ / sman btab 'dres dkrugs drod phab myos byed sbyar/ khams bstun nang zhog gsum la rim gyis phul/ / dus der tshogs bsags sbyin gtong ci nas 'bad/ / 'di ni mid 'chus spyi sman man ngag lugs/ / bden rdzun lag tu longs dang yid ches 'gyur/ / man ngag 'di 'dra dkon phyir gsang rgyas btab/ / dkon mod rgyal khams mir dris gces bar zungs/ / phyi rabs nyam thag 'gro la phan nus shog /so so'i bcos ni tsha 'gag sel ba la/ / cong zhi a ru mkha' lding gre ba dang / / srol gong ma nu shing mngar bzang bo drug / spang rgyan dkar bo ar nag snying zho sha / tsan dan dkar dmar ru rta brag zhun sdeb/ / bad kun gre ba tsha 'gag mid 'chus dang / / glo nad grer 'bab snying nad yid 'chus dang / / de steng 'dre 'jigs tshi ba ma gi ta/ / bi ṣa em tsam bsnan pa man ngag zab/ / mkhris ldan mchin pa gzer zhing ma bde na/ / gi tig gser me ba le ka bsnan zab/ / pho mchin na la 'jib rtsi se 'bru sdeb/ /0pho mtsher sbo zhing rgyu long 'khrog pa la/ / pi ling ko la rgya tshwa dug nyung sdeb/ rdo thal bul tog tsha la bya thal gnyis/ / bsdebs pas bad kun be snabs skyugs pa sel/ de rnams kyis ni tsha 'gag rigs kun 'joms/ / grang sel rdo thal cong zhi rgod btul da nga / / tsha sna gsum dang se 'bru pi pi ling / / brag zhun go gre

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 147 srol gong a ru ra/ / dzā ti cu gang li shi ka ko la/ / gur kum sga dang byi tangag sbyar sman/ / ma nu stab seng ru rta'i thang gis phul/ / spyi sman cong zhi nyer gcig ltag sprod gtong / / bad kun mgul 'gags nad dang pho thog 'joms/ / skabs su ri sho spyang tsher lhum rtsa dang / / rgyam tshwa pi ling dur byid sbyar pa'i skyugs/ / khong du gtong zhing lag len zhib par bya/ / zas ni ma smin rjen zas rul sungs dang / / khyad par lug sha rnying dang kheng tshig spangs/ / 'ju sla yang dro'i zas nyid cung zad bsten/ / spyod lam gnas dang gos dron rtsol bcag bya/ / nyen dang bad kun gsang rnams me yis bsreg / des ni mid 'chus mgul 'gag nad las grol/ / gzhan yang bar sprad de yun ring 'thung dgos tshul ni/ / rgyud las/ bad kun sa chu'i rang bzhin shin tu lci/ / lan res mi sel yun du bsten par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyin rer thengs drug nas bcu bar btung ba dang gnyen po gang 'phrod blta zhing yun bsrings nas 'thung dgos so/ /bad kun sman mchog cong zhi nyer gsum ni/ / cong zhi rgod btul chang gis ngar btab bsubs/ / se 'bru ma nu da lis tsha ba gsum/ /ru rta bse yab 'u su skyu ru ra/ / star bu shing tsha sga skya bzang bo drug /gangs thig brag zhun gi waṃ bcas sbyar ba/ / chang ngam chu bskol drod ldan gyis phul bas/ / bad gan skya smug bad mkhris rlung ldan dang / /lhen dang lcags dreg ma zhu zas skran sogs/ / ma lus gcong nad pho ba mchin pa'i nad/ / med 'chus pho thog dang ga 'gag pa dang / /chibad rlung mgo 'khor sogs la sman 'di zab/ / nad bstun sbyar tshul cung

148 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigazad ngag las nyan/ / brgyud pa zab cing phan chos myong bas grub/ /ces pa dang / gzhan yongs grags kyi sman bde byed snyom ldan dang phag grub sogs kyang bad kun skya bo'i nad rigs phal cher la shin tu phan pa myong bas grub bo/ / bad kun nad la rtsol bcag mchog yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyad par gre thogs nad rigs dgu bo gang yin yang /gzhan dbang sngon las kyi nad yin phyir phyag skor sgrib sbyangs dang tshogs gsog la 'bad pa gtso bor bya zhing / sman gyi bcos tshul rgya zhing khrom gyi gter byon gre thogs bcos skor las zab pa'i man ngag gzhan rang gis mthong ma myong bas der ltos/'dir rang gi nyams myong las thon pa'i bcos tshul mdor bsdus ni thog mar/ rgyud las/ li shi cu gang shing mngar spang rgyan dkar/ ru rta a ru ra dang ka ra sbyar/ / glo nad gre ba tsha skam skad 'gags sel/zhes pa 'di dang ma nu bzhi thang sbrags te 'thung nas gre sbyong bya/ de nas gre thogs spyi sman bdud rtsi'i zegs ma ni/ / spang rgyan star bu ru rta shing mngar dang / / tshar bong sga skya shing kun srol gong ba/ / 'bri ta sa 'dzin go gre stag sha nag / a ru nag chung rgya tshwa gla rtsi bcas/ / cha mnyam kun dang bong mnyam rdo thal bsres/ / ma nu 'u su se 'bru gsum gdus thang / / drod ldan dus phul gre thogs rigs kun sel/ khyad par tsha thogs nad kun 'di yis sel/ / zhes pa 'di dang / / gre thogs spyi sman dpa' bo nyer gcig ni/ / sman mchog rgyal bo rus dor cha drug la/ / mon sman dpa' bo cha gsum ma gi ta/ / cha gnyis rgya yi ral gri de dang mnyam/ / khrag rlung gnyen dang khrag bshigs cha gnyis

bod lu gas 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 149 te/ / dmar po gsum (btsod chos 'bri mog) dang bzang drug cha re re/ / nag po tsarnye cha gcig tsha ba gsum/ / nus bsregs thal ba cha lnga rgod btul phye/ / cha lnga rdo thal cha brgyad dang bcas sbyar/ / gar chang bzang bos 'dam btags yun ring bya/ / g.yag rgod zungs khrag bsres la ril bu dril/ / rim bzhin mur la khu ba khong du gtong / / gre thogs rkyen rigs dgu yi gsang sman mchog / khyad par gre 'dzer 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi yin/ / grang thog sel ba'i tres sam sbyor ba ni/ / tsha ba gsum dang sngo tsha gsum bsregs thal/ / dzā ti li shi sug smel ka ko la/ / star bu ru rta rgya tshwa kha ru tsha/ / se 'bru sga skya da lis pri yang ku/ shing mngar shing kun tshar bong spang rgyan dkar/ / 'bri mog gla rtsi stag sha byi tang ga / go gre nya sha rgol btul rdo thal bcas/ / tshad ldan sbyar te ol gong gdus khus dbul/ / gre thogs pho thogs grang rkyen ma zhu sel/ / nad rjes bshal skyugs sbrags mas sbyang bar bya/ / zhes dang / rgyud las/ bad kun nad la skyugs dang me btsa' mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bad kun skyugs kyis drangs ba ni/ / ri sho spyang tsher tsha la lcum rtsa dang / / dur byin rgyam tshwa pi ling sbyar ba yi/ / skyugs sman zos nas nad pa gan rkyal nyal/ / skyugs nyams byung dus mdun du sgur nas skyugs/ / chu bskol ngad yal lcag gis yang yang bskul/ /rlung sna mnan 'ing rjes gcod gzhan ltar 'phrul/ / zhes dang / dur byid star bu dung thal sbrul gyi sha rgya tshwa bu ram sbyar ba'i bshal gyis sbyang /lan grangs bdun nam dgu btang dag par byed/ rlung lam gzhug cing rjes spyod spyi ltar bya/ zhes so/ / gre thogs nad me btsas bcos tshul

150 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigashin tu zab pa'i man ngag dam rgya zhing khrom gyi gter byon ltar kong sprul gyis bkral nas zin tig nang bkod pa ltar lag len byas na shin tu zab pas der ltos dang gsal lo/ /le'u bcu bzhi ba/ bon gyi gsorig rgyud 'bum bye ba'i yang snying zhesapa lasa'abrasand kyi skor gleng tshul/dang po/ 'brasand kyi rgyu rkyen dbye ba/ nad rtagasadang gnyen po'i sman sbyor/lhan skyes rma nang 'bras ces bya ba/ rgyu rkyen brtag bcos bzhi las rgyu rkyen ni/ ngan khrag rgyas pa rlung gis bsgril ba ste/ dbye ba phyi 'bras gsum dang nang 'bras dgu/ nyes pa'i nad rigs drug dang bco brgyad gsungs/ 'di ru phyi 'bras nang 'bras gnyis su bstan/ phyi 'bras skrangs po yod dang rma can dang / rus pa'i 'bras dang nang 'bras gcig ste bzhi/ skrangs pa sra brtan nyung gsher 'khyags pa 'dra/byug lums zhi dka' zug chung yun ring zhen/ rma 'bras gting mkhregs sha'u gsos pa dka'/ rus 'bras sha'u mi chags rus mdog nyams/gang yang gnad steng byung na gso dka' gsungs/ nang 'bras mi mngon gting nub zas la 'khren/ smin nas gyen thur gnyis kur rnag rdol

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 151 'gyur/ bcos thabs sha 'bras mi rus nya yi sha spru rtsa re lcag cong zhi dri chu'i lums/ yun ring bsten na de yis zhi bar 'gyur/ ma zhi rnag tu 'gugs na byi brun dang / phug ron byi brun chang btsos lums bston pas/ rnag tu 'gugs sam gu gul mi zi dang / a ru sha chen nas zan mchil ba'i brun/ zhib btags sbrang smyon byis pa'i chur sbyar byug bal 'dab stong bsku shog bu'am dar gyis bcings/ skyon med zug 'khyil spangs pa rang zhir 'gro/ skyon can mdog 'gyur skrangs thog rnag mgo yong / de dag khug na rang brdol 'byung ba'am/ min na brdol ba'i rma de a sas bdug rjes la gtso bo cha gcig (dug tsher bar shun zhes kyang 'byung ba de nyid cha gnyis kha tshar kun stos sa cha gcig) gur kum mtshal/shing mngar yung ba chu rtsa stag dom spos/ phye ma rma chas dbyar dgun dus dang sbyar/ rus sman sde bzhi bzang drug gsang sman gnyis/ gla dom dar tshur sha skyi rtsa gsum la/ ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma rma dar bkab/ nad rgyu khrag yin gang nyes yang yang gtar/ spangs so rngabs rwas 'jib la gtar khrag dbyung / dwa tsha sug smel char nu rgya tshwa dang / sbrang smyon sbyar byug hol ge la sogs bkab/ chu bur byung na 'bras nad gting 'don byed/ nad rkyen gnyan yin khong sman rtsa lto sbyang / nad dngos 'bras yin lums 'dul chu tshan gzhug dur rus rnying pa tshi zad nas tsam brdungs/ sla ngar rdza spubs du ba mi 'chor bsreg phye ma zhib btags mar nag spos dkar sbyar/ me chu yun bsdu du chad rnag tsha 'dra/ ngad yal tshe na sbal mdung cog la ma/ gtso bo tshwa la cong zhi'i phye ma btab/'dres dkrugs nad dmigs khyab byug tel ge bkab/ zhag gsum song

152 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaspo rus 'dul che 'bring chung / la sogs bsten la khong sman dngul sbyor bsten/ cong zhi bre gang 'o ma bre dor bsrus/ sbrang rtsi bre gang blugs la btsos dkrugs pa'i/ zho tsam song dang pi ling khyor ba gang / gur kum brag zhun tsha la dom mkhris dang / zags thal brag spos btab la legs dkrugs pa'i/ lde gu lto stong bsten na bdud rtsi 'dra/ skabs su khrag dang chu ser gnyen po shis/gnyisapa/ 'brasand gshagasabacosabyed tshul/kun gyis phan dka' rus 'bras 'dra bcos bya/ de yang gnyan pa'i gnad la 'bras zhugs kyang / 'dzem cha mi dgus rus sbos de steng du/ khab btsugs tshor ba med par 'dra ba de/ khong bsrung khyung lnga gnyan 'bras dus bzhin bsten/ bla gnyan sar 'dzem gri rno sol mer bsregs/ tsha dras sha rus 'bras phyed phye ba yi/ chu grang rtun bran sen mo sogs btab kyang / reg bya nyams par bran la spra snam btsos/ brdzang zhing steng du sha gsar dmar po ni/ gri thag byas pa'i 'byar sdoms khrag bcad la/ zhag song kha phye gyur rgas rus skyon rnams/ ma lus snying stobs bskyed la 'drud cing brdar/ rjes la gong bshad gso ba'i sman rnams gdab/ kha zas skyur dang lan tshwa dug yin spang / gzhan la phyogs med 'jig zas btang la bshig khong 'bras sman gyis bshig la bshal gyis sbyang / zhes bon zhang zhung gso rig rgyud 'bum bye ba'i yang snying 'gro kun 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi zug rngu'i gdung ba kun sel sman sbyor stong rtsa las 'bras nad bcos pa'i le'u ste don gcig pa'o/ /

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 153 le'u bco lnga ba/ 'brong rtse be bum lasaphyi 'brasakyi bcos thabasazab mo/dang po/ 'brasand kyi dbye ba/'bras bcos skor yod/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi 'bras kyi 'dul bcos la/ 'bras kyi dbye ba/ rgyu rkyen/ skyon 'tshol/ bcos thabs/ log gnon lnga yis bstan/ 'bras rigs dbye ba 'di ltar ste/ rlung 'bras/ srin 'bras/gnyan 'bras/ shu 'bras/ mdze 'bras/ phol 'bras/ g.ya' 'bras/sha 'bras/ rtsa 'bras/ rus 'bras/ snga mo mgrin thung dung ltar 'khyil ba ste/ gnyan 'bras rigs gsum du 'dus/ sha 'bras rtsa 'bras rus 'bras gsum/ sha 'bras sha bem mdog sngo zug gzer chung / gson gshin ma phyed sha ro sbangs zan 'dra/ rtsa 'bras skrangs 'thor rtsa 'khrid rnag chu mang / yar mar 'pho skyen rma kha byi khung chu shor 'dra/ rus zlozlos skrangs pa sra la mkhregs/ 'gyur med spang la phur bu btab pa gnyisapa/ bcosathabasarnamapa drugaskyon 'tshol sbrang ma mchu snyung dang gcig skrangs pa rdo rje brag

154 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'ajoms dang gnyis/ sha la rko ba'i tog rtse dang gsum/ rus la brko ba'i gzong dang bzhi/ 'tsho sman tsha la gar sprin dang lnga/ 'bras kyi sbyin bsreg dpe chung yan dang drug go/ skyon 'tshol sbrang ma mchu snyung la/ mu zi nag po gu gul nag mi rus rtsa yags a ru rtse snyung / byi'u nas zan brun/ sbrang smyon dang sbyar la 'byar bya/ de steng bal 'dabs shog gu dar gyis bcings/ 'ag gsum bzhag skyon med na zug 'chagaskrangs pa zhi bar 'gyur/ skyon yod na skrang mtho/ rnag mgo yod/skrangs pa rdo rje brag 'joms la/ spru rtsa/ nya skam/ cong zhi mi rkang bzhi'i lums/ 'khyugs pa sa btab bzhin du skrangs pa 'joms tsha nagatar la kyi lce hong len bsnan/ grang na bsreg cing klad pa rul po bsnan/ 'dul gyi man ngag rdo rje brag 'joms la/ ha la nag po btsan dug yin/ reg pa lce gcod rgya tshwa yin/ bya nag ral gri dngul chu yin/rin chen brag 'brum smug po sbal rgyab yin/ stag chung ser khrab can ni byang ba yin/ mgron bu do bo dan rog la zer/ bdud rtsi chu bcos sa yi rta la skyon/ shugs pas sha la brko ba'i tog rtse lags/ shog shing re cag do rgod/ rtsa ba dug shing bcas bsnan/ rus la brko ba'i zongs lags/ dgu grus stag sha brag spos tha ram bzhi/ chu rtsa dom mkhris dag dang sbyar la btab/ 'tsho sman tsha la gar sprin bya ba lags/ 'bras kyi sbyin bsreg bla ma'i zhal las shes/ skyur dang tsha gnyis 'bras kyi dug yin spang / 'di 'dra sa bdag klu'i dug yin pas/ sngan pa byin la sngags kyi char ba phab/ slad kyis byugs la 'dzin pa me yis bsregasbyin bsreg zur tsam lags/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 155 gsumapa/ khyad par phyi 'brasakyi ldumabacos/'bras kyi ldum bcos/ ngang pa chu la 'o ma bzhin/ rab ces phal cher man ngag bsdus pa i thi/ yang 'bras kyi bcos thabs thun mong ma yin pa ni/ lung pa kha byang bstan nas g.yam pa nag po/ sa ma reg pa nyi ma ma 'phog pa btsal la/ zhib par brdungs pa'i bye ma bre phyed tsam sla nga'i nang du blug ste 'og nas me zan gcig za yun bar du legs par btang / de dang dus mnyam du mar rnying pa snod zur ba gcig gi nang du gzhu ste/ cod chod pa'i tshad nas/ jog skyur nas yas su 'gro/ de so ba dang gong gi sla nga'i nang gi g.yam pa brngos pa de ma grang tsam gyis mgo la byug ste/ gar sla lug zho tsam bya/ de la mdung rtse zho gang / mtshal dkar zho phyed/ sbal rgyab/ gangs thig cho long rnams gsum rnam re/gla rtsi bzhi rnams/ stag sha nag po mthur mgo gang / de rnams zhib par byas la btab pa'i g.yam pa mar sbyar de bsreg la skyi dkar la sogs pa'ikhud du rma dkris ltar byas la yang yang glan/ sman dron mo zla phyed tsam gyi bar du yang yang rgyun sring dgos/ 'dis ni 'bras kyi rigs rnams thams cad dang / rma rgan sogs kyi nad sel ba la the tshom med do/ / gong gi sman rnams thams cad 'dzoms na shin tu bzang ngo / /sman gzhan rnams ma 'dzoms kyang g.yam pa mar sbyar kho na sngar ltar byas pas shin tu phan thog che bar yong gi gda' 'o/ / 'di bdag po rnam rgyal grags pa'i man ngag shin tu zab pa gcig yin no i thi/ yang dur rus bzhi ba zhes bya ba/ 'brug rus/ rta bong mi la sogs dur khrod rus

156 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapa char char yags ma zhib par btags la phye spos dkar sprug po zhib btags/ gsum cha 'bri mar bskol ba'i nang btab skol/ mthas par gyur tsam na rus phye btab cing dkrugs gyur na/ mthas par gyur pa'i lde gu de 'bras gsar pa/ dreg grum/ rma rgan/ chu ser nad/ tsha shas che ba sel bar byed/ 'di steng rdo gnyis dang / thal ka rdo rje/ so ma ra dzā/ gu gul nag po bsnan pa gnas skabs bstun de bya/ 'di brang ti'i khyad chos yin/sbal rgyab mdung rtse gangs thigs mtshal dkar dang / / rdo rgyus khab len bye mgo ka rar sbyar/ / zhib btags mar khu lo lon mar bskol byugs/ / gnyan 'grams gtar nye tsha ro dang / / bkyigs sogs chu rgyus zha reng 'khums/ / spangs ro gang gi ma phan sel/ /skrangs pa sra zhing bying che na/ / mi klad sbyar ba byugs pas 'joms/ /brang ti mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/ / gzhan yang mi'i rus pa tshigs mgo char yags ma/ / stag sha nag po/ spos dkar rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i phye ma mar nag gi khu ba byas te rma dkris ltar byas pas 'bras gsar pa skrangs te rnying ba/ rma'i sha ro rnying pa rnams gcod cing gso ba la 'di las lhag pa med do/ / i thi/ yang spos dkar phul phyed/chu rtsa phul phyed/ so ma ra dzā thal ka rdo rje/ g.yer ma rnams pho tshom re re rnams phyed mar btags pa mar dkar la sbyar te gar sla skyo ma tsam byas la/ chu ser gyi spangs mdog sngon por yod pa dang / gzhan yang chu ser gyi skrangs kyi rigs thams cad dang / shu ba dang / rma'i 'bras rnying pa dang / rnag dang / chu ser 'dzag pa la sogs la shin tu phan no/ /

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 157 sman sbyor 'di'i ming la tsin ta zhes bya'o/ / yang rgya yung shing chu g.yer ma rnams/ mar dkar sbyar byug nyi mas sreg chu ser gyi spangs ma lus sel/ chu ser rtsa 'khyug zug rnams sel/ shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa'o/ / yang khro nyi ma 'dzar brdal sha zhes pa mang du bgrangs la 'bras kyi steng du gdab/ 'bras sngags shin tu zab i thi/sman gyi bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpyad la rnam pa lnga yin te/ /gtarasreg 'bred 'bug drud pa bcad/ / gzhan du tsam bya 'og kyang na/ / khrag ngan phyi nas skem pa la/ / de la gtar kha byed na 'khrul/ /rlung nad bcud kyis 'joms pa la/ / de la me btsa' byed na 'khrul/ /chu ser phye mas skem pa la/ / de la brad 'bru byed na 'khrul/ / rnag 'bras sha ro phye mas gcod/ / de la brad 'bug shin tu blun/ / de yi phye ma sbyar thabs ni/ / ston dus do ba'i 'bras bu dang / / sos dus thar nu kha 'bus dang / / reg pa lce 'big rdo sman dang / / 'od dpag med pa khra bo dang / / rigs lngas 'bras skrangs sha ro gcod/ / tsha tshar brnon po zho can gnyis/ / zho drug zho drug bcu gnyis la/ / byang pa khra mo zho bzhi btang / / rgya tshwa zho gang mtshal zho gsum/ / sha 'bras gcod na thar nu bskyed/ / rus 'bras gcod na rgya tshwa bskyed/ / rtsa 'bras gcod na byang pa bskyed/ / de rnams gong bzhin zhib par btags/ /skrangs la byug pas rdol nas 'byung / / rdol nas tsha la phye ma btab/ /sha ro gcod cing sha'u skye/ / sha 'bras byung na sha la btab/ / rus 'bras byung na rus la btab/ / mdor na gang byung kun la btab/ /ras sman rma dkris gzhan dang 'dra/ sha ro ma chod bar la rma cher

158 bod lugs 'bras nad gso riga'agro/ / chod nas rma kha 'ub kyis 'byung / / byung nas lo gsum song ba ni/ / zla ba gsum la nges par phan/ / lo gnyis zla gnyis lo gcig zla gcig nas 'tsho'o/ / de nas rim gyis phan par 'gyur/ skrangs pa rnams rang zhib 'ong ba'ang yod/ 'bras spangs 'dul byed 'di 'dra ba/ / gzhan la e yod dris la song / / bden rdzun lag tu blangs pas shes/ gasnyi ra/ i thi/bla ma sman bla drang srong rig 'dzin sogs/ / man ngag ston mdzad thugs rje can la 'dud/ 'bras kyi sdum bcos man ngag lag len gnad/ / sman pa byang sems ldan dang nad pa la/ / phan gdags bya phyir 'tsho byed bdag 'dra bas/ / ser sna spangs te man ngag 'di bkod bya/ / de la phyi nang 'bras rigs du ma yang / / dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs rjes gcod dang / / spyi don bzhi yi man ngag gtan la 'bab/ / dbye ba sha 'bras rus 'bras rtsa 'bras dang / / khong 'bras nad dang rnam pa bzhi ru 'dus/ / sha 'bras skrangs pa che la cung zad sra/ / rus 'bras rus la 'khol zhing gting nas na/ / rtsa 'bras rtsa 'khyug 'bus nas na/ / khong 'bras nang gi don babs na zhing za/ /phal cher mkhal mar babs pa mang ba yin/ / nad de za khu'i sur ya nag por 'gyur/ / mkhal steng skrangs shing rtsa rgyud khrid nas na/ / kun kyang skrangs sra rma dang chu ser 'byung / / don med na zhing byas med dar re drag / rtags tshang zla gsum gong du ma grags na/ / 'bras kyi nad yin brtse bas myur du bcos/ / bcos thabs spyi dang bye brag so sor bcos/ / spyi bcos sman ni cong zhi bre gang dang / / dmar zil ba yi 'o

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 159 ma bre tshad gsum/ / sbrang rtsi bre gang 'bri 'am ba yi mar/ / bzang ba srang gsum kun gyi gzhi ma yin/ / cong zhi 'o mar btso zhing dwangs ma bzhur/ / de bsdus spris ma chags pa bre gang la/ / lcags kyi snod du sbrang dang mar btab btso/ / chu chod skabs su zan tsam song ba la /drod sman spar gang mkhris sna rnyed tshad dang / / rwa co char yags a ba da byid sha / phug ron gtsang nya gtsang pa mchil ba'i sha / thong tsher lug gi dal mo sha rus bcas/ / bsdus pa zhib btags 'bras rigs spyi yi sman/ / bre gang so sor lde kha bsgyur ba ni/ / 'gram pa ma gal mjing pa gar babs kyang / / cu gang gur kum li shi a ru ra/ / snying ru rta brag zhun ba sha ka / zhib btags spyi sman steng du kha tshar btab/ / brang dang mchan 'og nu ma ro stod yul/ / (sha 'bras nyung ma 'khyags pa 'dra )skrangs shing rnag khrag 'dzag la rtse 'dar khyer/ / ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga'i phye ma bsnan/ / rlung shas che na (rlung shas che ba dang grang ba shas che na sbrang dkar la bya'o/)dzā ti a ru ra/ / li shi gur kum snying po zho sha dang / / gu gul dkar nag tsan dan kha ru tshwa/ / sle tres thal ka rdo rje so ma ra/ /seng ldeng a bar skyur gsum lde kha bsgyur/ / mkhal skyed grang zhing rtsa 'khyug rnag khrag 'dzag / gangs sbal sbrul sha a ru gser mu zi/ / sug smel a 'bras sra 'bras 'jam 'bras dang / / bre ga rgya tshwa zhib btags lde kha sgyur/ / de nyid gzhang babs gzhang nang 'brum pa 'byung / / ka sho kun rda phur mong lo ma dang / / shing kun byi tang ka dang ma ru rtse/ /gla rtsi g.yer ma sgog skya rnams/ / 'jam rtsi btang zhing dugs kyis bdug par bya/ / yang na ril ma mar btsos lnga bdun la/ / sngags 'di khri

160 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaphrag gcig btab nges par 'tsho/ oṃ bha ti ka kru tha na swā hā/ yang na spyi sman steng du ru rta dang / / mdze tshwa 'brug rus ldong rus bab pa dang / /nag tshur ser tshur zhib btags phye ma bsnan/ / mig dang mkhur tshos dreg dang rlig pa spangs/ / rnag khrag 'dzag la brag zhun ba sha ka / gur kum mtshal dkar gla rtsi zhib btags bsnan/ / nu ma spangs shing rnag khrag chu ser 'dzag / shin tu gnyan zhing rtsa mdud mang bos na/ / mu zi dul ma dngul chu brag gi zhun/ / gur kum dom mkhris a ba shing mngar dang / / sprul sha ba ru ra dang ra mo sha / zhib btags spyi steng bsnan te brtson pas bcos/ / rus steng bab na chab seng gangs thigs mtshal/ / smug po sbal rgyab mdung rtse man dzi ra/ / bye mgo dung dang mdze tshwa zhib btags bsnan/ / rus 'dzer yod bton steng dngul chu mtshal/ / mkhris sna rnyed tshad ze tsha a bhi sha / gur kum khur mong me tog ser chen dang / / brag gi ser thig rgya tshwa 'brug gi rus/ / ru rta nag tshur mdze tshwa gang rnyed rnams/ / bu ram ril bu rma dang 'tshams par dril/ / rma mang bzhag la dar bkab sbang 'jib bya/ / de yis 'dul gcod rnag khrag chu ser 'dren/ / de rjes rma gso'i sbyor ba bstan pa ni/ / ri dang klung gi rta lpags dar ya kun/ / dom mkhris chu rtsa brag spos a bhi sha / de rnams khan ṭa rmar bcug (ril bu byas pa dang phye ma )'tsho sman mchog / rtsa 'bras 'bal 'bus mang zhing (byi khung chu shor 'dra)rtsa rnams 'khrig / g.yas g.yon steng 'og nges med gar yang 'pho/ / rtsa rgyud khrid nas rnag khrag chu ser 'dzag / rgya tshwa gur kum shing mngar mkhris sna tshogs/ / zhib btags spyi sman gong la lde kha

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 161 gdags/ / khong 'bras mkhal babs sur ya za khu 'bras/ / don lnga la sogs gang la babs gyur kyang / / 'bam po'i rtsa lo khan ṭa byas pa la/ / don lnga'i kha 'dzin bzang drug 'bras bu gsum/ / zhib btags spyi sman steng du lde kha bsgyur/ / sha dus rtsa sogs gang la babs gyur kyang / / spyi sman stong du gang babs kha tshar btab/ / chu tshod sne ma tshig par sman mar sbyar/ / lto stong khyim pas bya sgong re tsam mam/ / 'ju tshod sbyar te rim pas bsten par bya/ / rjes gcod ma drag bar du sman mar gtong / / gang nye'i gang rgyas rtsa la gtar bya zhing / / gang 'khyug (mi'i rkang mgo) 'phar rtse bsreg (nya sha re cag) cing me yis (hor gyi)bsnan/ / (dri chur btsos pa'i lums kyis ) rgyab bcos 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan bcos/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ma tshig sdom pa bsrung / / rta mgrin phyag rdor (phyag rdo khyung la sogs pa gang rung gi rnam par mi rdog pa'i )bsgom bzlas ngang la bzhag / rgyud lung (bdud rtsi snying po ba char ba lce sman sa dra rol la ba)man ngag rgya mtsho'i bcud bsdus pa/ /gcig tu dril nas bu dang slob ma yi/ / don du 'tsho byed shākya nā tha yis/ / sngags 'chang prasnyo pa sun gyis/ / bskul ngor lcags pho byi lor klu lung dgon par sbyar/ / dge bas rkang gnyis nad kyi sdug bsngal las/ / grol bas thar lam bde ba thob par shog / 'bras sdum bcos lji sna/ zlog rtsa chen thogs med kun btus reg pa bde byed ces bya ba

162 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigale'u bcu drug pa/ bod yul dmangasakhrod kyi 'bras nad bcosathabs/gzhan yang gshin rje'i be+e bum dmar po las bcos thabs re gnyis lung drangs nas/1 'bras nad tsha ba rgyas pa la/ zi ra ser po zho gsum la/ shing mngar zho gang sge gsher dang / chi phi kha ni ran tsam btang / thang la glo 'bras mchin 'bras gnyis/ rang rang kha 'dzin ma nor sbyar/ ('bras tshad la spyi btang gi tsha sman gyis phan thog med)2 sdong ras tshur dkar rams mdze tshwa/ gu gul dkar nag zho bcu gnyis (gong sman rnams re re bzhin)/ sdig pa nag po zho drug dang /mang ga bur ni zho gnyis rnams/ zhib btags phye ma phag tshil sbyar/nyin bzhin gsher ba'i dmigs su byugs/ 'bras kyi glang thabs kun la phan/ (mchin 'bras dang mkhris 'bras/ mchin dri dkar nag gi 'bras nad sdi / /spri sprangs dug sman nyal tha ma gtogs mi phan phyir sdeb sbyor 'di rnams 〈 pur mgo (chu gnas rus sbal)gnyis dang sne'u (srang gnyis)gur kum(sung gnyis)/ 'dam btags legs byas nad dmigs rlan/bcos rdugs mchin 'bras glang thabs sel/

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 163 4 nyin bzhin chu sbur zho bcu gnyis gdus thang thengs bzhi byas /sna ༵༵nga na mchin 'bras kyi gzer gcog skyur dang kha tsha la 'dzem 5 ga bur (mang)zho gsum chang rgod bsnyal/ dgos pa'i dus su nad dmigs gdus thang / nyin bzhin zas rjes thengs gnyis btung /snyigs ro skrangs thog steng la byugs/ byugs pa'i sman nad bzod thub na/ lhang 'bras khrag skran pho 'bras dang / ska phreng zla gsum tsam gyis 'joms/6 rtsangs pa kha ral bdun cu tsam/ dkar po chig thub (go yu)zho lnga dang / sbyar phye zas sngon thengs bzhi btang / mid 'chus pho thog sogs la phan/7 ba bla (srang bzhi)dan rog (nang snying bdun)chi'i kha(bdun)/btsong rnams rlangs btsos 'dam btags byas/ khur pa'i dbyibs bzos dar gyis dril/ lag mthil gnyis su zhag lngar bcings/ de nas zhag lngar ngal gsos rjes/ slar yang lag mthil du rlan na/ glo mchin pho 'bras mgul ba 'gags/ gshin rje zhags las thar ba'ang yod/ de bstun khong sman gtong ba gnad// 'phar 'gro'i pags (rlon gsar) pas nad dmigs rlan/mchin 'bras na zug 'joms pa mthong /9 rtsangs pa (zhobaco brgyad)gtar 'bu (zhogang )rta bla dang (zho bcu)/ star ku'i nang snying (zhedrug)ril bur dril/ nub dang nyin gung khong du gtong / rmen 'bras sko 'phreng rigs rnams sel/ sman rnams

164 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigadug 'don byed pa gnad/10 ngang ba'i sgo nga tshos rjes lkog shun dor nas nang khrol blangs ba'i sbal sha dang mnyam du gdus nas yun lon rjes sgo nga zos na gre thogs rigs dgu sel/ lo phyed tsam la nyin bzhin sgo nga re dang khong sman de bstun/11 bad kun mgul 'gags pho 'bras la/ ngang ba'i gson khrag dron mo de/ bdun phrag re la thengs rer btung (nus tshad tsam)/khong sman mjug sgro (ngang ba'i) bsreg pa'i thal(mun bsreg)/ dgong dang tho rangs thun re btang / sha chang g.yer sgog 'khrig spyod spang /12 grong gi gcan gzan nag po'i mgo pun bsreg phye ma thengs gsum gtong (nyin bzhin)/ re lcag khaṇ+ḍa spangs thog byugs/mngal gyi 'bras la gcig chog yin/ (mun bsreg legs na mdog nagaser na ma tshos ba dang dkar na tshos drags pas sman du mi rung )/12 ba bla (zho bcu )sku dang (zho lnga mun bsreg )sen mo 〈zho lnga hrog bsreg)rnams/ khrom brdungs shing tog (ziling )nang du bcug(nang rus bton pa rdog bcu) de'i phyi gro phyes (zhobadun)g.yog nas sol mer bsreg tsos rjes (du ba dkar po 'byang )bton nas phye ma snum dang sbyar/yang gcig grong gi spre'i mgo gro phye thum bsreg snum dang sbyar/ gong gnyis res mos byugs pas na/ gdug can pags 'bras gnyen po yin/14 go bo'i pho ba'i nang gi rdzas dang zho lhan gcig bsnyal nas btung na skyugs nad sel(mgul 'gags dang pho thog)/15 sdig nag (dug 'don) zhib btags phye ma thun chung re

bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig dngos/ 165 btung na rmen 'bras dang ske 'phreng sogs lhag skyes rma 'joms/16 dan rog (dug 'don)dang byang khra (dug 'don)gi wang phran tsam rnams glo sman dang bsdebs nas btung na glo 'bras la phan/17 'bam po'i khaṇ+ḍa 'brong khrag dang bsres nas btung na khong 'bras sel bar bshad/1rdo rak+ṣa mig med (dug 'don mi dgos) har bsreg zhib btags phye ma 'bam po'i khan ṭas ril bu dril bas 'bras nad kha cig la phan zer/19 phye ma leb ser khra bu ram dang sbyar nas byugs na 'bras nad kyi na zug gcog nus/20 sbal nag mun bsreg zhib btags phye ma nyin rer thengs gsum re btung na pho 'bras nad la phan/21 yang na 'bras nad la cong zhi'i 'phrul thal steng chu srin rus pa mun bsreg bsnan pa btang dgos/ ('di'i man ma rnyed)

sde tshan bzhi ba/ deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/'bras nad ni lus khams kyi skye 'phel byung bzhin pa'am smin tshar ba'i phra phung la rigs mi 'dra ba'i 'brel yod rkyen gyis yun ring shugs rkyen dbang gis tshad brgal gyi 'phel snon rgyun ldan min pa'i dbye 'byed byung ba las grub pa'i skyes dngos gsar pa zhig yin/gzugs khams las skra dang sen mo ma rtogs dbang po dang phung grub yod tshad la 'bras nad byung nus/ 'bras nad kyi nad rgyu dang brtag bcos bya rgyu'i gnad don da dung yongs su thag gcod thub med pas mig sngar 'bras nad kyi 'gog bcos las ka de lha snga ba gsum ’ dam 'dzin legs po byed dgos pa ste/ snga tsam shes rtogs dang snga tsam brtag dpyad/ snga tsam sman bcos byed thub pa byed dgos/ 'o na gang 'dra zhig la 'bras nad zer zhe na/ rgyun ldan gyi gnas tshul 'og mi lus kyi phra phung tshang ma rnam pa nges can dang myur tshad nges can zhig dang bstun nas 'tshar skyes dang rnying tshab gsar byed kyis gzugs po'i rgyun ldan gyi nus pa srung 'dzin byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang 'bras nad ni nad slong ba'i rgyu rkyen kha shas kyi nus pa'i rkyen pas gzugs po'i phra phung khag

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 167 cig rgyun ldan ltar 'tshar skyes yong ba'i nus par 'gog skyon phog pas phra shā/ kha shas rgyun ldan gyi 'tshar skyes las ldog ste 'bras skrangs chags pa spyir 'bras nad phra phung de yang rgyun ldan gyi phra phung las 'gyur ldog byung ba zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang de'i gsar brje dang grub tshul nus pa bcas rgyun ldan gyi phra phung dang ha cang mi 'dra bar skyes 'phel de bas mgyogs par ma zad/ rgyun chad med par skyes 'phel byed kyi yod stabs/ gzugs khams kyi 'tsho bcud 'bor chen zhig zad 'gro ba dang dus mtshungs gnod 'tshe ldan pa'i dngos po 'ga' zhig zags thon byung ste gzugs po la gnod 'tshe gtong gi yod/ da dung tshabs chen zhig ni 'bras skrangs kyis rtag tu rgyun ldan dbang po'i chags tshul la gtor (tā k+ta kā/nga ste dbang po'i nus pa 'chol nas mi'i tshe srog la nyen kha le'u dang po/ bzang 'brasadang ngan 'bras/'bras nad kyi ngo bo dang mi'i gzugs por gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i tshad la gzhigs te bzang 'bras dang ngan 'bras gnyis su dbye choga'abras rigs de dag gi zhib phra'i dbye ba ni 'di lta ste/
sbya sduX/ /two rdo /daska nāX zlo / bye/ k+ṣiṃ dī/ stu/sdig ṭ+wāṃ (po/ tram̐ shī / rjisnru/ tram̐ phyi/shā gyu lbi marnyi gā/gyurngo khro/ hūṃ bye/khro sgre two wa tram̐ ṭ+wāṃ sdu

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 169 thog snang tshul de'i rigs la gnas 'gyur zhes zer/3'bras la bzang 'bras dang ngan 'bras kyi dbye ba yod rung dbye ba de dag ni bltos bcas shig ma yin/ bzang 'bras kha shas ngan 'bras su 'gyur srid pas 'tshar skyed dal ba'i bzang 'bras shig gal te glo bur tu 'tshar skyed byed mgyogs su song na ngan 'bras su 'gyur bar dogs gzhi byed dgos pa yin/le'u gnyis pa/ 'bras nad la ming 'dogs tshul/'bras nad la ming 'dogs pa'i rtsa don ni 'bras nad kyi ngo bo dang / 'byung sa'i phung grub/ yang na gnas sa bcas mtshon thub pa byed dgos/ 'on kyang 'bras nad nyung shas shig la sngon ma'i goms gshis ltar gyi ming btags yod/dang po/ bzang 'brasakyi ming 'dogasatshul/'bras nad 'byung sa'i phung grub kyi ming de'i rjes su 'bras zer ba'i yi ge de bsgon dgos pa ste dper na/ tshi sna'i phung grub la 'bras nad skyes yod na der tshil sna'i 'bras nad zer ba dang / steng g.yogs pags pa (dper na pags pa dang / lhang bu/ mkhal phor 'byar skyi sogs )la bzang 'bras skyes nas phyi ngos su skyes sring byas te nu ma'i dbyibs ltar 'bur na der nu dbyibs kyi 'bras nad zer/

170 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigaganyisapa/ ngan 'brasakyi ming 'dogasatshul/de'i phung grub kyi 'byung sa mi 'dra bar brten nas gsham gsal ltar dbye ba/1 ngan 'bras/ gong pags phung grub la ngan 'bras skyes pa der 66'bras zer ba'i yi ge'i mdun la dbang bo dang yang na phung grub kyi ming de 'bri dgos pa dper na/ mchin pa'i ngan 'bras dang / pho ba'i ngan 'bras/ yang na nya lcibs phra phung ngan 'bras/ gsher rmen ngan 'bras sogs yod pa lta bu'o/ /2 sha 'bras/ tshi sna'i phung grub dang / sha sgril/ rus sgrom/sbyig rtsa/ rmen bu'i phung grub sogs su skyes ba'i ngan 'bras la sha 'bras ra/ de'ang smyo sha 'bras mi zer ba'i yi ge'i mdun du phung grub kyi ming 'bri dgos pa dper na/ tshi sna'i sha 'bras dang / tshi lu'i sha 'bras/phrum rus sha 'bras sogs lta bu'o/ /2 ngan 'bras gzhan dag dbang rtsa'i phung grub kyi 'bras nad kha shas dang yang na sbrum sring phra phung la byung ba'i ngan 'bras der 66sngadze phra phung 'bras zhes bris te mtshon pa byed kyi yod/ dper na dbang rtsa'i phra phung gi 'bras nad yod pa kha shas la 'bras nad zer ba'i yi ge'i mdun du 6 ngan zer ba'i yig 'bru 'bri ba dper na/ sbrum bu 6 ya ma ’gzugs kyi ngan 'bras zhes pa lta bu dang / 'bras nad kha shas la da dung goms gshes ltar ming spyod pa dper na/ khrag 'bras dang / sha rtsi nag
