deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 171 'bras zer ba sogs ming btags yod rung don dngos thog de dag tshang ma ngan 'bras shig red/le'u gsum pa/ 'bras nad snga tsam rtogs thabs/'bras nad kyi nad rkyen da dung gsal bo ma rtogs phyir 'bras nad yod pa snga tsam rtogs pa bya rgyu de ha cang gal 'gangs che ba zhig yin/phyogs gcig nas thabs shes stabs bde zhing khyab spel gtong sla ba dang /bskyar zhib bya rgyur 'tsham pa'i thog ma'i skabs kyi brtag dpyad byed thabs kha shas spel dgos pa dper na/ mo mtshan nas bud pa'i phra phung shel leb la byugs te mngal ske'i sgo'i thog ma'i skabs kyi ngan 'bras rtogs thub pa byed dgos pa lta bu dang / ho nan zhing chen gyi lin rdzong du zas lam du dra ba 'then thabs la brten nas zas lam nang nas zags bud byas pa'i phra phung la brtag zhib kyis thog ma'i skabs kyi zas lam gyi ngan 'bras rtogs pa dang / gzhan yang ngan 'bras 'gog pa'i dril bsgrags las don khyab spel hur thag byas te rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams kyis 'bras nad 'gog bcos shes bya rtogs pa byas yod pa red/nad rtags dang snang tshul gang 'dra zhig ni 'bras nad yin pa'i dogs zon byas nas dus thog tu brtag zhib byed dgos/ rang rgyal du 'bras nad phog pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na gsham gsal gyi nad rtags chen po bcu yod mkhan rnams la do snang byed dgos/

172 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig1 lo na dar yol gyi bud med 'khrig sbyor byas rjes khrag thon pa dang / skye lam nas nges med khrag thon pa/ yang na grang ba mang po 'dzags pa bcas dang /2 lho zos rjes brang rus kyi rgyab ngos su dngos po gzhan zhig yod pa'i tshor snang yod pa dang / 'khar ba'i tshor snang yod pa/ khab btsugs pa ltar zug gzer rgyag pa/ yang na zas mid dka' ba sogs kyi snang tshul yod pa/2 rgyu mtshan gsal po med par sha rid pa dang / zungs khrag nyams pa/ grod stod na ba/ 'on kyang chos nyid nges gtan med pa dang /pho skyur langs pa'i snang tshul yang med pa sogs/ji gzugs po'i gnas gang rung zhig dper na/ nu rmen dang /mjing pa/ yang na grod pa sogs la rim bzhin che ru 'gro ba'i sbos ril yod pa/5 sna 'gags pa dang / sna khrag thon pa/ yang na mgo phyed ka na ba/ lhag par du mjing ba'i steng sbos cher rgyas byas pa'i rmen bu'i rtsa mdud reg thub pa/6 lud pa'i nang khrag yod pa dang / skam glo yun ring brgyab nas sman bcos byas kyang mi drag pa/ lhag par du brang khog na ba sogs/7 bshang ba gtong ba'i goms gshis la 'gyur ldog byung ba dang btsir 'then byed pa'i tshor snang yod pa dang / bshang ba'i nang khrag yod pa/ yang na bshang ba sla ru song ba bcas// mchin pa myur du che ru song ba'i thog mchin pa'i khongs

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 173 mtshams su na zug yod pa/ke sme ba glo bur che ru song ba dang dus mtshungs tsha sub rgyag pa/brdol nas khrag thon pa/ na zug rgyag pa/ yang na sme ba'i thog skyes pa'i spu de dag rang bzhin bud pa bcas/10 rgyu mtshan gsal bo med la na zug kyang med pa'i rang bzhin gyi khrag gcin thon pa sogs kyi mngon tshul yod pa bcas yin/ nad rigs gzhan dag la'ang gong gsal dang 'dra ba'i nad rtags yod pas gong gsal gyi nad rtags yod tshe dus thog tu sman khang du song nas brtag zhib byed pa dang rgyu mtshan 'tshol zhib kyis 'bras nad yin min brtag dpyad zhib tshags byed dgos/le'u bzhi ba/ 'bras nad kyi sngon 'gogadang po/ nad rgyu/'bras nad kha shas ni rdzas 'gyur dngos bo'i rigs 'ga' zhig dang yang na rgyu rkyen gzhan dag dang 'brel ba yod pa dper na/ las rigs rang bzhin gyi 'bras nad lta bu'o/ / gal te rgyu rkyen de dag gis mi'i gzugs por gnod 'tshe gtong ba de sel thub na 'bras nad de'i rigs sngon 'gog byed thub/ der brten zhing las thon skyed thad spyod pa'i rdzas lud dang zhing sman sogs la bdag gnyer yag po byed dgos pa dang / bzo las thog gi rlangs ro dang mkho med chu'i gnod 'tshe med pa

174 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigabazo dgos la rang byung khor yug la btsog skyon mi yong ba'i sngon 'gog gang thub byed dgos/ mi sger gyi 'gog srung la shugs snon brgyab nas 'od 'phro'i rang bzhin dang / rdo snum snyigs ma/ rdo sol sreg ma'i snum/hren rdzas/ ben an sogs kyi las ka byed mkhan mi snas dus bkag tu gzugs por brtag zhib byed dgos/gnyisapa/ 'brasand kyi dusarim thog ma'i nad 'gyur lasman bcosadusathog nyubyed dgos/nad 'gyur kha shas mig sngar gzugs po'i bde thang la shugs rkyen de tsam med la 'bras nad yang ma yin zhing / 'on kyang lo 'ga' zhig song rjes 'bras nad la 'gyur srid pas gso rig thad nad 'gyur de'i rigs la 66'bras nad kyi dus rim thog ma'i nad 'gyur zer/gal te nad 'gyur de 'bras nad du ma 'gyur gong du sman bcos byed thub na nad de sngon 'gog byed thub/1 mchu to dang / lce/ kha sbug 'byar skyi/ mngal ske/ mo mtshan phyi ma sogs la thon pa'i 'byar skyi'i dkar 'bur leb mo dang /2 dus yun ring por sman bcos byas kyang drag skyed mi thub pa'i dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi rma rul dang / rma rjes/ rnag sbubs sogs/2 mngal ske dang / long ga rgyu dkar/ pho ba bcas la skyes pa'i sha 'tsher/4 dal ba'i rang bzhin dang rkyal snod rang bzhin gyi nu rmen skye 'phar byung ba'i nad dang / nu ma'i 'dren sbug nang gi nu rdog dbyibs

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 175 can gyi 'bras sogs/gsumapa/ rgya khyabatubaskyar zhibabya rgyu khyabaspelabyasaste 'brasand yod pa snga tsamartogasathub pa byed dgos/gsal/)('bras yod med snga tsam rtogs pa byed pa'i sa bcad nang du zhib par bzhi ba/ 'phrod bsten ladang dod dang gzugasagazhi yag tu'agro rgyur shugasasnon rgyag dgos/de ni nad rigs thams cad sngon 'gog byed pa'i gal che'i thabs shig yin pas 'bras nad kyang de ltar ro/ / rnam kun gyi 'tsho ba'i nang 'bras nad dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don khag la do snang byed dgos pa dper na/ bza' bca' tsha drags pa mi za ba dang / phog thug yod pa'i za btung nyung tsam bzas na pho ba'i 'bras nad dang zas lam gyi 'bras nad sngon 'gog bya rgyur don snying nges can zhig yod/ tha mag dang a rag 'thung tshod byas na kha sbug 'bras nad dang / ol gong 'bras nad/ pho ba'i 'bras nad/ glo ba'i 'bras nad bcas sngon 'gog bya rgyur don snying nges can zhig yod/ gnyen sgrig byed snga drags pa dang / snga skyes byung ba/ yang na phru gu mang bo skyes pa des mngal sgor ral rma chags pa dang / gtsang sbra med pa'i 'khrig sbyor gyi 'tsho bas mngal skor gnyan kha rgyas pa dang / rma rul chags pa ni mngal sker 'bras nad byung ba'i rgyu rkyen nges can zhig yin/

176 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigale'u lnga ba/ 'bras nad kyi brtag bcos/mig sngar 'bras nad la sman bcos bya rgyu de gtso bo gshags bcos dang / 'od 'phro ba/ rgyun srol gso rig dang sman rdzas (rdzas 'gyur sman bcos)bcas thabs gsum la brten dgos/ de dag gi dmigs yul tshang ma ni 'bras nad kyi phra phung phyir 'bud bya rgyu dang / yang na gsod rgyu'i ched du yin/ nye lam lo shas nang nad 'gogs nus shugs kyi sman bcos kyi nus pa gong mthor gtong ched gong gsal gyi thabs de dag phyogs bsdus byas te bed spyod byas na'ang 'grigadang po/ rgyun mthong gi bzang 'bras/1 pags tshil rmen snod kyi sbos skrangs(phyi'abras)/ pags tshil rmen snod kyi sbos skrangs (ṣ+ṭha/ji //(77)ni pags tshil gsher rmen gyi dor shang bu ga 'gags stabs zags thon dngos po phyir 'thon ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis byung ba zhig red//nad rtags gnad bsdus/3( 1)de rgyun du mgo dang / sgal pa/ 'phongs tshos sogs kyi pags pa'i ngos su 'thon gyi yod pa/( 2) rkyal snod dbyibs kyi sbos ril zhig reg thub/ de'ang pags pa dang 'byar 'brel thebs yod pas 'gul ril byed sla po med pa

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 177 dang phyi dngos 'jam sha dod cing mtshams mtha' gsal bo yod pa/( 2)rkyal sbos kyi nang du go thal mdog ltar gyi phyur pa zhib zhib dang 'aḍisma pa'ib kārdodi po yod pa/rgyal sbos cha tshang bkog bregs byas te bskyar du mi skye ba'i sngon 'gog byed dgos/ gal te gnyan kha rgyas yod tshe cha shas la tsha dugs dang 'bu phra 'gog pa'i sman bcos byas te gnyan kha 'jags rjes rkyal sbos bkod bregs byed dgos/2 na rdog dbyibs kyi 'bras nad/ nu dog dbyibs kyi 'bras nad (sna'ilkoṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)ni pags par dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi phog thug byung ba dang / yang na gnyan kha rgyas rjes skyes pa'i bzang 'bras kyi rigs shig yin/ de yang rna lam phyi dang / pho mtshan/ gzhang kha'i mtha' 'khor/ lag pa sogs kyi pags pa'i steng thon pa mang la kher rkyang du thon pa dang / yang na mang po 'phel ba bcas byed kyi yod//nad rtags gnad bsdus/)phyi ngos rtsub shas che zhing mi snyoms pa dang / khab rtse'i dbyibs ldan zhing ja shing me tog dang 'dra ba de dag spyir btang du tshangs thig li smi gcig yin zhing / dbyibs gzugs nges gtan med pa de pags mdog dang 'dra ba'am yang na lcags mdog yin/(sman bcos/3105yin pa'i sha'o son ying sman chus rul slad gtong ba'am yang na gshags bcos byas te bkog dgos/

178 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig2 tshi sna'i 'bras nad/ tshi sna'i 'bras nad (21tsho47)ni tshi sna'i phung grub las grub pa'i sbos 'bras shig yin/ mang che ba pags 'og phuḥ gru( ༵nga skyes kyi yod la kher rkyang du thon pa dang yang na mang po 'a la spyon dad rta/gas gnad bsdus/ka(1)rgyun du grod pa'i ldebs la thon pa mang ba ma zad/ gzhan yang brla sha dang / 'phongs tshos/ brang khong sogs la'ang thon gyi yod/(2)'bras nad de 'tshar skyed dal la sgor dbyibs dang yang na sgong dbyibs ltar yin pa ngo bo mkhregs shing 'gul ril byed pa dang /'thum skyi yod pa/ phyi ngos kyi pags pa rgyun ldan ltar yin pa/ gal te sbos 'bras te gting ngos kyi sha gnad dang yang na rus sgrom dang phan tshun 'byar tshe 'gul ril la 'gog rkyen yong gi yod/(sman bcos/kagashags bcos byas te bkog dgos pa/4 tshil 'bras(1677)/ de ni tshil gyi phung grub tshad las brgal te 'phar skyes byung nas chags pa zhig red/ de dpung pa dang /sgal pa/ 'phongs tshos bcas kyi pags 'og gi tshil gyi phung grub nang skyes mang shos yin pa dang / rtag tu kher rkyang du thon pa dang / skabs re mang po 'phel gyi yod/(nad rtags gnad bsdus/3'tshar skyes byed dal zhing cung zad snyi ba'i sbos ril zhig yin/phyi dbyibs de rtag tu 'dab lo gyes ba dang 'dra/ 'bras nad de'i

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 179 rigs lus po'i phyir 'bur ba dang / phyi ngos 'jam sha dod la mtshams mtha' gsal zhing 'gul ril byed kyi yod/(sman bcos/3gshags bcos byas te bkog dgos/5 khams dmar 'byung gnas kyi 'bras nad (stob tshelkosgro)/khams dmar 'byung gnas kyi 'bras nad de la bzang 'bras dang ngan 'bras rigs gnyis yod/ khams dmar 'byung gnas kyi bzang 'bras mang che ba rkyal sbos rang bzhin dang / ngo bo snyi ba/ phyi ngos 'jam sha dod pa/ 'bras gzugs kyi che chung mi 'dra ba/ che ba rnams zla ba song ba'i mngal 'khor pa'i bu snod kyi che chung tsam yod pa dang / khams dmar 'byung gnas kyi ngan 'bras ni ngo bo mkhregs shing phyi ngos rtsub pa/de dang mnyam du grod chu bsags pa bcas kyi gnas tshul thon gyi yod/(nad rtags gnad bsdus/3(1)'bras skrangs chung dus nad rtags med pa dang / rim bzhin chen po chags skabs grod gsham la sbos ril yod pa reg thub/(2)'bras skrangs cung che ba rnams grod ldebs nas reg thub/des drangs chags long mo dang lhang bur gnon btsir byas stabs gcin kha snyi ba dang yang na gcin pa gtong dka' ba'i gnas tshul thon pa/ (2)gal te gnyan kha rgyas pa dang / 'bras yu bsgrims te rang brdol byung na dos drag che ba'i grod pa na ba'i nad rtags thon pa/(4)gal te ngan 'bras yin na 'tshar skyed byed myur zhing / nad

180 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapa'i nad kyi ngo bo ngan gyur byed pa dang / sha rid cing skam pa/ grod chu bsags pa sogs kyi nad rtags ston/(sman bcos/3(1)'bras skrangs kyi tshangs thig de li smi lnga man yin pa dang nad rtags med pa/ mngon gsal dod po'i rkyal sbos bcas yin na gnas skachos ring sman bcos ma byas par dus bkag tu brtag zhib byas na 'a ga(2)'bras skrangs tshangs thig de li smi lnga las che ba yod pa dang /'bras yu bsgrims pa/ yang na 'bras skrangs chung rung ngo bo dngos kyi rang bzhin ldan pa ma zad/ 'tshar skyed myur ba/ ngan 'bras yin min cod zhib byed dgos pa tshang ma gshags bcos byas te bkog dgos/6 bu snod sha sgril gyi 'bras nad(1ṣ+ṭhalos)/ bu snod sha sgril gyi 'bras nad dam mngal 'bras ni bud med kyi skyes 'phel dbang bo'i rgyun mthong gi bzang 'bras zhig yin/ de ni gtso bo 'jam nad de sha gnad dang tshil sna'i phung grub las grub pa zhig red/ 'bras nad de bu snod 'tshar skyed kyi gnas mi 'dra bar gzhigs te 'byar skyi'i 'og dang / sha gnad kyi ldebs gsang / spyin skyi'i 'og bcas khag gsum du dbye yod/(nad rtags gnad bsdus/3sha sgril 'bras nad kyi che chung dang 'tshar skye bya yul mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis kha shas la nad rtags med stabs mo nad tshan khag gi bskyar zhib byed skabs gzhi nas shes rtogs byung ba zhig yin/(1)zla mtshan babs drags pa dang / sha sgril ldebs gsang dang

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 181 'byar skyi'i 'og gi sha sgril 'bras spangs kyis bu snod kyi rgya khyon che ru btang stabs bu snod rub khums bya rgyur shugs rkyen thebs te zla mtshan zlo/ du 'gro ba dang / tshabs che bar zungs khrag nyams pa'i nad yod ( 2)sha sgril 'bras nad cung che bas lhang bu dang yang na drang chags long mor gnon btsir byas stabs gcin pa snyi ba dang / gcin pa shar gtong mi thub pa/ bshang ba 'gags pa sogs kyi nad rtags mngon gyi yod/( 2)grang ba 'dzags mang du song ba dang / 'byar skyi'i 'og gi sgrim 'bras nad la gnyan kha rgyas skabs nad rtags mngon gyi yod/(4)zla mtshan 'bab skabs na ba dang / yang na mngal mi 'khor ba'i gnas tshul thon srid/(5)mo nad tshan khag gi brtag zhib byed skabs su snod che ru song ba dang / sbos ril reg thub pa/ mkhregs tshad de bu snod dang 'dra ba/de dang bu snod kha 'bral mi thub pa bcas rtogs thub/(sman bcos/3( 1)'bras skrangs kyi tshangs thig de li smi bcu man yin pa dang /nad rtags med mkhan la gnas skabs ring sman bcos byas par dus bkag tu brtag zhib byas na 'grig( 2)'bras skrangs kyi tshangs thig de li smi bcu las che ba ma zad/zla mtshan mang po 'jog pa/ yang na khrag nges med du 'thon pa bcas la gshags bcos byas te bkog dgos/

182 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rig( 2)'byar skyi'i 'og gi sha sgril 'bras spangs te che chung la ma bltos par tshang ma gshags bcos byed dgos/gnyisapa/ rgyun mthong gi ngan 'bras/1 glo ba'i ngan 'bras(lo )/ glo ba'i ngan 'bras ni dbugs rngub gtong ma lag nang gi ches rgyun mthong gi ngan 'bras shig yin/rgyun du lo 40yan gyi skyes pa'i rigs la phog rgyu mang yang nad rkyen gsal bo med/ 'on kyang nad de glo yu'i yan lag 'byar skyir yun ring dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi gnyan tshad khrid pa dang tha mag yun ring 'then pa dang 'brel ba yod/(nad rtags gnad bsdus/3(1)thog ma'i skabs kyi nad rtags mang che ba gsal po med/'on kyang skam glo rgyag pa dang / lud pa'i nang khrag yod pa/ brang khog mi bde ba/ skabs 'gar dbugs kha thung zhing dbugs rngub gtong dka' ba sogs kyi nad rtags yod/ de rjes mu mthun rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyis brang kha na ba dang khrag phon chen lu ba sogs kyi rtags ston/(2)dus mjug tu sha rid cing skam pa dang / gzugs po nyams zhan du 'gyur ba/ 'bras kyis glo yu yan lag bkag skabs glo bar dbugs mi slebs pa/ dbugs rngub gtong shin tu dka' ba/ dbugs rngub gtong gi sgra nyams zhan du 'gro ba'am yang na med par 'gyur ba/glo bar rdung brtag byed skabs nyog sgra thon pa/ zas lam gnon btsir byung skabs zas mid dka' ba/ snying khams la gnon btsir byung skabs

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 183 snying gi 'phar tshigs gral mi sgrig pa/ dbugs 'gags pa/ khog stod kyi sdod rtsar gnon btsir byung skabs mgo mjing dang brang stod kyi sdod rtsa 'khyog sbos chags pa/ ol mdud dbang rtsar gnon btsir byung stabs skad 'dzer ba sogs kyi nad rtags thon/( 2)lo na che zhing yun ring yan lag glo yu'i 'byar skyir phog thug byung myong bas glo bar stu'od kyi brtag zhib byed skabs sgong dbyibs kyi grib gzigs mthong tshe glo ba'i ngan 'bras yin par dogs pa byed dgos/dmigs bsal gyi brtag zhib (dper na yan lag glo yu'i che shel dang lud pa'i nang gi phra phung shel leb la byugs pa'i tshod lta sogs) byas te brtag /zlo/ pa/shāka 'khel byed dgos/thog ma'i skabs ngan 'bras phra phung gnas 'gyur med na glo 'dab 'bregagacod dang / yang na glo ba yongs rdzogs 'breg gcod byed pa'i gshags bcos byed dgos/ ngan 'bras phra phung gnas 'gyur zin zhing rtsa bcos byed ma thub na 'od 'phro'i sman bcos dang glo sman nam yang na ngan 'bras 'gog pa'i sman rdzas gzhan dag bed spyod byas te sman bcos byed dgos/2 zas lam ngan 'bras(r+sā07)/ zas lam gyi ngan 'bras la skyugs nad kyang zer/ de ni rgyun mthong ngan 'bras kyi rigs sheg yin/nad de rang rgyal gyi hwa pe sa khul du mang po yod/ nad de langs pa'i lo grangs ni lo 40yan la slobs pa dang / bud med las skye par phog pa mang ba/ zas med myur pa'am yang na dus yun ring bo'i nang ngar

184 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigashugs che ba'i rang bzhin gyi a rag btung ba sogs kyi rgyu rkyen yod/(nad rtags gnad bsdus/kye( 1)thog ma'i skabs nad rtags mang ba dang yang po yod/ brang rus kyi rgyab la bde bo med pa dang / brang kha sub pa/ yang na na zug cung zad rgyag pa dang / mid pa'i nang dngos po gzhan zhugs pa'i tshor snang yod pa/ zas mid skabs 'gag pa'i tshor snang yod pa bcas zla ba kha shas rgyun mthud byed pa/( 2)rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyi zas mid dka' ba de gtso bo'i nad rtags yin/ thog mar zas skam po mid dka' ba dang / de rjes zlo/ sbol ba dang / thug pa/ chu sogs kyang mid dka' ba'i tshor snang ( 2)dus mjug tu sha rid cing skam pa dang / gzugs stobs nyams zhan du 'gro ba/ zungs khrag nyams pa/ sgrog rus steng gi rmen bu'i rtsa mdud sbos cher song ba sogs byed pa/ gal te ngan 'bras phra sbyardo gzhan du gnas 'gyur byas tshe de dang mtshungs pa'i nad rtags thon da(/sman bcos/1( 1) gshags bcos sam yang na 'od 'phro'i sman bcos dang /zas lam du dum bu gong ma'i ngan 'bras la 'od 'phro ba'i sman bcos bya rgyu gtso bo byed dgos/ dum bu bar ma'i ngan 'bras la 'od 'phro'i sman bcos byas rjes gshags bcos kyis 'breg gcod byas na 'tsham po yod/dum bu 'og ma'i ngan 'bras la gshags bcos bya rgyu gtso bo byed dgos

deng dus nub lugs gso rig gi 'bras nad ngos 'dzin/ 185 payin/(2)sngo sman gyis sman bcos byed dgos/( 2)sman rdzas kyis bcos thabs/ krong kong me'i su'u (r+sālko r+sā)dang / spro'i nya'o mi ting (r+sāṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)/ shi byu'u can (r+sā7tsho)sogs bed spyod byed dgos/2 pho ba'i ngan 'bras(ṣ+ṭha7)/ pho ba'i ngan 'bras ni mang che ba lo 40yan la slobs pa'i skye par phog sla ba'i thog nad de pho sgo'i nye 'gram dang pho ba'i gug 'khyog chung sar phog sla bo yod/(1)thog ma'i skabs grod stod bde po med pa dang / dang ga 'gags pa/ 'ju stobs 'an pa/ grod stod na ba bcas kyi mngon tshul yod pa ma zad/ mthar gzugs po'i ljid tshad chag pa dang zungs khrag nyams kyi yod/bshang ba'i mi mngon pa'i khrag gi tshod lta byas na mngon pa'i rang bzhin yin/(2)pho ba ral zags po yod pa dang dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi pho ba'i gnyan tshad khrid myong yod pa'i thog nye dus dmigs bsal slong rkyen med kyang na zug rgyag pa'i dus nges gtan med pa dang / de sngon phal cher ba'i sman rdzas spyad kyang da cha phan nus med par 'gyur ba/ de dang chabs cig sha rid cing skam pa/ dang ga zhan du song ba bcas kyi nad rtags yod na ngan 'bras su nad 'gyur byas yod pa shes dgos/(sman bcos/3snga tsam nad brtag gtan 'khel gyis gshags bcos byed dgos

186 bod lugs 'bras nad gso rigapa dang / dus mjug tu sngo sman nam yang na ngan 'bras 'gog pa'i sman gyis sman bcos byas na nad gzhi yang du 'gro bar phan pa yod/4 mchin pa'i ngan 'bras(1 nya6)/ mchin pa'i ngan 'bras de thog mar byung ba'i rang bzhin dang rjes su byung ba'i rang bzhin rigs gnyis su dbye yod/ rjes ma de mang che ba glo ba dang / pho ba/ rgyu ma/bu snod sogs kyi ngan 'bras gnas 'gyur byas pa las byung ba zhig yin pa dang / thog mar byung ba'i rang ba'in gyi mchin pa'i ngan 'bras de lo 30nas 50bar gyi mi'i nang du phog pa mang 'ing / nad de mchin pa mkhregs 'gyur gyi nad dang / mchin pa'i ga'an rten srin bu'i nad sogs dang 'brel ba nges can zhig yod/(nad rtags gnad bsdus/1( 1)thog ma'i skabs zas kyi dang ga 'gags pa dang / thang chad pa/ mchin pa'i khongs mtshams su sbos zug rgyag pa sogs kyi mtshon tshul yod pa dang / dus mjug tu sha rid cing skam pa dang zungs khrag shāms pa/ tha na ngo bo ngan 'gyur byed pa sogs kyi nad rtags mngon gyi da/ ( 2)rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyi mchin pa sbos cher song ba dang /ngo bo mkhregs pa/ sbos ril gyi dbyibs dang yang na rdog dbyibs ldan pa/ ngan 'bras rul skam byed pa gnyan kha rgyas skabs nges gtan med par tsha ba rgyas pa dang skabs 'gar khrag ldan rang bzhin gyi grod chu bsags pa bcas byed pa/( 2) dmigs bsal gyi brtag zhib byed pa'i thabs gzhan
